import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Walk

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# True quantified Boolean formulas are decidable in polynomial space

The correctness of the assignment walk of the `TQBF` register machine
`Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.A` at an inner node (`inner_spec`), hence at every depth
(`call_spec`), and the resulting membership of the true quantified Boolean formulas in
`PSPACE` (`Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.truth_mem_PSPACE`) — the membership half of
[AB09, Theorem 4.13], by the recursive evaluation of its proof run with an explicit stack
of assignment bits.

## Main definitions

* none (correctness theorems for the machine `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.A`; the walk's
  correctness predicate `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.CallOK` is in
  `TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Walk`).

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.inner_spec`, `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.call_spec` — the
  walk computes `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.Val`.
* `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.truth_mem_PSPACE` — `{x | (QBF.decode x).truth} ∈ PSPACE`.
  [AB09, Theorem 4.13, membership half]

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.2, Theorem 4.13.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

namespace TQBFARM

open Turing
open Std.Sat (CNF)

variable {x : List Bool} {B : ℕ} {qs : List Bool} {φ : CNF ℕ}

/-- The prefix bit `k` sits doubled at input positions `2k` and `2k + 1`. -/
lemma getD_quant (hx : x = pairEncode qs (CNF.serialize φ)) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < qs.length) :
    x.getD (2 * k) false = qs[k] ∧ x.getD (2 * k + 1) false = qs[k] := by
  rw [getD_enc hx, getD_enc hx]
  simp [show 2 * k < 2 * qs.length by omega, show 2 * k + 1 < 2 * qs.length by omega,
    show (2 * k + 1) / 2 = k by omega, hk]

open Classical in
/-- **An inner node**: if the walk is correct at depth `k + 1 ≤ |qs|`, it is correct at
depth `k`.

**Proof sketch.** The node reads the prefix bit at `2K` (and, when it is `0`, the bit at
`2K + 1`, again not the separator) and pushes `0`; the first child returns
`v₀ = Val (k + 1) (2S)` (the hypothesis), the pop restores `S` and the quantifier is read
again at `2K`. If `v₀` decides the quantifier (`1` under `∃`, `0` under `∀`) the node returns
`v₀`; otherwise it pushes `1`, and the second child's value `Val (k + 1) (2S + 1)` is returned
after the pop. `val_ex` and `val_all` identify the returned value with `Val k S`. -/
theorem inner_spec (hx : x = pairEncode qs (CNF.serialize φ)) (hB1 : 2 ^ (qs.length + 1) ≤ B)
    (hB2 : x.length ≤ B) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < qs.length) (IH : CallOK x B qs φ (k + 1)) :
    CallOK x B qs φ k := by
  intro S hS
  have hlen := length_enc hx
  obtain ⟨hq0, hq1⟩ := getD_quant hx hk
  have hp1 : 2 ^ (k + 2) ≤ 2 ^ (qs.length + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hp2 : 2 ^ (k + 2) = 2 * 2 ^ (k + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
  have hS2 : 2 * S + 1 ≤ B := by omega
  have hkB : 2 * k + 1 ≤ B := by omega
  -- the first child
  have first : Run x B .node (stp k S 0) .node (stp (k + 1) (2 * S) 0) := by
    refine (node_run k S 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)).trans ?_
    have e : stp (k + 1) (2 * S) 0 = stp (k + 1) (2 * S + false.toNat) 0 := by simp
    rw [e]
    cases hqk : qs[k]
    · refine read_f (l := .nd1) rfl (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
        (by show x.getD (2 * k) false = false; rw [hq0, hqk]) ?_
      refine step_of (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
      regs [astep_inc (show A .nd2 = _ from rfl)]
      refine cont (st' := stp k S (2 * k + 1)) rfl ?_
      refine read_f (l := .nd3) rfl (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
        (by show x.getD (2 * k + 1) false = false; rw [hq1, hqk]) ?_
      exact push_run false k S _ (by omega) hS2 (by omega)
    · refine read_t (l := .nd1) rfl (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
        (by show x.getD (2 * k) false = true; rw [hq0, hqk]) ?_
      exact push_run false k S _ (by omega) hS2 (by omega)
  have c0 := IH (2 * S) (by omega)
  -- the pop after the first child and the quantifier lookup
  have back : ∀ v : Bool, Run x B (.rt v) (stp (k + 1) (2 * S) 0) (cond qs[k] (.qE v) (.qU v))
      (stp k S (2 * k)) := by
    intro v
    have hp := pop_run (x := x) v false k S (by omega) hS2
    simp only [Bool.toNat_false, add_zero, cond_false] at hp
    refine hp.trans ((qlook_run v k S (by omega) (by omega)).trans ?_)
    exact read_b (l := .qr v) rfl (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) hq0 (AReach.refl _)
  -- the second child, entered from a push of `1`
  have second : Run x B (.push true) (stp k S 0) (.rt (decide (Val qs φ (k + 1) (2 * S + 1))))
      (stp k S 0) := by
    have hpush := push_run (x := x) true k S 0 (by omega) hS2 (by omega)
    simp only [Bool.toNat_true] at hpush
    refine hpush.trans ((IH (2 * S + 1) (by omega)).trans ?_)
    have hp := pop_run (x := x) (decide (Val qs φ (k + 1) (2 * S + 1))) true k S (by omega) hS2
    simpa only [Bool.toNat_true, cond_true] using hp
  refine first.trans (c0.trans ((back _).trans ?_))
  by_cases h0 : Val qs φ (k + 1) (2 * S)
  · rw [decide_eq_true h0]
    cases hqk : qs[k]
    · -- universal, first child true: the second child decides
      have hv : Val qs φ k S ↔ Val qs φ (k + 1) (2 * S + 1) := by
        rw [val_all qs φ k S hk hqk]; exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨h0, h⟩⟩
      refine step_of (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
      regs [astep_clr (show A (.qU true) = _ from rfl), cond_false, if_true]
      refine cont (st' := stp k S 0) rfl ?_
      rw [show decide (Val qs φ k S) = decide (Val qs φ (k + 1) (2 * S + 1)) from
        decide_eq_decide.mpr hv]
      exact second
    · -- existential, first child true
      have hv : Val qs φ k S := (val_ex qs φ k S hk hqk).mpr (Or.inl h0)
      refine step_of (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
      regs [astep_clr (show A (.qE true) = _ from rfl), cond_true, if_true]
      rw [decide_eq_true hv]
      exact fin_of (by sext [stp])
  · rw [decide_eq_false h0]
    cases hqk : qs[k]
    · -- universal, first child false
      have hv : ¬ Val qs φ k S := fun h => h0 ((val_all qs φ k S hk hqk).mp h).1
      refine step_of (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
      regs [astep_clr (show A (.qU false) = _ from rfl), cond_false, Bool.false_eq_true,
        if_false]
      rw [decide_eq_false hv]
      exact fin_of (by sext [stp])
    · -- existential, first child false: the second child decides
      have hv : Val qs φ k S ↔ Val qs φ (k + 1) (2 * S + 1) := by
        rw [val_ex qs φ k S hk hqk]; exact ⟨fun h => h.resolve_left h0, Or.inr⟩
      refine step_of (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
      regs [astep_clr (show A (.qE false) = _ from rfl), cond_true, Bool.false_eq_true,
        if_false]
      refine cont (st' := stp k S 0) rfl ?_
      rw [show decide (Val qs φ k S) = decide (Val qs φ (k + 1) (2 * S + 1)) from
        decide_eq_decide.mpr hv]
      exact second

/-- **The walk is correct at every depth.**

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the remaining depth `|qs| - k`: `leaf_spec` at the full depth,
`inner_spec` above. -/
theorem call_spec (hx : x = pairEncode qs (CNF.serialize φ)) (hB1 : 2 ^ (qs.length + 1) ≤ B)
    (hB2 : x.length ≤ B) : ∀ j k, k + j = qs.length → CallOK x B qs φ k := by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro k hk
    obtain rfl : k = qs.length := by omega
    exact leaf_spec hx hB1 hB2
  | succ j ih =>
    intro k hk
    exact inner_spec hx hB1 hB2 k (by omega) (ih (k + 1) (by omega))

open Classical in
/-- **True quantified Boolean formulas are decidable in polynomial space**: the strings whose
decoding (`Complexity.QBF.decode`) is a true formula form a language in `PSPACE`.
[AB09, Theorem 4.13, membership half]

**Proof sketch.** `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_pspace_val` with the input-bit and
input-length deciders and the value bound `2 ^ (|x| + 1)`. The machine sets `S := 1` and runs
the syntax automaton over `x` (`syn_run`). A rejected string decodes to a true formula
(`truth_of_not_synOK`), and the machine answers `1`. An accepted string is
`pairEncode qs (serialize φ)` (`repr_of_synOK`); the walk from the root returns
`Val qs φ 0 1` (`call_spec`), the truth of the decoded formula (`val_root`). Every register
stays at most the value bound `2 ^ (|x| + 1)`. In the syntax scan the stack is `1`, the
pointer is at most `|x|` and the other registers are `0`. On the walk the stack and its
scratch copy `T` stay below `2 ^ (|qs| + 1)`, which is at most `2 ^ (|x| + 1)` because an
encoding has `2|qs| + 2 ≤ |x|`; the pointer, the depth, the halving counter and the
literal's variable stay at most `|x|`; and the copy loops' scratch register `Z` stays at most
the register being copied. -/
theorem truth_mem_PSPACE : {x : List Bool | (QBF.decode x).truth} ∈ PSPACE := by
  refine arm_decides_pspace_val A .init decs (fun j => LOGSPACE_subset_PSPACE (decs_mem j)) 1 1
    fun x => ?_
  set B := 2 ^ (1 * (x.length + 1) ^ 1) with hB
  have hB' : B = 2 ^ (x.length + 1) := by simp [hB]
  have hxB : x.length + 1 ≤ B := by rw [hB']; exact (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le
  change AHalt A orc x (GuardLe A x B) (some .init, fun _ => 0, none) _
  rw [St.toV_zero]
  refine AHalt.step (gb_of (by simp only [St.Bd, St.zero]; omega) .init) ?_
  regs [astep_inc (show A .init = _ from rfl)]
  have hbd1 : St.Bd B { St.zero with S := 0 + 1 } := by simp only [St.Bd, St.zero]; omega
  refine (syn_run (x := x) (B := B) x.length (.inl none) { St.zero with S := 0 + 1 }
    (by simp [St.zero]) hbd1 (by omega)).halt ?_
  simp only [St.zero, List.drop_zero]
  rw [indicator_eq_decide]
  by_cases hv : synOK x = true
  · obtain ⟨qs, φ, hx⟩ := repr_of_synOK hv
    have hq : x.foldl synStep (.inl none) = .inr 4 := by simpa [synOK] using hv
    rw [hq]
    have hlen := length_enc hx
    have hB1 : 2 ^ (qs.length + 1) ≤ B := by
      rw [hB']; exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    refine AHalt.step (gb_of (by simp only [St.Bd]; omega) _) ?_
    regs [astep_clr (show A (.vend (Sum.inr 4)) = _ from rfl), if_true]
    refine AReach.halt (b := (some (.rt (decide (Val qs φ 0 1))), (stp 0 1 0).toV, none))
      (reach_of_eq ((cont (st' := stp 0 1 0) (by sext [stp]) (call_spec hx hB1 (by omega)
        qs.length 0 (by omega) 1 (by norm_num)))) rfl) ?_
    refine AHalt.step (gb_of (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) _) ?_
    simp only [astep_jz (show A (.rt (decide (Val qs φ 0 1))) = _ from rfl), stp, St.toV_K]
    regs [if_true]
    have hans : decide (Val qs φ 0 1) = decide (x ∈ {x : List Bool | (QBF.decode x).truth}) := by
      apply decide_eq_decide.mpr
      rw [val_root, ← hx]; rfl
    rw [hans]
    exact AHalt.ret rfl (gb_of (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) _)
  · have hf : synOK x = false := by simpa using hv
    have hq : x.foldl synStep (.inl none) ≠ .inr 4 := by simpa [synOK] using hf
    have hmem : decide (x ∈ {x : List Bool | (QBF.decode x).truth}) = true :=
      decide_eq_true (truth_of_not_synOK hf)
    rw [hmem]
    exact AHalt.ret (by simp [A, hq]) (gb_of (by simp only [St.Bd]; omega) _)

end TQBFARM

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Machine

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Matrix evaluation in the `TQBF` register machine

At a leaf of the assignment walk, `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.A` evaluates the CNF matrix
under the assignment `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.asg K S` of its stack, streaming the
serialization `Std.Sat.CNF.serialize` from the input: a literal `(v, b)` is a unary run of
`v + 1` ones, a zero and the polarity bit (`lc_run`, `lit_run`); a clause is a list of
literals closed by a zero (`clause_run`); the formula is a list of clauses, each announced by
a one, closed by a zero (`formula_run`). The variable's value is read off the stack by the
arithmetic of `lv_run`. Every run is through register files bounded by `B`.

Infrastructure for [AB09, §4.2, Theorem 4.13, membership half]; not itself a result of the
book.

## Main definitions

* none (run theorems of the input reads and the matrix evaluation; the file also adds the
  scoped tactics `bdt` and `sext`, which close register-file bounds and register-file
  equations).

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.read_t`, `read_f` — a read of the input.
* `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.lv_run` — the lookup of a literal's variable.
* `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.formula_run` — the matrix evaluation.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.2, Theorem 4.13.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

namespace TQBFARM

open Turing
open Std.Sat (CNF)

/-! ## Reading the input -/

variable {x : List Bool} {B : ℕ}

/-- **A read of the input returning `1`**: a bit call at a label continues at its yes-label. -/
lemma read_t {l l₁ l₀ : Lb} {st : St} {c : AConf 7 Lb}
    (hl : A l = .call 0 .whole [rP] l₁ l₀) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hb : x.getD st.P false = true)
    (h : AReach A orc x (GuardLe A x B) (some l₁, st.toV, none) c) :
    AReach A orc x (GuardLe A x B) (some l, st.toV, none) c := by
  refine step_of hbd ?_
  rw [astep_call hl, vword_whole₁]
  rw [St.toV_P, orc_bit, hb, if_pos rfl]
  exact h

/-- **A read of the input returning `0`**: a bit call at a label continues at its no-label. -/
lemma read_f {l l₁ l₀ : Lb} {st : St} {c : AConf 7 Lb}
    (hl : A l = .call 0 .whole [rP] l₁ l₀) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hb : x.getD st.P false = false)
    (h : AReach A orc x (GuardLe A x B) (some l₀, st.toV, none) c) :
    AReach A orc x (GuardLe A x B) (some l, st.toV, none) c := by
  refine step_of hbd ?_
  rw [astep_call hl, vword_whole₁]
  rw [St.toV_P, orc_bit, hb, if_neg (by decide)]
  exact h

/-- **A read of the input**, by the value read. -/
lemma read_b {l l₁ l₀ : Lb} {st : St} {c : AConf 7 Lb}
    (hl : A l = .call 0 .whole [rP] l₁ l₀) (hbd : st.Bd B) {b : Bool}
    (hb : x.getD st.P false = b)
    (h : AReach A orc x (GuardLe A x B) (some (cond b l₁ l₀), st.toV, none) c) :
    AReach A orc x (GuardLe A x B) (some l, st.toV, none) c := by
  cases b
  · exact read_f hl hbd hb h
  · exact read_t hl hbd hb h

/-- Close a register-file bound from the unfolded bounds in context. -/
scoped macro "bdt" : tactic => `(tactic| (simp only [St.Bd] at *; omega))

/-- Close an equation of register files field by field. -/
scoped syntax "sext" (" [" (Lean.Parser.Tactic.simpLemma),* "]")? : tactic
scoped macro_rules
  | `(tactic| sext) => `(tactic| (ext <;> (try simp) <;> omega))
  | `(tactic| sext [$args,*]) => `(tactic| (ext <;> (try simp [$args,*]) <;> omega))

/-! ## Literals -/

/-- **Counting a unary variable**: from `lc s` with the input at `P` reading `1ⁿ 0 b`, the
machine adds `n` to `V`, moves `P` past the polarity and reaches `lv s b`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `n`: each `1` increments `V` and `P`; the final zero and the
polarity bit are read and skipped. -/
theorem lc_run (s b : Bool) (rest : List Bool) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (st : St),
    x.drop st.P = List.replicate n true ++ false :: b :: rest → st.Bd B →
    x.length ≤ B → st.V ≤ st.P →
    Run x B (.lc s) st (.lv s b) { st with P := st.P + n + 2, V := st.V + n } := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro st h hbd hx hV
    simp only [List.replicate_zero, List.nil_append] at h
    have h1 := drop_succ_of_drop h
    have hl := lt_of_drop h1
    refine read_f (l := .lc s) rfl hbd (getD_of_drop h) ?_
    refine step_of hbd ?_
    regs [astep_inc (show A (.lcF s) = _ from rfl)]
    have hbd1 : St.Bd B { st with P := st.P + 1 } := by bdt
    refine read_b (l := .lb s) rfl hbd1 (getD_of_drop h1) ?_
    cases b <;>
    · refine step_of hbd1 ?_
      regs [astep_inc (show A (.lp s _) = _ from rfl), cond_true, cond_false]
      exact fin_of (by sext)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro st h hbd hx hV
    have h0 : x.drop st.P = true :: (List.replicate n true ++ false :: b :: rest) := by
      simpa [List.replicate_succ] using h
    have h1 := drop_succ_of_drop h0
    have hl := lt_of_drop h0
    refine read_t (l := .lc s) rfl hbd (getD_of_drop h0) ?_
    refine step_of hbd ?_
    regs [astep_inc (show A (.lcT s) = _ from rfl)]
    have hbd1 : St.Bd B { st with V := st.V + 1 } := by bdt
    refine step_of hbd1 ?_
    regs [astep_inc (show A (.lcI s) = _ from rfl)]
    have hbd2 : St.Bd B { st with V := st.V + 1, P := st.P + 1 } := by bdt
    have := ih { st with V := st.V + 1, P := st.P + 1 } h1 hbd2 hx (by simp; omega)
    refine reach_of_eq this ?_
    congr 3
    sext

/-- **The lookup of a literal**: from `lv false b` at depth `K`, with `T`, `Z`, `C` clear, the
machine reaches `cl s'` with `s'` whether the variable `V` reads `b` under `asg K S`, and
clears `V`.

**Proof sketch.** `C := K` (copy), `C := C - V` (`sb_run`). If `C = 0`, the variable is free
and reads `0`. Otherwise `C := C - 1`, `T := S` (copy), `T := T / 2 ^ C` (`hv_run`), and the
oddness of `T` is bit `K - 1 - V` of `S`; `T` is cleared. -/
theorem lv_run (b : Bool) (st : St) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hT : st.T = 0) (hZ : st.Z = 0)
    (hC : st.C = 0) :
    Run x B (.lv false b) st (.cl (asg st.K st.S st.V == b)) { st with V := 0 } := by
  have hb0 := hbd
  simp only [St.Bd] at hb0
  refine step_of hbd ?_
  regs [astep_clr (show A (.lv false b) = _ from rfl), Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  have e0 : { st with T := 0 } = st := by ext <;> simp [hT]
  rw [e0]
  refine (cp_run (.lK b) st hbd hZ (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; omega)).trans ?_
  regs [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit]
  have hbd1 : St.Bd B { st with C := st.C + st.K } := by bdt
  refine (sb_run b _ hbd1).trans ?_
  have hbd2 : St.Bd B { st with V := 0, C := st.C + st.K - st.V } := by bdt
  refine step_of hbd2 ?_
  regs [astep_jz (show A (.jzC b) = _ from rfl)]
  by_cases hk : st.C + st.K - st.V = 0
  · rw [if_pos hk]
    have ha : asg st.K st.S st.V = false := by
      simp [asg, show ¬ st.V < st.K by omega]
    rw [ha]
    cases b <;> exact fin_of (by sext)
  · rw [if_neg hk]
    refine step_of hbd2 ?_
    regs [astep_dec (show A (.dc b) = _ from rfl)]
    set st3 : St := { st with V := 0, C := st.C + st.K - st.V - 1 } with hst3
    have hbd3 : St.Bd B st3 := by simp only [hst3]; bdt
    refine (cp_run (.lS b) st3 hbd3 (by simp [hst3, hZ])
      (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; simp only [hst3]; omega)).trans ?_
    regs [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit]
    have hbd4 : St.Bd B { st3 with T := st3.T + st3.S } := by simp only [hst3]; bdt
    refine (hv_run b _ hbd4).trans ?_
    set q := (st3.T + st3.S) / 2 ^ st3.C with hq
    have hqS : q ≤ st.S := by
      simp only [hq, hst3, hT, zero_add]; exact Nat.div_le_self _ _
    have hbd5 : St.Bd B { st3 with T := q, C := 0 } := by simp only [hst3]; bdt
    have ha : asg st.K st.S st.V = decide (q % 2 = 1) := by
      simp only [asg, hq, hst3, hT, hC, zero_add]
      rw [show st.K - st.V - 1 = st.K - 1 - st.V by omega]
      simp [show st.V < st.K by omega]
    refine step_of (st := { st3 with T := q, C := 0 }) hbd5 ?_
    regs [astep_jodd (show A (.od b) = _ from rfl)]
    by_cases ho : q % 2 = 1
    · rw [if_pos ho]
      refine step_of hbd5 ?_
      regs [astep_clr (show A (.ot b) = _ from rfl)]
      rw [ha, decide_eq_true ho]
      cases b <;> exact fin_of (by sext [hst3, hC])
    · rw [if_neg ho]
      refine step_of hbd5 ?_
      regs [astep_clr (show A (.of b) = _ from rfl)]
      rw [ha, decide_eq_false ho]
      cases b <;> exact fin_of (by sext [hst3, hC])

/-- **A literal**: from `lt s` with the input at `P` reading the serialization of `(v, b)`,
and `T`, `Z`, `C`, `V` clear, the machine moves `P` past the literal and reaches `cl s'` with
`s'` whether the clause is satisfied so far (`s`, or `v` reads `b` under `asg K S`).

**Proof sketch.** Skip the first `1` of the unary run, count the rest (`lc_run`); if the
clause is already satisfied clear `V`, otherwise look the variable up (`lv_run`). -/
theorem lit_run (s : Bool) (v : ℕ) (b : Bool) (rest : List Bool) (st : St)
    (h : x.drop st.P = CNF.serializeLit (v, b) ++ rest) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hx : x.length ≤ B)
    (hT : st.T = 0) (hZ : st.Z = 0) (hC : st.C = 0) (hV : st.V = 0) :
    Run x B (.lt s) st (.cl (s || (asg st.K st.S v == b))) { st with P := st.P + v + 3 } := by
  have hl := le_of_drop h (by simp [CNF.serializeLit])
  simp only [CNF.serializeLit, List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons,
    List.length_nil] at hl
  have h0 : x.drop st.P = true :: (List.replicate v true ++ false :: b :: rest) := by
    simpa [CNF.serializeLit, List.replicate_succ] using h
  refine step_of hbd ?_
  regs [astep_inc (show A (.lt s) = _ from rfl)]
  have hbd1 : St.Bd B { st with P := st.P + 1 } := by bdt
  refine (lc_run s b rest v _ (drop_succ_of_drop h0) hbd1 hx (by simp; omega)).trans ?_
  have hbd2 : St.Bd B { st with P := st.P + 1 + v + 2, V := st.V + v } := by bdt
  cases s
  · have := lv_run (x := x) b _ hbd2 hT hZ hC
    simp only [hV, zero_add] at this ⊢
    refine reach_of_eq this ?_
    simp only [Bool.false_or]
    congr 3
    sext
  · refine step_of hbd2 ?_
    regs [astep_clr (show A (.lv true b) = _ from rfl), if_true]
    exact fin_of (by sext [hV])

/-- **A clause**: from `cl s` with the input at `P` reading the literals of `Cl` and the
clause terminator, and `T`, `Z`, `C`, `V` clear, the machine reaches `ce s'` at the terminator,
`s'` being `s` or the value of `Cl` under `asg K S`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `Cl`: a `0` ends the clause; a `1` starts a literal
(`lit_run`). -/
theorem clause_run (rest : List Bool) : ∀ (Cl : CNF.Clause ℕ) (s : Bool) (st : St),
    x.drop st.P = Cl.flatMap CNF.serializeLit ++ false :: rest → st.Bd B → x.length ≤ B →
    st.T = 0 → st.Z = 0 → st.C = 0 → st.V = 0 →
    Run x B (.cl s) st (.ce (s || CNF.Clause.eval (asg st.K st.S) Cl))
      { st with P := st.P + (Cl.flatMap CNF.serializeLit).length } := by
  intro Cl
  induction Cl with
  | nil =>
    intro s st h hbd hx hT hZ hC hV
    simp only [List.flatMap_nil, List.nil_append] at h
    refine read_f (l := .cl s) rfl hbd (getD_of_drop h) ?_
    rw [CNF.Clause.eval_nil, Bool.or_false]
    exact fin_of (by sext)
  | cons ℓ Cl ih =>
    intro s st h hbd hx hT hZ hC hV
    obtain ⟨v, b⟩ := ℓ
    have h' : x.drop st.P = CNF.serializeLit (v, b) ++
        (Cl.flatMap CNF.serializeLit ++ false :: rest) := by
      simpa [List.append_assoc] using h
    have hh : x.drop st.P = true :: (List.replicate v true ++ [false, b] ++
        (Cl.flatMap CNF.serializeLit ++ false :: rest)) := by
      simpa [CNF.serializeLit, List.replicate_succ, List.append_assoc] using h'
    refine read_t (l := .cl s) rfl hbd (getD_of_drop hh) ?_
    refine (lit_run s v b _ st h' hbd hx hT hZ hC hV).trans ?_
    have h2 := drop_add_of_drop h'
    simp only [CNF.serializeLit, List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons,
      List.length_nil] at h2
    have hl := le_of_drop h' (by simp [CNF.serializeLit])
    simp only [CNF.serializeLit, List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons,
      List.length_nil] at hl
    have hbd1 : St.Bd B { st with P := st.P + v + 3 } := by bdt
    have := ih (s || (asg st.K st.S v == b)) { st with P := st.P + v + 3 }
      (by simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using h2) hbd1 hx hT hZ hC hV
    refine reach_of_eq this ?_
    simp only [CNF.Clause.eval_cons, Bool.or_assoc]
    congr 3
    sext [CNF.serializeLit]

/-- **The matrix**: from `fm` with the input at `P` reading the serialization of `φ`, and
`T`, `Z`, `C`, `V` clear, the machine reaches `rt v` with `v` the value of `φ` under
`asg K S`, and clears `P`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `φ`: a `0` ends the formula (value `1`); a `1` announces a
clause (`clause_run`), after whose terminator the machine continues if the clause is
satisfied and returns `0` otherwise. -/
theorem formula_run (rest : List Bool) : ∀ (φ : CNF ℕ) (st : St),
    x.drop st.P = CNF.serialize φ ++ rest → st.Bd B → x.length ≤ B →
    st.T = 0 → st.Z = 0 → st.C = 0 → st.V = 0 →
    Run x B .fm st (.rt (CNF.eval (asg st.K st.S) φ)) { st with P := 0 } := by
  intro φ
  induction φ with
  | nil =>
    intro st h hbd hx hT hZ hC hV
    simp only [CNF.serialize, List.flatMap_nil, List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at h
    refine read_f (l := .fm) rfl hbd (getD_of_drop h) ?_
    refine step_of hbd ?_
    regs [astep_clr (show A (.lend true) = _ from rfl)]
    exact fin_of rfl
  | cons Cl φ ih =>
    intro st h hbd hx hT hZ hC hV
    have h0 : x.drop st.P = true :: (Cl.flatMap CNF.serializeLit ++ false ::
        (CNF.serialize φ ++ rest)) := by
      simpa [CNF.serialize, CNF.serializeClause, List.append_assoc] using h
    have h1 := drop_succ_of_drop h0
    have hl := le_of_drop (u := Cl.flatMap CNF.serializeLit ++ [false])
      (by simpa [List.append_assoc] using h1) (by simp)
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hl
    refine read_t (l := .fm) rfl hbd (getD_of_drop h0) ?_
    refine step_of hbd ?_
    regs [astep_inc (show A .fmT = _ from rfl)]
    have hbd1 : St.Bd B { st with P := st.P + 1 } := by bdt
    refine (clause_run _ Cl false _ h1 hbd1 hx hT hZ hC hV).trans ?_
    simp only [Bool.false_or]
    set P1 := st.P + 1 + (Cl.flatMap CNF.serializeLit).length with hP1
    have hbd2 : St.Bd B { st with P := P1 } := by bdt
    refine step_of hbd2 ?_
    regs [astep_inc (show A (.ce _) = _ from rfl)]
    have h2 : x.drop (P1 + 1) = CNF.serialize φ ++ rest := by
      have := drop_add_of_drop (u := Cl.flatMap CNF.serializeLit ++ [false]) (p := st.P + 1)
        (by simpa [List.append_assoc] using h1)
      simpa [hP1, Nat.add_assoc] using this
    have hbd3 : St.Bd B { st with P := P1 + 1 } := by bdt
    cases hc : CNF.Clause.eval (asg st.K st.S) Cl
    · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, CNF.eval_cons, hc, Bool.false_and]
      refine step_of hbd3 ?_
      regs [astep_clr (show A (.lend false) = _ from rfl)]
      exact fin_of (by ext <;> simp)
    · simp only [if_true, CNF.eval_cons, hc, Bool.true_and]
      have := ih { st with P := P1 + 1 } h2 hbd3 hx hT hZ hC hV
      refine reach_of_eq this ?_
      congr 3

end TQBFARM

end Complexity.LogProg
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/ClassPSPACE/TQBFARM/Walk.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Leaf

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The syntax check and the assignment walk of the `TQBF` register machine

The `TQBF` register machine `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.A` first runs the syntax automaton
over its input (`syn_run`), then evaluates the quantified formula by a depth-first walk over
the partial assignments of its prefix, kept as a binary stack `S` at depth `K`. This file
holds the walk's building blocks — locating a node's pair (`node_run`), pushing (`push_run`),
popping (`pop_run`), the quantifier lookup (`qlook_run`) — and its correctness at a leaf
(`leaf_spec`), where the matrix is evaluated (`Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.formula_run`).
The inner nodes and the conclusion `TQBF ∈ PSPACE` are in
`TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Correct`.

Infrastructure for [AB09, §4.2, Theorem 4.13, membership half]; not itself a result of the
book.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.stp` — the register files of the walk.
* `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.CallOK` — the correctness of the walk at a depth.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.syn_run` — the syntax check.
* `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.node_run`, `push_run`, `pop_run`, `qlook_run` — the walk's
  steps.
* `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.leaf_spec` — the walk is correct at a leaf.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.2, Theorem 4.13.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

namespace TQBFARM

open Turing
open Std.Sat (CNF)

variable {x : List Bool} {B : ℕ}

/-! ## The syntax check -/

/-- **A length query answered `1`**. -/
lemma len_t {l l₁ l₀ : Lb} {st : St} {c : AConf 7 Lb}
    (hl : A l = .call 1 .whole [rP] l₁ l₀) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : st.P < x.length)
    (h : AReach A orc x (GuardLe A x B) (some l₁, st.toV, none) c) :
    AReach A orc x (GuardLe A x B) (some l, st.toV, none) c := by
  refine step_of hbd ?_
  rw [astep_call hl, vword_whole₁]
  rw [St.toV_P, orc_len, decide_eq_true hp, if_pos rfl]
  exact h

/-- **A length query answered `0`**. -/
lemma len_f {l l₁ l₀ : Lb} {st : St} {c : AConf 7 Lb}
    (hl : A l = .call 1 .whole [rP] l₁ l₀) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : ¬ st.P < x.length)
    (h : AReach A orc x (GuardLe A x B) (some l₀, st.toV, none) c) :
    AReach A orc x (GuardLe A x B) (some l, st.toV, none) c := by
  refine step_of hbd ?_
  rw [astep_call hl, vword_whole₁]
  rw [St.toV_P, orc_len, decide_eq_false hp, if_neg (by decide)]
  exact h

/-- **The syntax loop**: from `vl q` at `P = |x| - n`, the machine steps the automaton over the
rest of the input and reaches `vend q'` at `P = |x|`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `n`: below the end, the length query succeeds, the bit is read
and the automaton stepped; at the end the query fails. -/
theorem syn_run : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : SynSt) (st : St), st.P + n = x.length → st.Bd B →
    x.length ≤ B →
    Run x B (.vl q) st (.vend ((x.drop st.P).foldl synStep q)) { st with P := x.length } := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro q st hn hbd hx
    refine len_f (l := .vl q) rfl hbd (by omega) ?_
    rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega), List.foldl_nil]
    exact fin_of (by sext)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro q st hn hbd hx
    have hlt : st.P < x.length := by omega
    have hd : x.drop st.P = x[st.P] :: x.drop (st.P + 1) := List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt
    generalize x[st.P] = b at hd
    have hbd1 : St.Bd B { st with P := st.P + 1 } := by bdt
    have := ih (synStep q b) { st with P := st.P + 1 } (by simp; omega) hbd1 hx
    refine len_t (l := .vl q) rfl hbd hlt ?_
    refine read_b (l := .vr q) rfl hbd (getD_of_drop hd) ?_
    rw [hd, List.foldl_cons]
    cases b <;>
    · refine step_of hbd ?_
      regs [astep_inc (show A (.vs q _) = _ from rfl), cond_true, cond_false]
      exact this

/-! ## The walk -/

/-- **The register file of the walk** at depth `k`, with stack `S` and pointer `p`: every
other register clear. -/
def stp (k S p : ℕ) : St := ⟨k, S, p, 0, 0, 0, 0⟩

/-- Continue a run from an equal register file. -/
lemma cont {st st' : St} {l : Lb} {c : AConf 7 Lb} (e : st = st')
    (h : AReach A orc x (GuardLe A x B) (some l, st'.toV, none) c) :
    AReach A orc x (GuardLe A x B) (some l, st.toV, none) c := e ▸ h

/-- A walk register file is bounded. -/
lemma stp_bd {k S p : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ B) (hS : S ≤ B) (hp : p ≤ B) : (stp k S p).Bd B := by
  simp only [St.Bd, stp]; omega

section Walk

variable {qs : List Bool} {φ : CNF ℕ}

/-- The bits of an encoded formula: the doubled prefix, then the separator `01`. -/
lemma getD_enc (hx : x = pairEncode qs (CNF.serialize φ)) (j : ℕ) :
    x.getD j false = if j < 2 * qs.length then qs.getD (j / 2) false
      else if j = 2 * qs.length then false
      else if j = 2 * qs.length + 1 then true
      else (CNF.serialize φ).getD (j - 2 * qs.length - 2) false := by
  rw [hx, pairEncode_getD]

/-- The length of an encoded formula: at least `2|qs| + 2`. -/
lemma length_enc (hx : x = pairEncode qs (CNF.serialize φ)) : 2 * qs.length + 2 ≤ x.length := by
  rw [hx, length_pairEncode]; omega

/-- **Locating the node's pair**: from `node`, the machine sets `P := 2K` and reaches `nd1`. -/
theorem node_run (k S p : ℕ) (hk : 2 * k ≤ B) (hS : S ≤ B) (hp : p ≤ B) :
    Run x B .node (stp k S p) .nd1 (stp k S (2 * k)) := by
  refine step_of (stp_bd (by omega) hS hp) ?_
  regs [astep_clr (show A .node = _ from rfl)]
  refine cont (st' := stp k S 0) rfl ?_
  refine (cp_run .ndA _ (stp_bd (by omega) hS (by omega)) rfl
    (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; simp [stp]; omega)).trans ?_
  regs [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit]
  refine cont (st' := stp k S k) (by sext [stp]) ?_
  refine (cp_run .ndB _ (stp_bd (by omega) hS (by omega)) rfl
    (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; simp [stp]; omega)).trans ?_
  regs [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit]
  exact fin_of (by sext [stp])

/-- **A push**: from `push b` at depth `k` with stack `S` (any pointer), the machine reaches
`node` at depth `k + 1` with stack `2S + b`.

**Proof sketch.** Straight-line code: clear `P`; the doubled move (`dm_run`) gives `T = 2S`,
`S = 0`; the move back (`mv_run`) gives `S = 2S`, `T = 0`; for `b = 1` increment `S`; then
increment `K`. Each step keeps the registers below `B` (`stp_bd`). -/
theorem push_run (b : Bool) (k S p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ B) (hS : 2 * S + 1 ≤ B) (hk : k + 1 ≤ B) :
    Run x B (.push b) (stp k S p) .node (stp (k + 1) (2 * S + b.toNat) 0) := by
  refine step_of (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) hp) ?_
  regs [astep_clr (show A (.push b) = _ from rfl)]
  refine cont (st' := stp k S 0) rfl ?_
  refine (dm_run b _ (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) (by simp [stp]; omega)).trans ?_
  refine cont (st' := ⟨k, 0, 0, 2 * S, 0, 0, 0⟩) (by sext [stp]) ?_
  refine (mv_run b _ (by simp only [St.Bd]; omega) (by simp; omega)).trans ?_
  refine cont (st' := ⟨k, 2 * S, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0⟩) (by sext) ?_
  cases b
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine step_of (by simp only [St.Bd]; omega) ?_
    regs [astep_inc (show A .incK = _ from rfl)]
    exact fin_of (by sext [stp])
  · simp only [if_true]
    refine step_of (by simp only [St.Bd]; omega) ?_
    regs [astep_inc (show A .incS = _ from rfl)]
    refine step_of (by simp only [St.Bd]; omega) ?_
    regs [astep_inc (show A .incK = _ from rfl)]
    exact fin_of (by sext [stp])

/-- **A pop**: from `rt v` at depth `k + 1` with stack `2S + b`, the machine returns to depth
`k` with stack `S`, at `rt v` after a second child (`b = 1`) and at the quantifier lookup after
a first child.

**Proof sketch.** Straight-line code: `K = k + 1 ≠ 0`, so `rt v` decrements `K`; the parity
test of `S = 2S + b` branches on `b`, and both branches halve `S` (`(2S + b) / 2 = S`), going
on to `rt v` (`b = 1`) or to the quantifier lookup (`b = 0`). -/
theorem pop_run (v b : Bool) (k S : ℕ) (hk : k + 1 ≤ B) (hS : 2 * S + 1 ≤ B) :
    Run x B (.rt v) (stp (k + 1) (2 * S + b.toNat) 0) (cond b (.rt v) (.cp (.qA v) 0))
      (stp k S 0) := by
  have hb : b.toNat ≤ 1 := Bool.toNat_le b
  refine step_of (stp_bd hk (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
  regs [astep_jz (show A (.rt v) = _ from rfl)]
  simp only [stp, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false]
  refine step_of (stp_bd hk (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
  regs [astep_dec (show A (.pop v) = _ from rfl)]
  refine cont (st' := stp k (2 * S + b.toNat) 0) (by sext [stp]) ?_
  refine step_of (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
  regs [astep_jodd (show A (.par v) = _ from rfl)]
  have h2 : (2 * S + b.toNat) / 2 = S := by omega
  cases b
  · simp only [stp, Bool.toNat_false, add_zero, Nat.mul_mod_right, zero_ne_one, if_false]
    refine step_of (stp_bd (B := B) (k := k) (S := 2 * S) (p := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
      (by omega)) ?_
    regs [astep_half (show A (.popF v) = _ from rfl)]
    exact fin_of (by sext [stp])
  · simp only [stp, Bool.toNat_true, Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.one_mod, if_true]
    refine step_of (stp_bd (B := B) (k := k) (S := 2 * S + 1) (p := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
      (by omega)) ?_
    regs [astep_half (show A (.popT v) = _ from rfl)]
    exact fin_of (by sext [stp])

/-- **The quantifier lookup**: from `cp (qA v) 0` at depth `k`, the machine sets `P := 2K` and
reaches `qr v`. -/
theorem qlook_run (v : Bool) (k S : ℕ) (hk : 2 * k ≤ B) (hS : S ≤ B) :
    Run x B (.cp (.qA v) 0) (stp k S 0) (.qr v) (stp k S (2 * k)) := by
  refine (cp_run (.qA v) _ (stp_bd (by omega) hS (by omega)) rfl
    (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; simp [stp]; omega)).trans ?_
  regs [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit]
  refine cont (st' := stp k S k) (by sext [stp]) ?_
  refine (cp_run (.qB v) _ (stp_bd (by omega) hS (by omega)) rfl
    (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; simp [stp]; omega)).trans ?_
  regs [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit]
  exact fin_of (by sext [stp])

variable (x B qs φ) in
open Classical in
/-- **The walk is correct at depth `k`**: from `node` at depth `k` with any stack `S` below
`2 ^ (k + 1)`, the machine reaches `rt v` with the same registers, `v` the value
`Val qs φ k S`. -/
def CallOK (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ S, S < 2 ^ (k + 1) →
    Run x B .node (stp k S 0) (.rt (decide (Val qs φ k S))) (stp k S 0)

open Classical in
/-- **A leaf**: at depth `|qs|` the walk returns the value of the matrix.

**Proof sketch.** The pair at `2K` is the separator: bit `2K` is `0`, bit `2K + 1` is `1`;
the matrix starts at `2K + 2` (`formula_run`), and `val_leaf` identifies its value. -/
theorem leaf_spec (hx : x = pairEncode qs (CNF.serialize φ)) (hB1 : 2 ^ (qs.length + 1) ≤ B)
    (hB2 : x.length ≤ B) : CallOK x B qs φ qs.length := by
  intro S hS
  have hlen := length_enc hx
  set M := qs.length with hM
  refine (node_run M S 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)).trans ?_
  refine read_f (l := .nd1) rfl (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
    (by show x.getD (2 * M) false = false; rw [getD_enc hx, ← hM]; simp) ?_
  refine step_of (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
  regs [astep_inc (show A .nd2 = _ from rfl)]
  refine cont (st' := stp M S (2 * M + 1)) rfl ?_
  refine read_t (l := .nd3) rfl (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
    (by show x.getD (2 * M + 1) false = true; rw [getD_enc hx, ← hM]; simp) ?_
  refine step_of (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
  regs [astep_inc (show A .leaf = _ from rfl)]
  refine cont (st' := stp M S (2 * M + 2)) rfl ?_
  have hd : x.drop (stp M S (2 * M + 2)).P = CNF.serialize φ ++ [] := by
    rw [hx]; simp [stp, pairEncode_eq_dbl, List.drop_append, hM]
  have := formula_run [] φ (stp M S (2 * M + 2)) hd (stp_bd (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
    hB2 rfl rfl rfl rfl
  have hv : decide (Val qs φ M S) = CNF.eval (asg M S) φ := by
    rw [hM, Bool.eq_iff_iff, decide_eq_true_iff, val_leaf]
  rw [hv]
  exact reach_of_eq this (by congr 3)

end Walk

end TQBFARM

end Complexity.LogProg
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/Randomized/SpaceAmplifyPolyRun.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 The TCSlib Authors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: TCSlib Contributors
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.SpaceAmplifyPolyMachine

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The repetition machine simulates its runs

The probabilistic semantics of the main loop of `Randomized.PolyAmp.ampA` [AB09, §7.7,
p. 139]. A run moves the code of `N`'s configuration along `K` coins: each coin picks the least
or the greatest step partner of the current code, which are the codes of the two successors,
so the probability that the run ends accepting is `Randomized.PolyAmp.accP` of the start after
`K` coins (`Randomized.PolyAmp.ps_steps`). The runs are independent, and the loop over them has
the semantics `Randomized.PolyAmp.runVal`: the probability that the decision rule holds of the
number of accepting runs among independent blocks of `K` coins (`Randomized.PolyAmp.ps_runs`).

## Main definitions

* `Randomized.PolyAmp.mk` — the register file of the main loop.
* `Randomized.PolyAmp.decRule`, `Randomized.PolyAmp.runVal` — the decision and its
  probability.

## Main results

* `Randomized.PolyAmp.ps_steps` — one run, coin by coin.
* `Randomized.PolyAmp.ps_runs` — the loop over the runs.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009.
-/

namespace Randomized.PolyAmp

open Complexity Complexity.LogProg Complexity.Codec Turing

variable {cS F : ℕ} {N : FinNDTM Bool} {os : Bool} {x : List Bool} {B : ℕ}

/-- The register file of the main loop: input length `n`, `ℓ`, radius `S`, `K`, `K + 1` runs;
`i` runs left, `cnt` accepting runs, current code `c`, candidate `d`, `j` coins left. -/
def mk (n ℓ S K i cnt c d j : ℕ) : Reg := ⟨n, ℓ, S, 0, K, K + 1, i, cnt, c, d, j, 0, 0, 0, 0⟩

/-- A copy site: `dst := dst + src` (scratch clear), then the exit. -/
lemma ps_cp (k : CpS) {σ σ' : Reg} {p : ℚ} (hσ : σ.Le B) (hz : σ.z = 0)
    (hb : σ.v (cpDst k) + σ.v (cpSrc k) ≤ B)
    (he : σ'.v = Function.update σ.v (cpDst k) (σ.v (cpDst k) + σ.v (cpSrc k)))
    (hK : PS N os x B (cpEx k : Lab cS F) σ' p) : PS N os x B (.cp0 k : Lab cS F) σ p := by
  have hr := copy_run (A := (ampA cS F os).detPart false) (oracle := ampOr N) (x := x) (B := B)
    (l := .cp0 k) (l1 := .cp1 k) (l2 := .cp2 k) (l3 := .cp3 k) (l4 := .cp4 k) (l5 := .cp5 k)
    (l6 := .cp6 k) (lx := cpEx k) (src := cpSrc k) (dst := cpDst k) (z := 11)
    (by cases k <;> decide) (by cases k <;> decide) (by cases k <;> decide)
    rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl σ.v hz (Reg.le_v hσ) hb
  exact PSem.of_reach (AReach.mono hr fun _ h => h.2) (he ▸ hK)

/-! ### The oracle on the main loop -/

/-- The initial-code decider. -/
theorem ampOr_init (S c : ℕ) :
    ampOr N 1 (pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits S))) =
      decide (c = cfgCode S (N.tm.initCfg x)) := by
  rw [ampOr, indicator_eq_decide]
  exact decide_eq_decide.mpr (mem_initLang_iff S c)

/-- The step decider at a reachable code. -/
theorem ampOr_step {S : ℕ} {sp : ℕ → ℕ} (hN : N.UsesSpace sp) (hs : sp x.length ≤ S)
    {C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x} (hC : Reach C) (c' : ℕ) :
    ampOr N 2 (pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits (cfgCode S C))
      (pairEncode (Nat.bits c') (Nat.bits S)))) =
      decide (c' = cfgCode S (N.tm.stepWith true C) ∨ c' = cfgCode S (N.tm.stepWith false C)) := by
  rw [ampOr, indicator_eq_decide]
  refine decide_eq_decide.mpr ((mem_stepLang_iff hN hs hC c').trans ?_)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩; cases b <;> simp
  · rintro (h | h) <;> exact ⟨_, h⟩

/-- The accepting-code decider at a reachable code. -/
theorem ampOr_accept {S : ℕ} {sp : ℕ → ℕ} (hN : N.UsesSpace sp) (hs : sp x.length ≤ S)
    {C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x} (hC : Reach C) :
    ampOr N 3 (pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits (cfgCode S C)) (Nat.bits S))) =
      decide (Accepting C) := by
  rw [ampOr, indicator_eq_decide]
  exact decide_eq_decide.mpr (mem_acceptLang_iff hN hs hC)

/-! ### One run -/

section Run

variable {n ℓ S K : ℕ}

/-- The fields of `mk` are bounded when the run counters and codes are. -/
lemma mk_le {i cnt c d j : ℕ} (hB : n + ℓ + S + 2 * K + 2 ≤ B) (hi : i ≤ K + 1)
    (hc : cnt ≤ K + 1) (hcc : c ≤ K) (hd : d ≤ K) (hj : j ≤ K) :
    (mk n ℓ S K i cnt c d j).Le B := by
  simp only [Reg.Le, mk]; omega

/-- **A coin of the run**: from the code of a reachable configuration `C` with `j` coins
left, the run ends accepting with probability `accP C j`; the continuations `A1` (accepting)
and `A0` are weighted accordingly.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `j`. With no coin left the acceptance check asks the accepting
code decider (`ampOr_accept`). Otherwise the coin selects the upward search, which stops at
the least step partner, or the downward search from `K`, which stops at the greatest
(`searchUp_run`, `searchDown_run`, `ampOr_step`); these are the codes of the two successors
(below `K` by `cfgCode_lt_codeBound`), so averaging the induction hypotheses at the two
successors gives `accP_succ`. -/
theorem ps_steps {sp : ℕ → ℕ} (hN : N.UsesSpace sp) (hs : sp x.length ≤ S)
    (hK : codeBound N x.length S ≤ K) (hB : n + ℓ + S + 2 * K + 2 ≤ B) {i cnt : ℕ}
    (hi : i ≤ K + 1) (hcnt : cnt + 1 ≤ K + 1) {A1 A0 : ℚ}
    (h1 : ∀ c d, c ≤ K → d ≤ K → PS N os x B (.rT : Lab cS F) (mk n ℓ S K i (cnt + 1) c d 0) A1)
    (h0 : ∀ c d, c ≤ K → d ≤ K → PS N os x B (.rT : Lab cS F) (mk n ℓ S K i cnt c d 0) A0) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x) (d : ℕ), j ≤ K → Reach C → d ≤ K →
      PS N os x B (.sT : Lab cS F) (mk n ℓ S K i cnt (cfgCode S C) d j)
        (accP C j * A1 + (1 - accP C j) * A0) := by
  have hlt : ∀ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, cfgCode S C < K :=
    fun C => (cfgCode_lt_codeBound S C).trans_le hK
  have hle : ∀ {i' cnt' c d j}, i' ≤ K + 1 → cnt' ≤ K + 1 → c ≤ K → d ≤ K → j ≤ K →
      RegLe 15 (Lab cS F) B (none, (mk n ℓ S K i' cnt' c d j).v, none) :=
    fun a b c d e => Reg.le_v (mk_le hB a b c d e)
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro C d _ hC hd
    refine PSem.jz_pos (A := ampA cS F os) rfl (hle hi (by omega) (hlt C).le hd (by omega)) rfl ?_
    refine PSem.call (A := ampA cS F os) rfl (hle hi (by omega) (hlt C).le hd (by omega)) ?_
    rw [vword_whole₂]
    simp only [Reg.v_8, Reg.v_2, mk]
    simp only [ampOr_accept hN hs hC, accP_zero]
    by_cases hacc : Accepting C
    · simp only [hacc, decide_true, ↓reduceIte]
      refine PSem.inc (A := ampA cS F os) rfl (hle hi (by omega) (hlt C).le hd (by omega)) ?_
      simp only [Reg.v_7, Reg.u_7]
      exact (h1 _ _ (hlt C).le hd).congr (by ring)
    · simp only [hacc, decide_false, ↓reduceIte, Bool.false_eq_true]
      exact (h0 _ _ (hlt C).le hd).congr (by ring)
  | succ j ih =>
    intro C d hj hC hd
    obtain ⟨ct, hct_def⟩ : ∃ y, y = cfgCode S (N.tm.stepWith true C) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨cf, hcf_def⟩ : ∃ y, y = cfgCode S (N.tm.stepWith false C) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hct : ct < K := hct_def ▸ hlt (N.tm.stepWith true C)
    have hcf : cf < K := hcf_def ▸ hlt (N.tm.stepWith false C)
    have hCK := (hlt C).le
    set σ := mk n ℓ S K i cnt (cfgCode S C) d j with hσ
    have hσB : σ.Le B := mk_le hB hi (by omega) hCK hd (by omega)
    -- after the move, the run continues from the chosen successor
    have hmv : ∀ C' : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, Reach C' →
        PS N os x B (.mv : Lab cS F) (mk n ℓ S K i cnt (cfgCode S C) (cfgCode S C') j)
          (accP C' j * A1 + (1 - accP C' j) * A0) := by
      intro C' hC'
      have hC'K := (hlt C').le
      refine PSem.clr (A := ampA cS F os) rfl (Reg.le_v (mk_le hB hi (by omega) hCK hC'K
        (by omega))) ?_
      simp only [Reg.u_8]
      refine ps_cp .cc (σ' := mk n ℓ S K i cnt (cfgCode S C') (cfgCode S C') j)
        (by simp only [Reg.Le, mk]; omega) rfl (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, mk]; omega)
        (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, mk]) ?_
      exact ih C' _ (by omega) hC' hC'K
    have hcall : ∀ (l₁ l₀ : Lab cS F) (c' : ℕ),
        astep ((ampA cS F os).detPart false) (ampOr N) x
            (some (.uT : Lab cS F), Function.update σ.v 9 c', none) =
          (some (if c' = ct ∨ c' = cf then .mv else .uI), Function.update σ.v 9 c', none) ∧
        astep ((ampA cS F os).detPart false) (ampOr N) x
            (some (.dT : Lab cS F), Function.update σ.v 9 c', none) =
          (some (if c' = ct ∨ c' = cf then .mv else .dD), Function.update σ.v 9 c', none) := by
      intro _ _ c'
      have h := ampOr_step hN hs hC c'
      rw [← hct_def, ← hcf_def] at h
      constructor <;>
      · simp [astep_call (show (ampA cS F os).detPart false .uT = _ from rfl),
          astep_call (show (ampA cS F os).detPart false .dT = _ from rfl), vword_whole₃, hσ, mk,
          h]
    have hpre : ∀ (l : Lab cS F), (l = .uT ∨ l = .dT) → ∀ w : Fin 15 → ℕ,
        PreS ((ampA cS F os).detPart false) x (some l, w, none) := by
      rintro l (rfl | rfl) w <;> simp [PreS, NARM.detPart, ampA]
    -- the upward search stops at the least successor code
    have hup : PS N os x B (.up : Lab cS F) σ
        (accP (if ct ≤ cf then N.tm.stepWith true C else N.tm.stepWith false C) j * A1 +
          (1 - accP (if ct ≤ cf then N.tm.stepWith true C else N.tm.stepWith false C) j) * A0) := by
      refine PSem.clr (A := ampA cS F os) rfl (Reg.le_v hσB) ?_
      have hr := searchUp_run (x := x) ((ampA cS F os).detPart false) (ampOr N) 9
        (fun c' => c' = ct ∨ c' = cf) .uT .uI .mv B σ.v (Reg.le_v hσB)
        (fun c' => (hcall .mv .uI c').1) (hpre .uT (Or.inl rfl)) rfl (min ct cf)
        (by rcases le_total ct cf with h | h <;> simp [h]) (by omega) 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
        (fun c' _ h => by omega)
      refine PSem.of_reach (AReach.mono hr fun _ h => h.2) ?_
      have e : Function.update σ.v 9 (min ct cf) =
          (mk n ℓ S K i cnt (cfgCode S C) (cfgCode S (if ct ≤ cf then N.tm.stepWith true C
            else N.tm.stepWith false C)) j).v := by
        rw [Reg.u_9]
        split_ifs with h
        · rw [min_eq_left h]; simp [hσ, mk, hct_def]
        · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge h)]; simp [hσ, mk, hcf_def]
      rw [e]
      exact hmv _ (by split_ifs <;> exact hC.step _)
    -- the downward search from `K` stops at the greatest successor code
    have hdn : PS N os x B (.dn : Lab cS F) σ
        (accP (if ct ≤ cf then N.tm.stepWith false C else N.tm.stepWith true C) j * A1 +
          (1 - accP (if ct ≤ cf then N.tm.stepWith false C else N.tm.stepWith true C) j) * A0) := by
      refine PSem.clr (A := ampA cS F os) rfl (Reg.le_v hσB) ?_
      simp only [Reg.u_9]
      refine ps_cp .kc (σ' := mk n ℓ S K i cnt (cfgCode S C) K j)
        (by simp only [Reg.Le, hσ, mk]; omega) rfl (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hσ, mk]; omega)
        (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hσ, mk]) ?_
      have hr := searchDown_run (x := x) ((ampA cS F os).detPart false) (ampOr N) 9
        (fun c' => c' = ct ∨ c' = cf) .dD .dT .mv B σ.v (Reg.le_v hσB)
        (fun c' => (hcall .mv .dD c').2) (hpre .dT (Or.inr rfl)) rfl (max ct cf)
        (by rcases le_total ct cf with h | h <;> simp [h]) K (by omega) (by omega)
        (fun c' h1 h2 => by omega)
      have e0 : Function.update σ.v 9 K = (mk n ℓ S K i cnt (cfgCode S C) K j).v := by
        rw [Reg.u_9]; simp [hσ, mk]
      rw [e0] at hr
      refine PSem.of_reach (AReach.mono hr fun _ h => h.2) ?_
      have e : Function.update σ.v 9 (max ct cf) =
          (mk n ℓ S K i cnt (cfgCode S C) (cfgCode S (if ct ≤ cf then N.tm.stepWith false C
            else N.tm.stepWith true C)) j).v := by
        rw [Reg.u_9]
        split_ifs with h
        · rw [max_eq_right h]; simp [hσ, mk, hcf_def]
        · rw [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge h)]; simp [hσ, mk, hct_def]
      rw [e]
      exact hmv _ (by split_ifs <;> exact hC.step _)
    have hG1 := Reg.le_v (mk_le (n := n) (ℓ := ℓ) (S := S) (K := K) (i := i) (cnt := cnt)
      (c := cfgCode S C) (d := d) (j := j + 1) hB hi (by omega) hCK hd hj)
    refine PSem.jz_neg (A := ampA cS F os) rfl (fun r => hG1 r) (by simp [mk]) ?_
    refine PSem.dec (A := ampA cS F os) rfl (fun r => hG1 r) ?_
    have e : Function.update (mk n ℓ S K i cnt (cfgCode S C) d (j + 1)).v 10
        ((mk n ℓ S K i cnt (cfgCode S C) d (j + 1)).v 10 - 1) = σ.v := by
      rw [Reg.u_10]; rfl
    rw [e]
    refine (PSem.choose (A := ampA cS F os) rfl (Reg.le_v hσB) hup hdn).congr ?_
    rw [accP_succ]
    split_ifs <;> ring

end Run

/-! ### The runs -/

/-- The acceptance bit of a block of coins: the run of `N` on it ends accepting. -/
def accBit (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (l : List Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (Accepting (N.tm.runWith l (N.tm.initCfg x)))

/-- The decision on the number `m` of accepting runs out of `K + 1`: some run accepted
(one-sided), or a strict majority (two-sided). -/
def decRule (os : Bool) (K m : ℕ) : Bool := if os then decide (1 ≤ m) else decide (K + 1 < 2 * m)

/-- The probability that the decision holds of `cnt` plus the number of accepting blocks among
`i` independent blocks of `K` coins. -/
noncomputable def runVal (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (os : Bool) (K i cnt : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  randProb (i * K) fun w => decRule os K (cnt + blockCount K i (accBit N x) w) = true

/-- With no block left the decision is on `cnt`. -/
theorem runVal_zero (K cnt : ℕ) :
    runVal N x os K 0 cnt = if decRule os K cnt then 1 else 0 := by
  unfold runVal
  rw [zero_mul, ← randProb_const 0 (decRule os K cnt = true)]
  refine randProb_congr fun r => ?_
  simp [blockCount]

/-- One more block: the first block accepts with probability `accP` of the start.

**Proof sketch.** Split the coins into the first block and the rest (`blockCount_succ`): the
event is the disjoint union of "the first block accepts and the rest decides from `cnt + 1`"
and "the first block rejects and the rest decides from `cnt`"; each part factors
(`randProb_split`). -/
theorem runVal_succ (K i cnt : ℕ) :
    runVal N x os K (i + 1) cnt =
      accP (N.tm.initCfg x) K * runVal N x os K i (cnt + 1) +
        (1 - accP (N.tm.initCfg x) K) * runVal N x os K i cnt := by
  have hp : accP (N.tm.initCfg x) K = randProb K (fun l => accBit N x l = true) :=
    randProb_congr fun r => by simp [accBit]
  unfold runVal
  rw [hp, show (i + 1) * K = K + i * K by ring]
  have hev : randProb (K + i * K)
      (fun l => decRule os K (cnt + blockCount K (i + 1) (accBit N x) l) = true) =
      randProb (K + i * K) (fun l =>
        ((fun l' => accBit N x l' = true) (l.take K) ∧
          (fun w => decRule os K (cnt + 1 + blockCount K i (accBit N x) w) = true) (l.drop K)) ∨
        ((fun l' => accBit N x l' = false) (l.take K) ∧
          (fun w => decRule os K (cnt + blockCount K i (accBit N x) w) = true) (l.drop K))) :=
    randProb_congr fun r => by
      rw [blockCount_succ]
      rcases hb : accBit N x ((List.ofFn r).take K) <;> simp [hb, Nat.add_assoc]
  rw [hev, randProb_or_disjoint _ _ (fun r => by
      rintro ⟨⟨h1, -⟩, h2, -⟩
      rw [h1] at h2
      exact absurd h2 (by simp)),
    randProb_split K (i * K) (fun l' => accBit N x l' = true)
      (fun w => decRule os K (cnt + 1 + blockCount K i (accBit N x) w) = true),
    randProb_split K (i * K) (fun l' => accBit N x l' = false)
      (fun w => decRule os K (cnt + blockCount K i (accBit N x) w) = true), randProb_bool_false]

section Loop

variable {n ℓ S K : ℕ}

/-- **The decision**: from `fin` with `cnt` accepting runs, the machine answers `decRule`.

**Proof sketch.** One-sided: a zero test of the count. Two-sided: an add-twice loop puts `2 cnt`
into register `14` (`psem_addTwice`), and the comparison loop `Complexity.Codec.le_loop`
tests `2 cnt ≤ K + 1`. -/
theorem ps_fin (hB : n + ℓ + S + 2 * K + 2 ≤ B) {cnt c d : ℕ} (hcnt : cnt ≤ K + 1)
    (hc : c ≤ K) (hd : d ≤ K) :
    PS N os x B (.fin : Lab cS F) (mk n ℓ S K 0 cnt c d 0)
      (if decRule os K cnt then 1 else 0) := by
  have hσ := mk_le (n := n) (ℓ := ℓ) (S := S) (K := K) (B := B) hB (Nat.zero_le _) hcnt hc hd
    (Nat.zero_le _) (i := 0) (j := 0)
  cases os with
  | true =>
    by_cases h0 : cnt = 0
    · subst h0
      refine PSem.jz_pos (A := ampA cS F true) rfl (Reg.le_v hσ) rfl ?_
      exact (PSem.rej (A := ampA cS F true) rfl (Reg.le_v hσ)).congr (by simp [decRule])
    · refine PSem.jz_neg (A := ampA cS F true) rfl (Reg.le_v hσ) (by simpa [mk] using h0) ?_
      exact (PSem.acc (A := ampA cS F true) rfl (Reg.le_v hσ)).congr
        (by simp [decRule]; omega)
  | false =>
    refine psem_addTwice (ampA cS F false) (ampOr N) x B 12 7 14 (by decide) (by decide)
      (by decide) .fin .ad1 .ad2 .ad3 .fC rfl rfl rfl rfl _ _ (Reg.le_v hσ) (by simp [mk])
      (by simp [mk]; omega) ?_
    simp only [Reg.v_14, Reg.v_7, Reg.v_12, Reg.u_14, Reg.u_12, mk]
    set σ : Reg := ⟨n, ℓ, S, 0, K, K + 1, 0, cnt, c, d, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2 * cnt⟩ with hσ'
    have hσB : σ.Le B := by simp only [Reg.Le, hσ']; omega
    have e1 : ({ ({ (mk n ℓ S K 0 cnt c d 0) with w := 0 + 2 * (cnt - 0) } : Reg) with t := cnt } :
        Reg) = { σ with t := cnt } := by simp [hσ', mk]
    simp only [mk] at e1
    rw [e1]
    refine PSem.clr (A := ampA cS F false) rfl (Reg.le_v (by simp only [Reg.Le, hσ']; omega)) ?_
    simp only [Reg.u_12]
    have e2 : ({ ({ σ with t := cnt } : Reg) with t := 0 } : Reg) = σ := rfl
    rw [e2]
    have hr := Codec.le_loop ((ampA cS F false).detPart false) (ampOr N) x 12 14 5 (by decide)
      (by decide) .lt1 .lt2 .ltb .rej .acc rfl rfl rfl B σ.v (Reg.le_v hσB) (by simp [hσ'])
      (by simp [hσ'])
    refine PSem.of_reach (AReach.mono hr fun _ h => h.2) ?_
    have hv : ∀ r, Function.update σ.v 12 (min (σ.v 14) (σ.v 5)) r ≤ B :=
      register_update_le σ.v 12 B _ (Reg.le_v hσB) (by simp [hσ']; omega)
    by_cases hle : 2 * cnt ≤ K + 1
    · rw [if_pos (by simpa [hσ'] using hle)]
      exact (PSem.rej (A := ampA cS F false) rfl hv).congr (by simp [decRule]; omega)
    · rw [if_neg (by simpa [hσ'] using hle)]
      exact (PSem.acc (A := ampA cS F false) rfl hv).congr (by simp [decRule]; omega)

/-- **The loop over the runs**: from `rT` with `i` runs left and `cnt` accepting runs, the
answer is `true` with probability `runVal i cnt`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `i`. With no run left, `ps_fin`. Otherwise the run searches the
initial code (`searchUp_run`, `ampOr_init`), copies `K` into the coin counter, and runs
(`ps_steps` from the start, with the induction hypothesis as continuations); `runVal_succ`
recombines. -/
theorem ps_runs {sp : ℕ → ℕ} (hN : N.UsesSpace sp) (hs : sp x.length ≤ S)
    (hK : codeBound N x.length S ≤ K) (hB : n + ℓ + S + 2 * K + 2 ≤ B) :
    ∀ (i cnt c d : ℕ), cnt + i ≤ K + 1 → c ≤ K → d ≤ K →
      PS N os x B (.rT : Lab cS F) (mk n ℓ S K i cnt c d 0) (runVal N x os K i cnt) := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro cnt c d hcnt hc hd
    have hσ := mk_le (n := n) (ℓ := ℓ) (S := S) (K := K) (B := B) hB (Nat.zero_le _)
      (by omega) hc hd (Nat.zero_le _) (i := 0) (cnt := cnt) (j := 0)
    refine PSem.jz_pos (A := ampA cS F os) rfl (Reg.le_v hσ) rfl ?_
    rw [runVal_zero]
    exact ps_fin hB (by omega) hc hd
  | succ i ih =>
    intro cnt c d hcnt hc hd
    have hσ := mk_le (n := n) (ℓ := ℓ) (S := S) (K := K) (B := B) hB (by omega)
      (by omega) hc hd (Nat.zero_le _) (i := i + 1) (cnt := cnt) (j := 0)
    refine PSem.jz_neg (A := ampA cS F os) rfl (Reg.le_v hσ) (by simp [mk]) ?_
    refine PSem.dec (A := ampA cS F os) rfl (Reg.le_v hσ) ?_
    have e : Function.update (mk n ℓ S K (i + 1) cnt c d 0).v 6
        ((mk n ℓ S K (i + 1) cnt c d 0).v 6 - 1) = (mk n ℓ S K i cnt c d 0).v := by
      rw [Reg.u_6]; rfl
    rw [e]
    have hσi := mk_le (n := n) (ℓ := ℓ) (S := S) (K := K) (B := B) hB (by omega)
      (by omega) hc hd (Nat.zero_le _) (i := i) (cnt := cnt) (j := 0)
    refine PSem.clr (A := ampA cS F os) rfl (Reg.le_v hσi) ?_
    -- the initial-code search
    obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀_def⟩ : ∃ y, y = cfgCode S (N.tm.initCfg x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hc₀ : c₀ < K := hc₀_def ▸ (cfgCode_lt_codeBound S _).trans_le hK
    have hr := searchUp_run (x := x) ((ampA cS F os).detPart false) (ampOr N) 8 (fun c' => c' = c₀)
      .iT .iI (.cp0 .kj) B (mk n ℓ S K i cnt c d 0).v (Reg.le_v hσi)
      (fun c' => by
        have h := ampOr_init (N := N) (x := x) S c'
        rw [← hc₀_def] at h
        simp [astep_call (show (ampA cS F os).detPart false .iT = _ from rfl), vword_whole₂,
          mk, h])
      (fun w => by simp [PreS, NARM.detPart, ampA]) rfl c₀ rfl (by omega) 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
      (fun c' _ h => by omega)
    refine PSem.of_reach (AReach.mono hr fun _ h => h.2) ?_
    rw [Reg.u_8]
    refine ps_cp .kj (σ' := mk n ℓ S K i cnt c₀ d K) (by simp only [Reg.Le, mk]; omega) rfl
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, mk]; omega) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, mk]) ?_
    have hrun := ps_steps (cS := cS) (F := F) (os := os) hN hs hK hB (i := i) (cnt := cnt)
      (by omega) (by omega)
      (fun c' d' hc' hd' => ih (cnt + 1) c' d' (by omega) hc' hd')
      (fun c' d' hc' hd' => ih cnt c' d' (by omega) hc' hd') K (N.tm.initCfg x) d le_rfl
      reach_init hd
    rw [runVal_succ, hc₀_def]
    exact hrun

end Loop

end Randomized.PolyAmp
```

```
/-
