import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Layout

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The step machine lays out the second code word and reads the input symbol

Two phases of the codec machine `Complexity.Codec.CA` in mode `step`: the layout of the second
code word `w'` (its chunk-region end `E₂`, its position-field end `F₂`, the length and
final-letter checks, the decoded input position), and the read of the input symbol under the
first word's input head into the register `rZ` (`0` for a blank, `1` for `0`, `2` for `1`),
followed by the pointer copies of the double sliding scan.

Logspace machine infrastructure for the codec; not a result of [AB09].

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.Codec.lay2R` — the register file after the second layout.
* `Complexity.Codec.zcode` — the register code of an input symbol.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Codec.layout2_run` — the layout of the second code word.
* `Complexity.Codec.insym_run` — the input-symbol read and the scan pointers.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Codec

open Turing LogProg

variable {N : FinNDTM Bool}

/-- Letters of the second code word inside a step input. -/
lemma getD_w2 (x w w' rest : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < w'.length) :
    (pairEncode x (pairEncode w (pairEncode w' rest))).getD
      (2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 + 2 * i) false = w'.getD i false := by
  rw [show 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 + 2 * i = 2 * x.length + 2 + (2 * w.length + 2 + 2 * i)
    by ring, pe_getD_snd, pe_getD_snd, pe_getD_fst _ _ _ hi]

variable (N) in
/-- The register file after the layout of the second code word. -/
def lay2R (R : Regs) (b s wp pos : ℕ) : Regs :=
  { R with
    E2 := b + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N, F2 := b + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N + 2 * wp,
    U := b + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N + 2 * wp + 4, Q1 := b + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N,
    Pos2 := pos, T := 0 }

/-- **The layout of the second code word**: as `layout_run`, for `w'` starting at `rB`,
reusing `wP |x|` from `rWp`; the length check compares `F₂ + 4` with the start `rP` of the
radius field. The machine rejects exactly when `w'` has the wrong length or final letter, and
otherwise reaches the input-symbol read with the decoded position of `w'` in `rPos2`.

**Proof sketch.** The loop sequence of `layout_run` from the scale of the radius on, with
letters of `w'` at `b + 2i` (`getD_w2`). -/
theorem layout2_run (y x w w' rest : List Bool)
    (hy : y = pairEncode x (pairEncode w (pairEncode w' rest)))
    (R : Regs) (s : ℕ) (hBd : R.Bd (bnd N y)) (hB : R.B = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4)
    (hP : R.P = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6) (hS : R.S = s)
    (hs : s ≤ 2 * y.length) (hWp : R.Wp = wP x.length) (hE2 : R.E2 = 0) (hF2 : R.F2 = 0)
    (hT : R.T = 0) (hPos2 : R.Pos2 = 0) :
    (w'.length = W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length + 1 ∧
      w'.getD (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length) false = true ∧
      Reach N .step y (bnd N y) (.cp .E2) R.val .inZ
        (lay2R N R (2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4) s (wP x.length)
          (bitsVal ((w'.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP x.length)))).val) ∨
    (¬ (w'.length = W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length + 1 ∧
      w'.getD (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length) false = true) ∧
      AHalt (CA N .step) orc y (GuardLe (CA N .step) y (bnd N y)) (some (.cp .E2), R.val, none)
        false) := by
  set B := bnd N y
  set n := x.length
  set b := 2 * n + 2 * w.length + 4
  set e := b + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N
  set f := e + 2 * wP n
  have hyl : y.length = b + 2 * w'.length + 2 + rest.length := by
    rw [hy, length_pairEncode, length_pairEncode, length_pairEncode]; simp only [b, n]; ring
  have hbig := bnd_ge (N := N) y s hs
  have hwP := wP_le n
  have he2 : e = b + 2 * W N * (2 * s + 1) := by simp only [e]; ring
  have hB0 := hBd
  simp only [Regs.Bd] at hB0
  have r5 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .E2) R.val (.cp .Ts2) ({R with E2 := b} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .E2 _ hBd.val_le (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hE2]))
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hB, b])
  have r6 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .Ts2) ({R with E2 := b} : Regs).val (.sc .E2)
      ({R with E2 := b, T := s} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Ts2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hT])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hS])
  have r7 : Reach N .step y B (.sc .E2) ({R with E2 := b, T := s} : Regs).val (icL N .E2 0)
      ({R with E2 := b + 4 * W N * s, T := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (sc_run y B .E2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor]; omega)) (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor])
  have r8 : Reach N .step y B (icL N .E2 0) ({R with E2 := b + 4 * W N * s, T := 0} : Regs).val
      (.cp .F2) ({R with E2 := e, T := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (ic_run y B .E2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [icReg, icCount]; omega)) (by simp [icReg, icCount, e])
  have r9 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .F2) ({R with E2 := e, T := 0} : Regs).val (.cp .Tw2)
      ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := e} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .F2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hF2])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
  have r10 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .Tw2) ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := e} : Regs).val (.sc .F2)
      ({R with E2 := e, T := wP n, F2 := e} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Tw2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hWp])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hWp])
  have r11 : Reach N .step y B (.sc .F2) ({R with E2 := e, T := wP n, F2 := e} : Regs).val .clrU2
      ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (sc_run y B .F2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor]; omega)) (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor, f])
  have r12 : Reach N .step y B .clrU2 ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f} : Regs).val (.cp .U2)
      ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f, U := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep_clr (show CA N .step .clrU2 = _ from rfl)])
  have r13 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .U2) ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f, U := 0} : Regs).val
      (icL N .U2 0) ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f, U := f} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .U2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
  have r14 : Reach N .step y B (icL N .U2 0) ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f, U := f} : Regs).val
      .lenChk2 ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f, U := f + 4} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (ic_run y B .U2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [icReg, icCount]; omega)) (by simp [icReg, icCount])
  have r5_14 := r5.trans (r6.trans (r7.trans (r8.trans (r9.trans (r10.trans (r11.trans
    (r12.trans (r13.trans r14))))))))
  set R14 : Regs := {R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f, U := f + 4}
  have hR14 : R14.Bd B := by simp only [R14, Regs.Bd]; omega
  by_cases hlen : w'.length = W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n + 1
  · have heq : f + 4 = 2 * n + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6 := by
      rw [hlen]; simp only [f, e, b]; ring
    have r15 : Reach N .step y B .lenChk2 R14.val .term2 R14.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]; decide))
        (by simp [astep_jeq (show CA N .step .lenChk2 = _ from rfl), R14, heq, hP])
    have hterm : y.getD f false = w'.getD (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n) false := by
      rw [show f = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 + 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n) by
          simp only [f, e, b, n]; ring, hy, getD_w2 _ _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at hterm
    by_cases htm : w'.getD (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n) false = true
    · have htm' := htm
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at htm'
      left
      refine ⟨hlen, htm, ?_⟩
      have r16 : Reach N .step y B .term2 R14.val .clrQ1b R14.val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
          (by simp [astep_call (show CA N .step .term2 = _ from rfl), vword_whole₁, orc_bit, R14,
            hterm, htm'])
      have r17 : Reach N .step y B .clrQ1b R14.val (.cp .Q1f2) ({R14 with Q1 := 0} : Regs).val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
          (by simp [astep_clr (show CA N .step .clrQ1b = _ from rfl)])
      have r18 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .Q1f2) ({R14 with Q1 := 0} : Regs).val (.dcTest .Pos2)
          ({R14 with Q1 := f} : Regs).val :=
        Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Q1f2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [R14, Regs.Bd]; omega)
          (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, R14])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, R14])
      set pf := (w'.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP n)
      have hpf : pf.length = wP n := by simp only [pf, List.length_take, List.length_drop]; omega
      have hpow : 2 ^ wP n ≤ 2 * (n + 1) := two_pow_bits_le (n + 1) (by omega)
      have r19 : Reach N .step y B (.dcTest .Pos2) ({R14 with Q1 := f} : Regs).val .inZ
          ({R14 with Q1 := e, Pos2 := bitsVal pf} : Regs).val :=
        Reach.cast (dc_run y B .Pos2 pf
          (fun i _ => by
            have h1 := bitsVal_lt_two_pow (pf.drop i)
            have h2 : 2 ^ (pf.drop i).length ≤ 2 ^ wP n :=
              Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by simp; omega)
            omega)
          _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [R14, Regs.Bd]; omega)
          (by simp [dcPtr, dcBase, dcStride, R14, hpf, f])
          (by simp [dcAcc, R14, hPos2]) (by simp [R14])
          (fun i hi => by
            rw [hpf] at hi
            simp only [dcBase, dcStride, R14, Regs.val_E2]
            rw [hy,
              show e + 2 * i = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 + 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1) + i) by
                rw [he2]; simp only [b, n]; ring,
              getD_w2 _ _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
            simp only [pf, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_take, if_pos hi,

          (by simp [dcPtr, dcBase, dcAcc, R14])
      refine (r5_14.trans (r15.trans (r16.trans (r17.trans (r18.trans r19))))).cast ?_
      simp only [lay2R, R14, e, f, b, pf, n]
    · have htm' : (w'[W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n]?).getD false = false := by
        rw [← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]; simpa using htm
      right
      refine ⟨fun h => htm h.2, ?_⟩
      have r16 : Reach N .step y B .term2 R14.val .rej R14.val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
          (by simp [astep_call (show CA N .step .term2 = _ from rfl), vword_whole₁, orc_bit, R14,
            hterm, htm'])
      exact halt_rej (r5_14.trans (r15.trans r16)) hR14.val_le
  · right
    refine ⟨fun h => hlen h.1, ?_⟩
    have hne : ¬ f = 2 * n + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 2 := by
      intro h; apply hlen; simp only [f, e, b] at h
      have : 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N = 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1)) := by ring
      omega
    have r15 : Reach N .step y B .lenChk2 R14.val .rej R14.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]; decide))
        (by simp [astep_jeq (show CA N .step .lenChk2 = _ from rfl), R14, hP, hne])
    exact halt_rej (r5_14.trans r15) hR14.val_le

/-- The register code of an optional input symbol: `0` blank, `1` for `0`, `2` for `1`. -/
def zcode : Option Bool → ℕ
  | none => 0
  | some false => 1
  | some true => 2

/-- **The input-symbol read**: the machine stores the code of the input symbol under the
first word's input head (`inpOf`) in `rZ`, then copies the scan pointers `rQ3 := rA`,
`rQ4 := rB`.

**Proof sketch.** Zero and end tests on the position; otherwise copy the position, decrement,
double into `rU` (`sc_run`) — the address of input letter `pos - 1` in the doubled first
field — read it (`pe_getD_fst`) and count it into `rZ`; then two copies. -/
theorem insym_run (y x rest : List Bool) (hy : y = pairEncode x rest) (R : Regs)
    (hBd : R.Bd (bnd N y)) (hPos : R.Pos ≤ x.length + 1) (hN1 : R.N1 = x.length + 1)
    (hT : R.T = 0) (hZ : R.Z = 0) (hQ3 : R.Q3 = 0) (hQ4 : R.Q4 = 0) :
    ∃ u, u ≤ bnd N y ∧ Reach N .step y (bnd N y) .inZ R.val .clrQ1v
      ({R with Z := zcode (inpOf x R.Pos), U := u, Q3 := R.A, Q4 := R.B} : Regs).val := by
  set B := bnd N y
  have hB0 := hBd
  simp only [Regs.Bd] at hB0
  have hyl : y.length = 2 * x.length + 2 + rest.length := by rw [hy, length_pairEncode]
  have hLB : y.length ≤ B := length_le_bnd y
  -- the pointer copies
  have copies : ∀ R' : Regs, R'.Bd B → R'.Q3 = 0 → R'.Q4 = 0 →
      Reach N .step y B (.cp .Q3) R'.val .clrQ1v ({R' with Q3 := R'.A, Q4 := R'.B} : Regs).val := by
    intro R' hR' h3 h4
    have hR'0 := hR'
    simp only [Regs.Bd] at hR'0
    have c1 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .Q3) R'.val (.cp .Q4) ({R' with Q3 := R'.A} : Regs).val :=
      Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Q3 _ hR'.val_le (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, h3])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
    have c2 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .Q4) ({R' with Q3 := R'.A} : Regs).val .clrQ1v
        ({R' with Q3 := R'.A, Q4 := R'.B} : Regs).val :=
      Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Q4 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
        (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, h4])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
    exact c1.trans c2
  by_cases h0 : R.Pos = 0
  · refine ⟨R.U, hB0.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
    have r1 : Reach N .step y B .inZ R.val (.cp .Q3) R.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hBd.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
        (by simp [astep_jz (show CA N .step .inZ = _ from rfl), h0])
    have := copies R hBd hQ3 hQ4
    exact (r1.trans this).cast (by simp [inpOf, h0, zcode, hZ])
  have r1 : Reach N .step y B .inZ R.val .inN R.val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of hBd.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
      (by simp [astep_jz (show CA N .step .inZ = _ from rfl), h0])
  by_cases h1 : R.Pos = x.length + 1
  · refine ⟨R.U, hB0.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
    have r2 : Reach N .step y B .inN R.val (.cp .Q3) R.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hBd.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]; decide))
        (by simp [astep_jeq (show CA N .step .inN = _ from rfl), h1, hN1])
    have := copies R hBd hQ3 hQ4
    exact (r1.trans (r2.trans this)).cast (by simp [inpOf, h1, zcode, hZ])
  have r2 : Reach N .step y B .inN R.val (.cp .Tpos) R.val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of hBd.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]; decide))
      (by simp [astep_jeq (show CA N .step .inN = _ from rfl), hN1]; omega)
  have r3 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .Tpos) R.val .inDec ({R with T := R.Pos} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Tpos _ hBd.val_le (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hT])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
  have r4 : Reach N .step y B .inDec ({R with T := R.Pos} : Regs).val .clrU3
      ({R with T := R.Pos - 1} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep_dec (show CA N .step .inDec = _ from rfl)])
  have r5 : Reach N .step y B .clrU3 ({R with T := R.Pos - 1} : Regs).val (.sc .In)
      ({R with T := R.Pos - 1, U := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep_clr (show CA N .step .clrU3 = _ from rfl)])
  have r6 : Reach N .step y B (.sc .In) ({R with T := R.Pos - 1, U := 0} : Regs).val .inRead
      ({R with T := 0, U := 2 * (R.Pos - 1)} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (sc_run y B .In _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor]; omega)) (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor])
  set R6 : Regs := {R with T := 0, U := 2 * (R.Pos - 1)}
  have hR6 : R6.Bd B := by simp only [R6, Regs.Bd]; omega
  have hbit : y.getD (2 * (R.Pos - 1)) false = x.getD (R.Pos - 1) false := by
    rw [hy, pe_getD_fst _ _ _ (by omega)]
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at hbit
  have hin : inpOf x R.Pos = some (x.getD (R.Pos - 1) false) := by
    simp [inpOf, h0, h1]
  refine ⟨2 * (R.Pos - 1), by omega, ?_⟩
  rw [hin, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  cases hb : (x[R.Pos - 1]?).getD false
  · have r7 : Reach N .step y B .inRead R6.val .inF R6.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR6.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
        (by simp [astep_call (show CA N .step .inRead = _ from rfl), vword_whole₁, orc_bit, R6,
          hbit, hb])
    have r8 : Reach N .step y B .inF R6.val (.cp .Q3) ({R6 with Z := 1} : Regs).val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR6.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
        (by simp [astep_inc (show CA N .step .inF = _ from rfl), R6, hZ])
    have := copies ({R6 with Z := 1} : Regs) (by simp only [R6, Regs.Bd]; omega) (by simp [R6, hQ3])
      (by simp [R6, hQ4])
    exact (r1.trans (r2.trans (r3.trans (r4.trans (r5.trans (r6.trans (r7.trans (r8.trans
      this)))))))).cast (by simp [R6, hT, zcode])
  · have r7 : Reach N .step y B .inRead R6.val .inT1 R6.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR6.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
        (by simp [astep_call (show CA N .step .inRead = _ from rfl), vword_whole₁, orc_bit, R6,
          hbit, hb])
    have r8 : Reach N .step y B .inT1 R6.val .inF ({R6 with Z := 1} : Regs).val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR6.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
        (by simp [astep_inc (show CA N .step .inT1 = _ from rfl), R6, hZ])
    have r9 : Reach N .step y B .inF ({R6 with Z := 1} : Regs).val (.cp .Q3)
        ({R6 with Z := 2} : Regs).val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [R6, Regs.Bd]; omega)
        (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep_inc (show CA N .step .inF = _ from rfl)])
    have := copies ({R6 with Z := 2} : Regs) (by simp only [R6, Regs.Bd]; omega) (by simp [R6, hQ3])
      (by simp [R6, hQ4])
    exact (r1.trans (r2.trans (r3.trans (r4.trans (r5.trans (r6.trans (r7.trans (r8.trans
      (r9.trans this))))))))).cast (by simp [R6, hT, zcode])

end Complexity.Codec
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Layout2
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Deciders

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The step language is logspace

The codec machine `Complexity.Codec.CA` in mode `step` decides
`Complexity.Codec.stepLang N`: after the parse (`parse_run₂`), the layout of both code words
(`layout_run`, `layout2_run`), the position comparison (`le_phase`), the input-symbol read
(`insym_run`) and the validity scan of the first word (`vscan_run`), it reads the step data
into its control, moves the first word's input position by the action of each choice bit
and compares it with the second word's (`pm_run`), and runs the double sliding scan of the
two chunk regions (`s_run`). `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_poly` turns this into
membership in `L`.

Configuration-graph infrastructure for logspace algorithms ([AB09, §4.1.1, §4.3]); not a
result of [AB09] by itself.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.Codec.stepAns` — the answer of the step machine after the scan.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Codec.z_run`, `Complexity.Codec.step_tail` — the step tail.
* `Complexity.Codec.pm_run` — the position move and comparison of one choice bit.
* `Complexity.Codec.stepLang_mem` — the step language is in `L`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1, §4.3.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Codec

open Turing LogProg

variable {N : FinNDTM Bool}

/-- A Boolean branch is the branch at the decision. -/
lemma ite_bool {α : Type} (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (f : Bool → α) :
    (if p then f true else f false) = f (decide p) := by
  by_cases h : p <;> simp [h]

/-- **The position move of one choice bit**: from `.pm I b f .start`, the machine compares
`rPos` moved by the action of `b` (clamped to `[0, rN1]`) with `rPos2`, restores `rPos`, and
continues with the verdict.

**Proof sketch.** By the move: no move compares directly; a right move compares directly at
the right end and otherwise increments, compares and decrements; a left move compares
directly at `0` and otherwise decrements, compares and increments. -/
theorem pm_run (y : List Bool) (I : SInfo N) (b f : Bool) (R : Regs) (hBd : R.Bd (bnd N y))
    (hN1 : 1 ≤ R.N1) (hle : R.Pos ≤ R.N1) (hbig : R.N1 + 1 ≤ bnd N y) :
    Reach N .step y (bnd N y) (.pm I b f .start) R.val
      (pmNext N I b f (decide (movePos (R.N1 - 1) R.Pos (aI N I b).inputTape = R.Pos2))) R.val := by
  set B := bnd N y
  have hv := hBd.val_le
  have hB0 := hBd
  simp only [Regs.Bd] at hB0
  cases hm : (aI N I b).inputTape with
  | zero =>
    have hst : CA N .step (.pm I b f .start) =
        .jeq rPos rPos2 (pmNext N I b f true) (pmNext N I b f false) := by simp [CA, hm]
    refine Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA, hm]; decide)) ?_
    simp only [astep_jeq hst, Regs.val_Pos, Regs.val_Pos2]
    rw [ite_bool]; rfl
  | pos =>
    have hst : CA N .step (.pm I b f .start) = .jeq rPos rN1 (.pm I b f .eq) (.pm I b f .inc) := by
      simp [CA, hm]
    by_cases hp : R.Pos = R.N1
    · have r1 : Reach N .step y B (.pm I b f .start) R.val (.pm I b f .eq) R.val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA, hm]; decide)) (by simp [astep_jeq hst, hp])
      refine r1.trans (Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA]; decide)) ?_)
      simp only [astep_jeq (show CA N .step (.pm I b f .eq) = _ from rfl), Regs.val_Pos,
        Regs.val_Pos2]
      rw [ite_bool]
      simp [movePos, show R.N1 - 1 + 1 = R.N1 by omega, hp]
    · have r1 : Reach N .step y B (.pm I b f .start) R.val (.pm I b f .inc) R.val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA, hm]; decide)) (by simp [astep_jeq hst, hp])
      have hv1 : ({R with Pos := R.Pos + 1} : Regs).Bd B := by simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega
      have r2 : Reach N .step y B (.pm I b f .inc) R.val (.pm I b f .eq2)
          ({R with Pos := R.Pos + 1} : Regs).val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA]))
          (by simp [astep_inc (show CA N .step (.pm I b f .inc) = _ from rfl)])
      have r3 : Reach N .step y B (.pm I b f .eq2) ({R with Pos := R.Pos + 1} : Regs).val
          (.pm I b f (.decR (decide (R.Pos + 1 = R.Pos2))))
          ({R with Pos := R.Pos + 1} : Regs).val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hv1.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]; decide))
          (by simp only [astep_jeq (show CA N .step (.pm I b f .eq2) = _ from rfl), Regs.val_Pos,
            Regs.val_Pos2]
              by_cases h : R.Pos + 1 = R.Pos2 <;> simp [h])
      have r4 : Reach N .step y B (.pm I b f (.decR (decide (R.Pos + 1 = R.Pos2))))
          ({R with Pos := R.Pos + 1} : Regs).val (pmNext N I b f (decide (R.Pos + 1 = R.Pos2)))
          R.val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hv1.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
          (by simp [astep_dec (show CA N .step (.pm I b f (.decR _)) = _ from rfl)])
      refine (r1.trans (r2.trans (r3.trans r4))).cast rfl |> fun h => ?_
      have : movePos (R.N1 - 1) R.Pos .pos = R.Pos + 1 := by
        simp [movePos, show R.N1 - 1 + 1 = R.N1 by omega, hp]
      rw [this]
      exact h
  | neg =>
    have hst : CA N .step (.pm I b f .start) = .jz rPos (.pm I b f .eq) (.pm I b f .decN) := by
      simp [CA, hm]
    by_cases hp : R.Pos = 0
    · have r1 : Reach N .step y B (.pm I b f .start) R.val (.pm I b f .eq) R.val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA, hm])) (by simp [astep_jz hst, hp])
      refine r1.trans (Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA]; decide)) ?_)
      simp only [astep_jeq (show CA N .step (.pm I b f .eq) = _ from rfl), Regs.val_Pos,
        Regs.val_Pos2]
      rw [ite_bool]
      simp [movePos, hp]
    · have r1 : Reach N .step y B (.pm I b f .start) R.val (.pm I b f .decN) R.val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA, hm])) (by simp [astep_jz hst, hp])
      have hv1 : ({R with Pos := R.Pos - 1} : Regs).Bd B := by simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega
      have r2 : Reach N .step y B (.pm I b f .decN) R.val (.pm I b f .eq3)
          ({R with Pos := R.Pos - 1} : Regs).val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA]))
          (by simp [astep_dec (show CA N .step (.pm I b f .decN) = _ from rfl)])
      have r3 : Reach N .step y B (.pm I b f .eq3) ({R with Pos := R.Pos - 1} : Regs).val
          (.pm I b f (.incR (decide (R.Pos - 1 = R.Pos2))))
          ({R with Pos := R.Pos - 1} : Regs).val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hv1.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]; decide))
          (by simp only [astep_jeq (show CA N .step (.pm I b f .eq3) = _ from rfl), Regs.val_Pos,
            Regs.val_Pos2]
              by_cases h : R.Pos - 1 = R.Pos2 <;> simp [h])
      have r4 : Reach N .step y B (.pm I b f (.incR (decide (R.Pos - 1 = R.Pos2))))
          ({R with Pos := R.Pos - 1} : Regs).val (pmNext N I b f (decide (R.Pos - 1 = R.Pos2)))
          R.val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hv1.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
          (by simp [astep_inc (show CA N .step (.pm I b f (.incR _)) = _ from rfl),
            show R.Pos - 1 + 1 = R.Pos by omega])
      have : movePos (R.N1 - 1) R.Pos .neg = R.Pos - 1 := rfl
      rw [this]
      exact r1.trans (r2.trans (r3.trans r4))

/-- **Reading the step data into the control**: the code of the input symbol in `rZ` becomes
the second component of the step data.

**Proof sketch.** A zero test, a decrement and a second zero test on `rZ` distinguish the
three codes. -/
theorem z_run (y x : List Bool) (σ : VSt N) (R : Regs) (hBd : R.Bd (bnd N y)) (p : ℕ)
    (hZ : R.Z = zcode (inpOf x p)) :
    ∃ z, z ≤ 2 ∧ Reach N .step y (bnd N y) (.zA σ) R.val (.pm (σ, inpOf x p) false false .start)
      ({R with Z := z} : Regs).val := by
  have hv := hBd.val_le
  cases hin : inpOf x p with
  | none =>
    rw [hin] at hZ
    simp only [zcode] at hZ
    have hR : ({R with Z := 0} : Regs) = R := by cases R; simp_all
    refine ⟨0, by omega, ?_⟩
    rw [hR]
    exact Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA]))
      (by simp [astep_jz (show CA N .step (.zA σ) = _ from rfl), hZ])
  | some c =>
    rw [hin] at hZ
    have r1 : Reach N .step y (bnd N y) (.zA σ) R.val (.zB σ) R.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA]))
        (by cases c <;> simp [astep_jz (show CA N .step (.zA σ) = _ from rfl), hZ, zcode])
    have hv1 : ({R with Z := R.Z - 1} : Regs).Bd (bnd N y) := by
      have := hBd; simp only [Regs.Bd] at this ⊢; omega
    have r2 : Reach N .step y (bnd N y) (.zB σ) R.val (.zC σ) ({R with Z := R.Z - 1} : Regs).val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA]))
        (by simp [astep_dec (show CA N .step (.zB σ) = _ from rfl)])
    refine ⟨R.Z - 1, by cases c <;> simp [zcode] at hZ <;> omega, r1.trans (r2.trans ?_)⟩
    exact Reach.single' (gd_of hv1.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
      (by cases c <;> simp [astep_jz (show CA N .step (.zC σ) = _ from rfl), hZ, zcode])

/-- The answer of the step machine after the validity scan, from the scan state `st`, the
input positions `p`, `p'`, and the two chunk regions `u`, `u'`. -/
noncomputable def stepAns (x : List Bool) (st : VSt N) (p p' : ℕ) (u u' : List Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (VAcc N st) &&
    ((decide (movePos x.length p (aI N (st, inpOf x p) false).inputTape = p') &&
        sDone N (Gs N (st, inpOf x p) false)
          (sScan N (Gs N (st, inpOf x p) false) (Gs N (st, inpOf x p) true) u u').1) ||
      (decide (movePos x.length p (aI N (st, inpOf x p) true).inputTape = p') &&
        sDone N (Gs N (st, inpOf x p) true)
          (sScan N (Gs N (st, inpOf x p) false) (Gs N (st, inpOf x p) true) u u').2))

/-- **The tail of the step mode**: after the validity scan of the first word, read the step
data, compare the positions for both choice bits (`pm_run`), run the double sliding scan of
the two chunk regions (`s_run`), and answer `stepAns`.

**Proof sketch.** A branch on the scan verdict, `z_run`, two `pm_run`s, `s_run` with the
letters of both words at stride two (`getD_w`, `getD_w2`), and the final `ret`. -/
theorem step_tail (y x w w' rest : List Bool)
    (hy : y = pairEncode x (pairEncode w (pairEncode w' rest))) (s : ℕ) (st : VAd N) (R : Regs)
    (hBd : R.Bd (bnd N y)) (hN1 : R.N1 = x.length + 1) (hPos : R.Pos ≤ x.length + 1)
    (hZ : R.Z = zcode (inpOf x R.Pos)) (hQ3 : R.Q3 = 2 * x.length + 2)
    (hQ4 : R.Q4 = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4)
    (hE : R.E = 2 * x.length + 2 + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N)
    (hw : W N * (2 * s + 1) ≤ w.length) (hw' : W N * (2 * s + 1) ≤ w'.length)
    (hs : s ≤ 2 * y.length) :
    AHalt (CA N .step) orc y (GuardLe (CA N .step) y (bnd N y)) (some (.vDone st), R.val, none)
      (stepAns x st.1 R.Pos R.Pos2 (w.take (W N * (2 * s + 1))) (w'.take (W N * (2 * s + 1)))) := by
  set B := bnd N y
  have hv := hBd.val_le
  have hB0 := hBd
  simp only [Regs.Bd] at hB0
  have hyl : y.length = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6 + rest.length := by
    rw [hy, length_pairEncode, length_pairEncode, length_pairEncode]; ring
  have hbig := bnd_ge (N := N) y s hs
  have hret : ∀ (l : Lab N) (v : Fin 21 → ℕ) (b : Bool), (∀ r, v r ≤ B) →
      CA N .step l = .ret b →
        AHalt (CA N .step) orc y (GuardLe (CA N .step) y B) (some l, v, none) b :=
    fun l v b hv h => AHalt.ret h ⟨by simp [PreS, h], hv⟩
  by_cases hacc : VAcc N st.1
  swap
  · have : stepAns x st.1 R.Pos R.Pos2 (w.take (W N * (2 * s + 1))) (w'.take (W N * (2 * s + 1)))
        = false := by simp [stepAns, hacc]
    rw [this]
    have r1 : Reach N .step y B (.vDone st) R.val .rej R.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA, goto]))
        (by simp [astep_jz (show CA N .step (.vDone st) = _ from rfl), hacc])
    exact AReach.halt r1 (hret _ _ _ hv rfl)
  have r1 : Reach N .step y B (.vDone st) R.val (.zA st.1) R.val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of hv (by simp [PreS, CA, goto]))
      (by simp [astep_jz (show CA N .step (.vDone st) = _ from rfl), hacc])
  obtain ⟨z, hz, r2⟩ := z_run (N := N) y x st.1 R hBd R.Pos hZ
  set I : SInfo N := (st.1, inpOf x R.Pos)
  set R2 : Regs := {R with Z := z}
  have hR2 : R2.Bd B := by simp only [R2, Regs.Bd]; omega
  have r3 := pm_run (N := N) y I false false R2 hR2 (by simp [R2, hN1]) (by simp [R2, hN1, hPos])
    (by simp [R2, hN1]; omega)
  set f₀ := decide (movePos (R2.N1 - 1) R2.Pos (aI N I false).inputTape = R2.Pos2)
  have r4 := pm_run (N := N) y I true f₀ R2 hR2 (by simp [R2, hN1]) (by simp [R2, hN1, hPos])
    (by simp [R2, hN1]; omega)
  set f₁ := decide (movePos (R2.N1 - 1) R2.Pos (aI N I true).inputTape = R2.Pos2)
  simp only [pmNext, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at r3 r4
  set u := w.take (W N * (2 * s + 1))
  set u' := w'.take (W N * (2 * s + 1))
  have hu : u.length = W N * (2 * s + 1) := by simp only [u, List.length_take]; omega
  have hu' : u'.length = W N * (2 * s + 1) := by simp only [u', List.length_take]; omega
  have r5 := s_run (N := N) (mode := .step) y B I f₀ f₁ u u' (by rw [hu, hu']) (sAd0 N) R2.val
    hR2.val_le (by simp [R2, hu, hE, hQ3]; ring)
    (by simp [R2, hu, hQ4]; have : 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1)) = 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N := by ring
        omega)
    (fun i hi => by
      rw [hu] at hi
      simp only [R2, Regs.val_Q3, hQ3]
      rw [hy, getD_w _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
      simp only [u, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_take, if_pos hi])
    (fun i hi => by
      rw [hu] at hi
      simp only [R2, Regs.val_Q4, hQ4]
      rw [hy, getD_w2 _ _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
      simp only [u', List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_take, if_pos hi])
  set R5 : Regs := {R2 with Q3 := R2.Q3 + 2 * u.length, Q4 := R2.Q4 + 2 * u.length}
  have hR5 : R5.Bd B := by
    simp only [R5, R2, Regs.Bd, hu]
    have : 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1)) = 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N := by ring
    omega
  have r5' : Reach N .step y B (.sTest I f₀ f₁ (sAd0 N)) R2.val
      (.sFin I f₀ f₁ ((List.zip u u').foldl (δS N I) (sAd0 N))) R5.val :=
    Reach.cast r5 (by simp [R5])
  have hans : stepAns x st.1 R.Pos R.Pos2 u u' =
      ((f₀ && sDone N (Gs N I false) ((List.zip u u').foldl (δS N I) (sAd0 N)).1.1) ||
        (f₁ && sDone N (Gs N I true) ((List.zip u u').foldl (δS N I) (sAd0 N)).1.2)) := by
    simp only [stepAns, hacc, decide_true, Bool.true_and, f₀, f₁, R2, hN1,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel, I]
    rfl
  rw [hans]
  exact AReach.halt (r1.trans (r2.trans (r3.trans (r4.trans r5')))) (hret _ _ _ hR5.val_le rfl)

/-- The answer of the step machine is the step check, on inputs passing the pre-scan
checks of both words. -/
lemma stepAns_iff (x w w' : List Bool) (s : ℕ) (hpre : PreChk N x.length s w)
    (hlen' : w'.length = W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length + 1)
    (hterm' : w'.getD (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length) false = true) :
    stepAns x (vScan N (w.take (W N * (2 * s + 1))))
        (bitsVal ((w.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP x.length)))
        (bitsVal ((w'.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP x.length)))
        (w.take (W N * (2 * s + 1))) (w'.take (W N * (2 * s + 1))) = true ↔
      StepChk N x s w w' := by
  unfold StepChk stepAns
  rw [validChk_iff_pre]
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hacc, (⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩)⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨hpre, hacc⟩, hlen', hterm', false, h1.symm, h2⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨hpre, hacc⟩, hlen', hterm', true, h1.symm, h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨-, hacc⟩, -, -, b, h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨hacc, ?_⟩
    cases b
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h1.symm, h2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h1.symm, h2⟩

/-- Members of the step language are well shaped. -/
lemma shape2_of_code {y x : List Bool} {c c' s : ℕ}
    (hy : y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (pairEncode (Nat.bits c') (Nat.bits s))))
    (C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x) (hc : cfgCode s C = c) :
    Shape2 y x (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits c') s := by
  refine ⟨hy, width_of_code s C y ?_⟩
  rw [hy, ← hc, bits_cfgCode]
  simp [length_pairEncode]; omega

/-- **The step language is logspace** (`Complexity.Codec.stepLang`).

**Proof sketch.** `arm_decides_poly` with the codec machine in mode `step`: the phases
`parse_run₂`, `layout_run`, `le_phase`, `layout2_run`, `insym_run`, `vscan_run`,
`step_tail` answer `stepAns`, which on well-shaped inputs passing the pre-scan checks is the
step check (`stepAns_iff`), i.e. membership (`stepLang_iff`); every rejection on the way
falsifies the step check or the shape (`shape2_of_code`). -/
theorem stepLang_mem : stepLang N ∈ LOGSPACE := by
  refine arm_decides_poly (CA N .step) .lenScan codecAs codecAs_mem (8 * W N + 8) 1
    fun y => ?_
  rw [← val_empty]
  refine AHalt.mono ?_ (fun a h => gd_mono a h)
  set B := bnd N y
  -- non-members: no shape, or a failed check
  have hnon : (∀ x w w' s, Shape2 y x w w' s → ¬ StepChk N x s w w') →
      MultiTapeTM.indicator (stepLang N : Set (List Bool)) y = false := by
    intro hfail
    rw [indicator_eq_of_iff (P := False) (Iff.intro (fun h => ?_) False.elim)]
    · rfl
    obtain ⟨x, c, c', s, hy, C, hC, hc, C', hstep, hC', hc'⟩ := h
    have hsh := shape2_of_code (c' := c') hy C hc
    exact hfail x _ _ s hsh ((stepLang_iff N x (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits c') s).mp
      ⟨x, c, c', s, rfl, C, hC, hc, C', hstep, hC', hc'⟩)
  rcases parse_run₂ (N := N) y with ⟨x, w, w', s, q1, cap, ⟨hy, hwid⟩, hq1, hcap, r1⟩ |
      ⟨hno, hhalt⟩
  swap
  · rw [hnon (fun x w w' s h => absurd ⟨x, w, w', s, h⟩ hno)]
    exact hhalt
  have hyl : y.length = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6 + (Nat.bits s).length := by
    rw [hy, length_pairEncode, length_pairEncode, length_pairEncode]; ring
  have hs := s_le_of_width y s (by omega) hwid
  have hbig := bnd_ge (N := N) y s hs
  have hlink : 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N = 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1)) := by ring
  have hlink2 : 2 * W N * (2 * s + 1) = 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1)) := by ring
  have huniq : ∀ x₁ w₁ w₁' s₁, Shape2 y x₁ w₁ w₁' s₁ → x₁ = x ∧ w₁ = w ∧ w₁' = w' ∧ s₁ = s := by
    rintro x₁ w₁ w₁' s₁ ⟨hy₁, -⟩
    rw [hy] at hy₁
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := pairEncode_inj hy₁
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := pairEncode_inj h2
    obtain ⟨h5, h6⟩ := pairEncode_inj h4
    exact ⟨h1.symm, h3.symm, h5.symm, (bits_injective h6).symm⟩
  set R1 : Regs := { L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6,
                     A := 2 * x.length + 2, B := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4, Q1 := q1,
                     Cap := cap, Q2 := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6, S := s }
  have hR1 : R1.Bd B := by simp only [R1, Regs.Bd]; omega
  rcases layout_run (N := N) (mode := .step) y x w (pairEncode w' (Nat.bits s)) hy R1 s hR1 rfl rfl
    rfl hs rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl (by simp [R1]) with ⟨hlen, hterm, r2⟩ | ⟨hbad, hhalt⟩
  swap
  · rw [hnon (fun x₁ w₁ w₁' s₁ hsh hchk => by
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := huniq x₁ w₁ w₁' s₁ hsh
      exact hbad ⟨hchk.1.1, hchk.1.2.2.2⟩)]
    exact AReach.halt r1 hhalt
  set pos := bitsVal ((w.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP x.length))
  set R2 := layR N R1 x.length s pos
  have hwP := wP_le x.length
  have hpos_lt : pos < 2 * (x.length + 1) := by
    have h1 := bitsVal_lt_two_pow ((w.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP x.length))
    have h2 : 2 ^ ((w.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP x.length)).length ≤
        2 * (x.length + 1) := by
      rw [show ((w.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP x.length)).length = wP x.length by
        simp; omega]
      exact two_pow_bits_le _ (by omega)
    omega
  have hR2 : R2.Bd B := by simp only [R2, R1, layR, Regs.Bd]; omega
  obtain ⟨hle, hgt⟩ := le_phase (N := N) (mode := .step) y R2 hR2 (by simp [R2, R1, layR])
  by_cases hp : pos ≤ x.length + 1
  swap
  · rw [hnon (fun x₁ w₁ w₁' s₁ hsh hchk => by
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := huniq x₁ w₁ w₁' s₁ hsh
      exact hp hchk.1.2.2.1)]
    exact AReach.halt (r1.trans r2) (hgt (by simpa [R2, R1, layR] using hp))
  have r3 := hle (by simpa [R2, R1, layR] using hp)
  simp only [↓reduceIte] at r3
  rcases layout2_run (N := N) y x w w' (Nat.bits s) hy R2 s hR2 (by simp [R2, R1, layR])
    (by simp [R2, R1, layR]) (by simp [R2, R1, layR]) hs (by simp [R2, layR])
    (by simp [R2, R1, layR]) (by simp [R2, R1, layR]) (by simp [R2, R1, layR])
    (by simp [R2, R1, layR]) with ⟨hlen', hterm', r4⟩ | ⟨hbad', hhalt'⟩
  swap
  · rw [hnon (fun x₁ w₁ w₁' s₁ hsh hchk => by
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := huniq x₁ w₁ w₁' s₁ hsh
      exact hbad' ⟨hchk.2.1, hchk.2.2.1⟩)]
    exact AReach.halt (r1.trans (r2.trans r3)) hhalt'
  set pos' := bitsVal ((w'.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP x.length))
  set R3 := lay2R N R2 (2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4) s (wP x.length) pos'
  have hpos'_lt : pos' < 2 * (x.length + 1) := by
    have h1 := bitsVal_lt_two_pow ((w'.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP x.length))
    have h2 : 2 ^ ((w'.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP x.length)).length ≤
        2 * (x.length + 1) := by
      rw [show ((w'.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP x.length)).length = wP x.length by
        simp; omega]
      exact two_pow_bits_le _ (by omega)
    omega
  have hR3 : R3.Bd B := by simp only [R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR, Regs.Bd]; omega
  obtain ⟨u, hu, r5⟩ := insym_run (N := N) y x (pairEncode w (pairEncode w' (Nat.bits s))) hy R3 hR3
    (by simp [R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR]; omega) (by simp [R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR])
    (by simp [R3, lay2R]) (by simp [R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR]) (by simp [R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR])
    (by simp [R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR])
  set R4 : Regs := {R3 with Z := zcode (inpOf x R3.Pos), U := u, Q3 := R3.A, Q4 := R3.B}
  have hR4 : R4.Bd B := by
    simp only [R4, R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR, Regs.Bd]
    have : zcode (inpOf x pos) ≤ 2 := by
      unfold zcode; split <;> omega
    omega
  obtain ⟨st, hst, r6⟩ := vscan_run (N := N) (mode := .step) y x w (pairEncode w' (Nat.bits s)) hy
    R4 s hR4 (by simp [R4, R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR]) (by simp [R4, R3, R2, lay2R, layR])
    (by omega)
  set R5 : Regs := {R4 with Q1 := R4.E, Q2 := R4.E}
  have hR5 : R5.Bd B := by
    simp only [R5, R4, R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR, Regs.Bd]
    have : zcode (inpOf x pos) ≤ 2 := by
      unfold zcode; split <;> omega
    omega
  have tail := step_tail (N := N) y x w w' (Nat.bits s) hy s st R5 hR5
    (by simp [R5, R4, R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR]) (by simp [R5, R4, R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR]; omega)
    (by simp [R5, R4, R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR]) (by simp [R5, R4, R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR])
    (by simp [R5, R4, R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR]) (by simp [R5, R4, R3, R2, lay2R, layR])
    (by omega) (by omega) hs
  have hPosR5 : R5.Pos = pos := by simp [R5, R4, R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR]
  have hPos2R5 : R5.Pos2 = pos' := by simp [R5, R4, R3, R2, R1, lay2R, layR]
  rw [hst, hPosR5, hPos2R5] at tail
  have hind : MultiTapeTM.indicator (stepLang N : Set (List Bool)) y =
      stepAns x (vScan N (w.take (W N * (2 * s + 1)))) pos pos'
        (w.take (W N * (2 * s + 1))) (w'.take (W N * (2 * s + 1))) := by
    rw [indicator_eq_decide]
    have key := stepAns_iff (N := N) x w w' s ⟨hlen, hterm, hp⟩ hlen' hterm'
    rw [hy, stepLang_iff]
    cases h : stepAns x (vScan N (w.take (W N * (2 * s + 1)))) pos pos'
        (w.take (W N * (2 * s + 1))) (w'.take (W N * (2 * s + 1)))
    · simp only [decide_eq_false_iff_not]
      intro hc; rw [← key] at hc; rw [hc] at h; exact Bool.noConfusion h
    · simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
      exact key.mp h
  rw [hind]
  exact AReach.halt (r1.trans (r2.trans (r3.trans (r4.trans (r5.trans r6))))) tail

end Complexity.Codec
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/CounterProgSim.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.CounterProgRun
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.UnaryLogspace

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Simulating counter programs in logarithmic space

A counter program (`Complexity.CounterProg`, the model of the emitters of [AB09, Remark 6.7])
that runs for polynomially many steps keeps every register polynomially bounded, so its
registers fit in `O(log n)` bits. This file builds the abstract register machine
`Complexity.CPSim.A P l₀ lm` that, on `⟨1ⁿ, bits p⟩`, runs `P` with its registers, its input
position and the *number* of printed bits held in binary, reading the input of `P` through
two deciders (the length and bit languages of the input) and stopping at the `p`-th printed
bit [AB09, §4.3: composing implicitly logspace computable functions, by recomputing bits on
demand].

This file defines the machine and proves the simulation of one counter step
(`Complexity.CPSim.sim_step`); the whole run and the resulting closure property are in
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.CounterProgSimRun`.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.CPSim.A` — the simulating machine; `lm` selects the length language.
* `Complexity.CPSim.ev` — the register file of a counter state.

## Main results

* `Complexity.CPSim.sim_step` — one counter step is simulated, or the machine answers.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.3, Lemma 4.17; §6.1.1, Remark 6.7.)
-/

namespace Complexity

namespace CPSim

open Turing LogProg

variable {R : ℕ} {Λ : Type}

/-! ## The register file -/

/-- The register of counter register `r`. -/
def rg (r : Fin R) : Fin (R + 3) := Fin.castAdd 3 r
/-- The register of the input position. -/
def rP (R : ℕ) : Fin (R + 3) := ⟨R, by omega⟩
/-- The register of the number of printed bits. -/
def rO (R : ℕ) : Fin (R + 3) := ⟨R + 1, by omega⟩
/-- The scratch register of the print loop. -/
def rT (R : ℕ) : Fin (R + 3) := ⟨R + 2, by omega⟩

/-- The register file: counter registers `ρ`, input position `p`, output count `oc`, scratch
`tm`. -/
def ev (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm : ℕ) : Fin (R + 3) → ℕ := fun i =>
  if h : i.val < R then ρ ⟨i.val, h⟩ else if i.val = R then p else if i.val = R + 1 then oc
  else tm

/-- Reading a counter register. -/
@[simp] lemma ev_rg (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm : ℕ) (r : Fin R) : ev ρ p oc tm (rg r) = ρ r := by
  simp [ev, rg]
/-- Reading the input position. -/
@[simp] lemma ev_rP (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm : ℕ) : ev ρ p oc tm (rP R) = p := by simp [ev, rP]
/-- Reading the output count. -/
@[simp] lemma ev_rO (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm : ℕ) : ev ρ p oc tm (rO R) = oc := by
  simp [ev, rO]
/-- Reading the scratch register. -/
@[simp] lemma ev_rT (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm : ℕ) : ev ρ p oc tm (rT R) = tm := by
  simp [ev, rT]

/-- Writing a counter register. -/
lemma upd_rg (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm : ℕ) (r : Fin R) (v : ℕ) :
    Function.update (ev ρ p oc tm) (rg r) v = ev (Function.update ρ r v) p oc tm := by
  funext i
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := r
  simp only [Function.update_apply, ev, rg, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_castAdd]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

/-- Writing the input position. -/
lemma upd_rP (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm v : ℕ) :
    Function.update (ev ρ p oc tm) (rP R) v = ev ρ v oc tm := by
  funext i; obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
  simp only [Function.update_apply, ev, rP, Fin.ext_iff]
  split_ifs <;> omega

/-- Writing the output count. -/
lemma upd_rO (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm v : ℕ) :
    Function.update (ev ρ p oc tm) (rO R) v = ev ρ p v tm := by
  funext i; obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
  simp only [Function.update_apply, ev, rO, Fin.ext_iff]
  split_ifs <;> omega

/-- Writing the scratch register. -/
lemma upd_rT (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (p oc tm v : ℕ) :
    Function.update (ev ρ p oc tm) (rT R) v = ev ρ p oc v := by
  funext i; obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
  simp only [Function.update_apply, ev, rT, Fin.ext_iff]
  split_ifs <;> omega

/-- The scratch register is not a counter register. -/
lemma rT_ne_rg (r : Fin R) : rT R ≠ rg r := by
  intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; simp [rT, rg] at this; omega

/-! ## The machine -/

/-- The labels: simulating label `l`, and the auxiliary labels of the output count, the print
loop and the input read. -/
inductive Lb (Λ : Type) where
  | start
  | sim (l : Λ)
  | bump (l : Λ)
  | prL (l : Λ)
  | prC (l : Λ)
  | prB (l : Λ)
  | prT (l : Λ)
  | rdB (l : Λ)
  | rdT (l : Λ)
  | rdF (l : Λ)
  | ans (b : Bool)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Finitely many labels (via an explicit equivalence with `(Unit ⊕ Fin 9 × Λ) ⊕ Bool`). -/
instance [Fintype Λ] : Fintype (Lb Λ) := by
  classical
  let e : Lb Λ ≃ (Unit ⊕ (Fin 9 × Λ)) ⊕ Bool :=
    { toFun := fun q => match q with
        | .start => .inl (.inl ())
        | .sim l => .inl (.inr (0, l))
        | .bump l => .inl (.inr (1, l))
        | .prL l => .inl (.inr (2, l))
        | .prC l => .inl (.inr (3, l))
        | .prB l => .inl (.inr (4, l))
        | .prT l => .inl (.inr (5, l))
        | .rdB l => .inl (.inr (6, l))
        | .rdT l => .inl (.inr (7, l))
        | .rdF l => .inl (.inr (8, l))
        | .ans b => .inr b
      invFun := fun z => match z with
        | .inl (.inl ()) => .start
        | .inl (.inr (i, l)) =>
          match i with
          | 0 => .sim l | 1 => .bump l | 2 => .prL l | 3 => .prC l | 4 => .prB l
          | 5 => .prT l | 6 => .rdB l | 7 => .rdT l | 8 => .rdF l
        | .inr b => .ans b
      left_inv := fun q => by cases q <;> rfl
      right_inv := fun z => by
        rcases z with (⟨⟩ | ⟨i, l⟩) | b
        · rfl
        · fin_cases i <;> rfl
        · rfl }
  exact Fintype.ofEquiv _ e.symm

variable (P : Λ → CounterProg.Instr R Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (lm : Bool)

/-- **The simulating machine.** At `sim l` it executes `P l`: register instructions act on the
corresponding registers; printing a bit compares the output count with the index `p` on the
input (answer if equal, else count); printing a register loops over the scratch register;
reading asks the length decider (`0`) and the bit decider (`1`) about the input position;
`halt` answers `0` (the index is beyond the output). In length mode (`lm`) every printed bit
answers `1`. -/
def A : ARM (R + 3) 2 (Lb Λ) := fun q =>
  match q with
  | .start => .valP (rP R) (.sim l₀)
  | .sim l =>
    match P l with
    | .halt => .ret false
    | .goto l' => .jz (rP R) (.sim l') (.sim l')
    | .out b l' => .jeqIn (rO R) (.ans (lm || b)) (.bump l')
    | .inc r l' => .inc (rg r) (.sim l')
    | .dec r l' => .dec (rg r) (.sim l')
    | .jz r l0 l1 => .jz (rg r) (.sim l0) (.sim l1)
    | .pr _ _ => .clr (rT R) (.prL l)
    | .rd le _ _ => .call 0 .unaryFst [rP R] (.rdB l) (.sim le)
  | .bump l' => .inc (rO R) (.sim l')
  | .prL l =>
    match P l with
    | .pr r l' => .jeq (rT R) (rg r) (.sim l') (.prC l)
    | _ => .ret false
  | .prC l => .jeqIn (rO R) (.ans true) (.prB l)
  | .prB l => .inc (rO R) (.prT l)
  | .prT l => .inc (rT R) (.prL l)
  | .rdB l => .call 1 .unaryFst [rP R] (.rdT l) (.rdF l)
  | .rdT l =>
    match P l with
    | .rd _ _ lt => .inc (rP R) (.sim lt)
    | _ => .ret false
  | .rdF l =>
    match P l with
    | .rd _ lf _ => .inc (rP R) (.sim lf)
    | _ => .ret false
  | .ans b => .ret b

/-- On a well-formed input every configuration meets the syntactic preconditions. -/
lemma preS_A {y : List Bool} (hv : ValidPlain y) (a : AConf (R + 3) (Lb Λ)) :
    PreS (A P l₀ lm) y a := by
  obtain ⟨_ | q, v, res⟩ := a
  · trivial
  · cases q with
    | sim l => cases h : P l <;> simp [PreS, A, h, hv]
    | prL l => cases h : P l <;> simp [PreS, A, h, rT_ne_rg]
    | rdT l => cases h : P l <;> simp [PreS, A, h]
    | rdF l => cases h : P l <;> simp [PreS, A, h]
    | _ => simp [PreS, A, hv]

/-! ## One step -/

/-- The answer for index `p` on output `O`: the bit `O_p`, or in length mode `p < |O|`. -/
def ans (lm : Bool) (O : List Bool) (p : ℕ) : Bool :=
  if lm then decide (p < O.length) else O.getD p false

/-- A running abstract configuration. -/
abbrev cf (q : Lb Λ) (v : Fin (R + 3) → ℕ) : AConf (R + 3) (Lb Λ) := (some q, v, none)

section Step

variable {n p : ℕ} {u : List Bool} {o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool}
  (ho0 : ∀ h, o 0 (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits h)) = decide (h < u.length))
  (ho1 : ∀ h, o 1 (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits h)) = u.getD h false)
  (B : ℕ)

/-- The invariant of the simulation: preconditions, and registers at most `B`. -/
def G (y : List Bool) (a : AConf (R + 3) (Lb Λ)) : Prop :=
  PreS (A P l₀ lm) y a ∧ ∀ r, a.2.1 r ≤ B

variable {P l₀ lm B}

/-- Configurations with all values within `B` satisfy the invariant. -/
lemma G_ev (q : Lb Λ) (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (ps oc tm : ℕ) (hρ : ∀ r, ρ r ≤ B) (hps : ps ≤ B)
    (hoc : oc ≤ B) (htm : tm ≤ B) :
    G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)) (cf q (ev ρ ps oc tm)) := by
  refine ⟨preS_A P l₀ lm ⟨n, _, rfl, canon_bits p⟩ _, fun i => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
  simp only [ev]
  split_ifs
  · exact hρ _
  all_goals assumption

/-- The output-count comparison: `bits oc = bits p` iff `oc = p`. -/
lemma jeqIn_eq (oc : ℕ) :
    (Nat.bits oc = plainWord (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))) ↔ oc = p := by
  rw [plainWord_pairEncode, bits_injective.eq_iff]

/-- **The print loop**, when the whole value fits below the index: from `prL` with scratch
`j` and count `o₀ + j` the machine reaches the next label with count `o₀ + V`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the remaining count `d`: each round goes through `prL` (scratch
`≠` value), `prC` (count `≠ p`), `prB` (count `+1`) and `prT` (scratch `+1`); at `d = 0` the
test at `prL` exits to `sim l'`. -/
lemma pr_reach {l l' : Λ} {r : Fin R} (hP : P l = .pr r l') (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (ps o₀ : ℕ)
    (hρ : ∀ r, ρ r ≤ B) (hps : ps ≤ B) (hle : o₀ + ρ r ≤ p) (hB : o₀ + ρ r ≤ B) :
    ∀ d j, j + d = ρ r →
      AReach (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)))
        (cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) (cf (.sim l') (ev ρ ps (o₀ + ρ r) (ρ r))) := by
  have hL : A P l₀ lm (.prL l) = .jeq (rT R) (rg r) (.sim l') (.prC l) := by simp [A, hP]
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro j hj
    simp only [Nat.add_zero] at hj; subst hj
    refine AReach.step (G_ev _ _ _ _ _ hρ hps (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + ρ r) (ρ r))) = cf (.sim l') (ev ρ ps (o₀ + ρ r) (ρ r)) := by
      simp [astep_jeq hL]
    rw [this]; exact AReach.refl _
  | succ d ih =>
    intro j hj
    have hG := fun q (oc tm : ℕ) (h1 : oc ≤ B) (h2 : tm ≤ B) => G_ev (n := n) (p := p) (P := P)
      (l₀ := l₀) (lm := lm) q ρ ps oc tm hρ hps h1 h2
    refine AReach.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have e1 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) = cf (.prC l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j) := by
      simp [astep_jeq hL, show j ≠ ρ r by omega]
    rw [e1]
    refine AReach.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have e2 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prC l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) = cf (.prB l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j) := by
      simp only [astep_jeqIn (show A P l₀ lm (.prC l) = _ from rfl), ev_rO, jeqIn_eq,
        show o₀ + j ≠ p by omega, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [e2]
    refine AReach.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.prB l) = _ from rfl), ev_rO, upd_rO]
    refine AReach.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.prT l) = _ from rfl), ev_rT, upd_rT]
    have := ih (j + 1) (by omega)
    rwa [show o₀ + j + 1 = o₀ + (j + 1) by ring]

/-- **The print loop**, when the index falls inside the printed block: the machine answers
`1` when the count reaches the index.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the distance `d` from the count to `p`: each round goes through
`prL`, `prC`, `prB`, `prT`; at `d = 0` the comparison at `prC` succeeds and the machine
answers `1`. -/
lemma pr_halt {l l' : Λ} {r : Fin R} (hP : P l = .pr r l') (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (ps o₀ : ℕ)
    (hρ : ∀ r, ρ r ≤ B) (hps : ps ≤ B) (hlt : p < o₀ + ρ r) (hB : o₀ + ρ r ≤ B) :
    ∀ d j, o₀ + j + d = p →
      AHalt (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)))
        (cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) true := by
  have hG := fun q (oc tm : ℕ) (h1 : oc ≤ B) (h2 : tm ≤ B) => G_ev (n := n) (p := p) (P := P)
    (l₀ := l₀) (lm := lm) q ρ ps oc tm hρ hps h1 h2
  have hL : A P l₀ lm (.prL l) = .jeq (rT R) (rg r) (.sim l') (.prC l) := by simp [A, hP]
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro j hj
    refine AHalt.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have e1 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) = cf (.prC l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j) := by
      simp [astep_jeq hL, show j ≠ ρ r by omega]
    rw [e1]
    refine AHalt.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have e2 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prC l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) = cf (.ans true) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j) := by
      simp only [astep_jeqIn (show A P l₀ lm (.prC l) = _ from rfl), ev_rO, jeqIn_eq,
        show o₀ + j = p by omega, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [e2]
    exact AHalt.ret rfl (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega))
  | succ d ih =>
    intro j hj
    refine AHalt.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have e1 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) = cf (.prC l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j) := by
      simp [astep_jeq hL, show j ≠ ρ r by omega]
    rw [e1]
    refine AHalt.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have e2 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (cf (.prC l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j)) = cf (.prB l) (ev ρ ps (o₀ + j) j) := by
      simp only [astep_jeqIn (show A P l₀ lm (.prC l) = _ from rfl), ev_rO, jeqIn_eq,
        show o₀ + j ≠ p by omega, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [e2]
    refine AHalt.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.prB l) = _ from rfl), ev_rO, upd_rO]
    refine AHalt.step (hG _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.prT l) = _ from rfl), ev_rT, upd_rT]
    have := ih (j + 1) (by omega)
    rwa [show o₀ + j + 1 = o₀ + (j + 1) by ring]

include ho0 ho1 in
/-- **One counter step.** From the configuration simulating the counter state
`⟨l, ρ, ps, out⟩` (with `|out| ≤ p`) the machine either answers `0` because `P` halts, or
reaches the configuration simulating the next state, or — if the step prints the `p`-th bit —
answers `ans lm s' p` for the next state `s'`; all through configurations within `B`.

**Proof sketch.** By cases on the instruction: register instructions are one machine step;
printing a bit compares the count with `p` (`jeqIn`); printing a register is the print loop
(`pr_reach`, `pr_halt`); reading asks the length decider, then the bit decider, and advances
the position. -/
lemma sim_step (l : Λ) (ρ : Fin R → ℕ) (ps : ℕ) (out : List Bool) (tm : ℕ)
    (hp : out.length ≤ p) (hρ : ∀ r, ρ r ≤ B) (hps : ps ≤ B) (hout : out.length ≤ B)
    (htm : tm ≤ B) (s' : CounterProg.St R Λ)
    (hs : s' = CounterProg.step P u ⟨some l, ρ, ps, out⟩) (hρ' : ∀ r, s'.regs r ≤ B)
    (hps' : s'.pos ≤ B) (hout' : s'.out.length ≤ B) :
    (s'.lbl = none ∧ s'.out = out ∧
      AHalt (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
        (G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)))
        (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm)) false) ∨
    (∃ l', s'.lbl = some l' ∧
      ((s'.out.length ≤ p ∧ ∃ tm' ≤ B,
        AReach (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
          (G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)))
          (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm))
          (cf (.sim l') (ev s'.regs s'.pos s'.out.length tm')))
      ∨ (p < s'.out.length ∧
        AHalt (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
          (G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)))
          (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm)) (ans lm s'.out p)))) := by
  set y := pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p) with hy
  have hG0 := G_ev (n := n) (p := p) (P := P) (l₀ := l₀) (lm := lm) (.sim l) ρ ps out.length tm
    hρ hps hout htm
  cases hP : P l with
  | halt =>
    left
    have : s' = ⟨none, ρ, ps, out⟩ := by rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl, AHalt.ret (by simp [A, hP]) hG0⟩
  | goto l' =>
    have : s' = ⟨some l', ρ, ps, out⟩ := by rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    refine Or.inr ⟨l', rfl, Or.inl ⟨hp, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩⟩
    have hins : A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .jz (rP R) (.sim l') (.sim l') := by simp [A, hP]
    have : astep (A P l₀ lm) o y (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm)) =
        cf (.sim l') (ev ρ ps out.length tm) := by simp [astep_jz hins]
    rw [this]; exact AReach.refl _
  | out b l' =>
    have : s' = ⟨some l', ρ, ps, out ++ [b]⟩ := by rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hout' ⊢
    refine Or.inr ⟨l', rfl, ?_⟩
    have hins : A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .jeqIn (rO R) (.ans (lm || b)) (.bump l') := by
      simp [A, hP]
    by_cases heq : out.length = p
    · refine Or.inr ⟨by omega, AHalt.step hG0 ?_⟩
      have : astep (A P l₀ lm) o y (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm)) =
          cf (.ans (lm || b)) (ev ρ ps out.length tm) := by
        simp only [astep_jeqIn hins, ev_rO, hy, jeqIn_eq, heq, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [this]
      have ha : ans lm (out ++ [b]) p = (lm || b) := by
        subst heq; cases lm <;> simp [ans, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
      rw [ha]
      exact AHalt.ret rfl (G_ev _ _ _ _ _ hρ hps hout htm)
    · refine Or.inl ⟨by omega, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩
      have : astep (A P l₀ lm) o y (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm)) =
          cf (.bump l') (ev ρ ps out.length tm) := by
        simp only [astep_jeqIn hins, ev_rO, hy, jeqIn_eq, heq, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [this]
      refine AReach.step (G_ev _ _ _ _ _ hρ hps hout htm) ?_
      simp only [astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.bump l') = _ from rfl), ev_rO, upd_rO]
      exact AReach.refl _
  | inc r l' =>
    have : s' = ⟨some l', Function.update ρ r (ρ r + 1), ps, out⟩ := by
      rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    refine Or.inr ⟨l', rfl, Or.inl ⟨hp, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩⟩
    simp only [astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .inc (rg r) (.sim l') by simp [A, hP]),
      ev_rg, upd_rg]
    exact AReach.refl _
  | dec r l' =>
    have : s' = ⟨some l', Function.update ρ r (ρ r - 1), ps, out⟩ := by
      rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    refine Or.inr ⟨l', rfl, Or.inl ⟨hp, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩⟩
    simp only [astep_dec (show A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .dec (rg r) (.sim l') by simp [A, hP]),
      ev_rg, upd_rg]
    exact AReach.refl _
  | jz r l0 l1 =>
    have : s' = ⟨some (if ρ r = 0 then l0 else l1), ρ, ps, out⟩ := by
      rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    refine Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, Or.inl ⟨hp, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩⟩
    have hins : A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .jz (rg r) (.sim l0) (.sim l1) := by simp [A, hP]
    by_cases hr : ρ r = 0
    · simp only [astep_jz hins, ev_rg, hr, ↓reduceIte]; exact AReach.refl _
    · simp only [astep_jz hins, ev_rg, hr, ↓reduceIte]; exact AReach.refl _
  | pr r l' =>
    have : s' = ⟨some l', ρ, ps, out ++ List.replicate (ρ r) true⟩ := by
      rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP]
    subst this
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate] at hout' ⊢
    refine Or.inr ⟨l', rfl, ?_⟩
    have e0 : astep (A P l₀ lm) o y (cf (.sim l) (ev ρ ps out.length tm)) =
        cf (.prL l) (ev ρ ps (out.length + 0) 0) := by
      simp only [astep_clr (show A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .clr (rT R) (.prL l) by simp [A, hP]),
        upd_rT, Nat.add_zero]
    by_cases hle : out.length + ρ r ≤ p
    · refine Or.inl ⟨hle, ρ r, hρ r, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩
      rw [e0]
      exact pr_reach hP ρ ps out.length hρ hps hle hout' (ρ r) 0 (by omega)
    · refine Or.inr ⟨by omega, AHalt.step hG0 ?_⟩
      rw [e0]
      have ha : ans lm (out ++ List.replicate (ρ r) true) p = true := by
        cases lm
        · simp only [ans, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
          rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), List.getElem?_replicate]
          rw [if_pos (by omega)]; rfl
        · simp [ans]; omega
      rw [ha]
      exact pr_halt hP ρ ps out.length hρ hps (by omega) hout' (p - out.length) 0 (by omega)
  | rd le lf lt =>
    have hcall : A P l₀ lm (.sim l) = .call 0 .unaryFst [rP R] (.rdB l) (.sim le) := by
      simp [A, hP]
    cases hx : u[ps]? with
    | none =>
      have : s' = ⟨some le, ρ, ps, out⟩ := by rw [hs]; simp [CounterProg.step, hP, hx]
      subst this
      refine Or.inr ⟨le, rfl, Or.inl ⟨hp, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩⟩
      rw [astep_call₁ _ _ hcall, ho0]
      have : ¬ ps < u.length := by
        intro h; rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem h] at hx; exact absurd hx (by simp)
      simp only [ev_rP, this, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      exact AReach.refl _
    | some b =>
      have hlt : ps < u.length := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hx).1
      have hb : u.getD ps false = b := by simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hx]
      have : s' = ⟨some (if b then lt else lf), ρ, ps + 1, out⟩ := by
        rw [hs]; cases b <;> simp [CounterProg.step, hP, hx]
      subst this
      refine Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, Or.inl ⟨hp, tm, htm, AReach.step hG0 ?_⟩⟩
      rw [astep_call₁ _ _ hcall, ho0]
      simp only [ev_rP, hlt, decide_true, ↓reduceIte]
      refine AReach.step (G_ev _ _ _ _ _ hρ hps hout htm) ?_
      rw [astep_call₁ _ _ (show A P l₀ lm (.rdB l) = .call 1 .unaryFst [rP R] (.rdT l) (.rdF l)
        from rfl), ho1]
      simp only [ev_rP, hb]
      refine AReach.step (G_ev _ _ _ _ _ hρ hps hout htm) ?_
      cases b
      · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
          astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.rdF l) = .inc (rP R) (.sim lf) by simp [A, hP]), ev_rP,
          upd_rP]
        exact AReach.refl _
      · simp only [↓reduceIte,
          astep_inc (show A P l₀ lm (.rdT l) = .inc (rP R) (.sim lt) by simp [A, hP]), ev_rP,
          upd_rP]
        exact AReach.refl _

end Step

end CPSim

end Complexity
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.CounterProgSim

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Counter programs on unary-logspace inputs are unary-logspace

The closure property behind the logspace half of [AB09, Remark 6.7]: if a counter program
(`Complexity.CounterProg`) halts within polynomially many steps on the words `u(n)`, and `u`
is unary-logspace (its bits and length are decidable in logarithmic space from `⟨1ⁿ, i⟩`),
then so is the sequence of its outputs. This is the composition of implicitly logspace
computable functions [AB09, Lemma 4.17] in the special form needed here: the second
function is a polynomial-time counter program, whose registers are therefore polynomially
bounded and fit in `O(log n)` bits.

## Main results

* `Complexity.CPSim.sim_run` — the simulating machine answers for the whole run.
* `Complexity.UnaryLogspace.counterProg` — the closure property.
* `Complexity.CounterProg.length_out_le` — the outputs have polynomial length.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.3, Lemma 4.17; §6.1.1, Remark 6.7.)
-/

namespace Complexity

namespace CPSim

open Turing LogProg

variable {R : ℕ} {Λ : Type} {P : Λ → CounterProg.Instr R Λ} {l₀ : Λ} {lm : Bool}

/-- The answer for an index inside a prefix is the prefix's answer. -/
lemma ans_append (O e : List Bool) {p : ℕ} (hp : p < O.length) :
    ans lm (O ++ e) p = ans lm O p := by
  cases lm
  · simp [ans, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_left hp]
  · simp [ans]; omega

/-- Past the output the answer is `0`. -/
lemma ans_of_le (O : List Bool) {p : ℕ} (hp : O.length ≤ p) : ans lm O p = false := by
  cases lm
  · simp [ans, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_none hp]
  · simp [ans]; omega

/-- The counter state is within `B`. -/
def Bd (B : ℕ) (s : CounterProg.St R Λ) : Prop :=
  (∀ r, s.regs r ≤ B) ∧ s.pos ≤ B ∧ s.out.length ≤ B

section Run

variable {n p : ℕ} {u : List Bool} {o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool}
  (ho0 : ∀ h, o 0 (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits h)) = decide (h < u.length))
  (ho1 : ∀ h, o 1 (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits h)) = u.getD h false)
  {B : ℕ}

include ho0 ho1 in
/-- **The whole run.** From the configuration simulating a running counter state `s` with
`|out| ≤ p`, if `P` halts after `k` more steps, all states within `B`, the machine answers
`ans lm O p` for the final output `O`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `k`, one counter step at a time (`sim_step`): a halting step
answers `0` (the index is past the output); a step printing the `p`-th bit answers it, and
later steps only append (`CounterProg.run_out`, `ans_append`); otherwise continue. -/
lemma sim_run : ∀ (k : ℕ) (s : CounterProg.St R Λ) (tm : ℕ) (l : Λ), s.lbl = some l →
    s.out.length ≤ p → tm ≤ B → (CounterProg.run P u s k).lbl = none →
    (∀ j ≤ k, Bd B (CounterProg.run P u s j)) →
    AHalt (A P l₀ lm) o (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p))
      (G P l₀ lm B (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)))
      (cf (.sim l) (ev s.regs s.pos s.out.length tm)) (ans lm (CounterProg.run P u s k).out p) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro s tm l hl _ _ hk _
    rw [CounterProg.run_zero, hl] at hk; exact absurd hk (by simp)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro s tm l hl hp htm hk hbd
    obtain ⟨lbl, ρ, ps, out⟩ := s
    simp only at hl; subst hl
    obtain ⟨hρ, hps, hout⟩ := hbd 0 (by omega)
    obtain ⟨hρ', hps', hout'⟩ := hbd 1 (by omega)
    rw [CounterProg.run_zero] at hρ hps hout
    rcases sim_step (P := P) (l₀ := l₀) (lm := lm) ho0 ho1 l ρ ps out tm hp hρ hps hout htm
      (CounterProg.step P u ⟨some l, ρ, ps, out⟩) rfl hρ' hps' hout' with
      ⟨hnone, hout1, hh⟩ | ⟨l', hl', (⟨hle, tm', htm', hr⟩ | ⟨hlt, hh⟩)⟩
    · rw [CounterProg.run_succ, CounterProg.run_of_halted _ _ _ hnone, hout1,
        ans_of_le _ hp]
      exact hh
    · rw [CounterProg.run_succ] at hk ⊢
      refine hr.halt (ih _ tm' l' hl' hle htm' hk fun j hj => ?_)
      have := hbd (j + 1) (by omega)
      rwa [CounterProg.run_succ] at this
    · rw [CounterProg.run_succ]
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := CounterProg.run_out P u (CounterProg.step P u ⟨some l, ρ, ps, out⟩) k
      rw [he, ans_append _ _ hlt]
      exact hh

end Run

end CPSim

namespace CounterProg

variable {R : ℕ} {Λ : Type}

/-- **Outputs of polynomially many steps have polynomial length**: `t ≤ C (n + 1)^c` steps
print at most `(C + 1)² (n + 1)^{2c}` bits. -/
theorem length_out_le (P : Λ → Instr R Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (x : List Bool) (C c n t : ℕ)
    (ht : t ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ c) :
    (run P x (init l₀) t).out.length ≤ (C + 1) ^ 2 * (n + 1) ^ (2 * c) := by
  have h := run_init_out_le P x l₀ t
  have h1 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ c := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have e : (C + 1) ^ 2 * (n + 1) ^ (2 * c) = ((C + 1) * (n + 1) ^ c) ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [e]
  have : t + 1 ≤ (C + 1) * (n + 1) ^ c := by nlinarith
  nlinarith

end CounterProg

open Turing LogProg CPSim in
/-- **Counter programs preserve unary-logspace sequences** [AB09, Lemma 4.17, for a
polynomial-time counter program as the outer function]: if `u` is unary-logspace and the
counter program `P` halts on every `u(n)` within `C (n + 1)^c` steps with output `g(n)`, then
`g` is unary-logspace.

**Proof sketch.** For each of the two languages, `arm_decides_poly` with the simulating
machine `CPSim.A` (length or bit mode) and the deciders of `u`: on `⟨1ⁿ, bits p⟩` the
machine validates the input and runs `sim_run` from the initial state. Within `t ≤ N =
C (n + 1)^c` steps the registers are at most `N`, the input position at most `N`, the output
count at most `N (N + 1)` (`CounterProg.run_init_out_le`), so all registers are below
`(N + 1)² ≤ (C + 1)² (|y| + 1)^{2c}`. Malformed inputs are rejected at once. -/
theorem UnaryLogspace.counterProg {R : ℕ} {Λ : Type} [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ]
    (P : Λ → CounterProg.Instr R Λ) (l₀ : Λ) {u g : ℕ → List Bool} (hu : UnaryLogspace u)
    (C c : ℕ) (hrun : ∀ n, ∃ t ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ c,
      (CounterProg.run P (u n) (CounterProg.init l₀) t).lbl = none ∧
      (CounterProg.run P (u n) (CounterProg.init l₀) t).out = g n) :
    UnaryLogspace g := by
  let As : Fin 2 → Language Bool := fun j => if j = 0 then uLen u else uBit u
  have hAs : ∀ j, As j ∈ LOGSPACE := by
    intro j; fin_cases j
    · exact hu.2
    · exact hu.1
  have key : ∀ lm : Bool, (if lm then uLen g else uBit g) ∈ LOGSPACE := by
    intro lm
    refine arm_decides_poly (A P l₀ lm) .start As hAs ((C + 1) ^ 2) (2 * c) fun y => ?_
    by_cases hv : ValidPlain y
    · obtain ⟨n, w, rfl, hw⟩ := hv
      rw [canon_eq_bits w hw]
      set p := bitsVal w
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hhalt, hout⟩ := hrun n
      set N := C * (n + 1) ^ c with hN
      set B := (N + 1) ^ 2 with hB
      have ho0 : ∀ h, (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) 0
          (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits h)) = decide (h < (u n).length) := by
        intro h
        simp only [As, ↓reduceIte, indicator_eq_decide]
        exact decide_eq_decide.mpr (mem_uLen u n h)
      have ho1 : ∀ h, (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) 1
          (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits h)) = (u n).getD h false := by
        intro h
        show MultiTapeTM.indicator (uBit u : Set (List Bool)) _ = _
        have := mem_uBit u n h
        unfold MultiTapeTM.indicator
        split_ifs with hm <;> cases hb : (u n).getD h false <;> simp_all
      have hbd : ∀ j ≤ t, Bd B (CounterProg.run P (u n) (CounterProg.init l₀) j) := by
        intro j hj
        have hjN : j ≤ N := hj.trans ht
        have hNB : N * (N + 1) ≤ B := by simp only [hB]; nlinarith
        have hNN : N ≤ N * (N + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
        refine ⟨fun r => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have := CounterProg.run_regs_le P (u n) (CounterProg.init l₀) r j
          have h0 : (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).regs r = 0 := rfl
          omega
        · have := CounterProg.run_pos_le P (u n) (CounterProg.init l₀) j
          have h0 : (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).pos = 0 := rfl
          omega
        · have := CounterProg.run_init_out_le P (u n) l₀ j
          have : j * (j + 1) ≤ N * (N + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul hjN (by omega)
          omega
      have hrunA := sim_run (P := P) (l₀ := l₀) (lm := lm) (B := B) (n := n) (p := p)
        (o := fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) ho0 ho1 t
        (CounterProg.init l₀) 0 l₀ rfl (by simp [CounterProg.init]) (Nat.zero_le _) hhalt hbd
      rw [hout] at hrunA
      have hans : ans lm (g n) p = MultiTapeTM.indicator
          ((if lm then uLen g else uBit g : Language Bool) : Set (List Bool))
          (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)) := by
        cases lm
        · show (g n).getD p false = MultiTapeTM.indicator (uBit g : Set (List Bool)) _
          have := mem_uBit g n p
          unfold MultiTapeTM.indicator
          split_ifs with hm <;> cases hb : (g n).getD p false <;> simp_all
        · show decide (p < (g n).length) = MultiTapeTM.indicator (uLen g : Set (List Bool)) _
          have := mem_uLen g n p
          unfold MultiTapeTM.indicator
          split_ifs with hm <;> simp_all
      rw [← hans]
      have hval : ValidPlain (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)) :=
        ⟨n, _, rfl, canon_bits p⟩
      have hev : (fun _ => 0 : Fin (R + 3) → ℕ) =
          ev (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).regs (CounterProg.init l₀ :
            CounterProg.St R Λ).pos (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).out.length 0 := by
        funext i; simp only [ev, CounterProg.init]; split_ifs <;> rfl
      refine AHalt.step ⟨preS_A P l₀ lm hval _, fun r => by simp⟩ ?_
      have : astep (A P l₀ lm) (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V)
          (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)) (some .start, fun _ => 0, none) =
          cf (.sim l₀) (ev (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).regs
            (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).pos
            (CounterProg.init l₀ : CounterProg.St R Λ).out.length 0) := by
        rw [← hev]; simp [astep_valP (show A P l₀ lm .start = _ from rfl), hval]
      rw [this]
      refine hrunA.mono fun a ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, fun r => (h2 r).trans ?_⟩
      have hn : n + 1 ≤ (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)).length + 1 := by
        simp [pairEncode_eq_dbl, dbl_replicate]; omega
      have h1 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ c := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
      calc B = (C * (n + 1) ^ c + 1) ^ 2 := rfl
        _ ≤ ((C + 1) * (n + 1) ^ c) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by nlinarith) 2
        _ = (C + 1) ^ 2 * (n + 1) ^ (2 * c) := by ring
        _ ≤ (C + 1) ^ 2 * ((pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (Nat.bits p)).length + 1) ^
            (2 * c) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hn _)
    · have hn : MultiTapeTM.indicator ((if lm then uLen g else uBit g : Language Bool) :
          Set (List Bool)) y = false := by
        rw [indicator_eq_decide]
        simp only [decide_eq_false_iff_not]
        intro h
        cases lm
        · exact hv (validPlain_of_mem_unaryIdx (p := fun n i => (g n).getD i false = true) h)
        · exact hv (validPlain_of_mem_unaryIdx (p := fun n i => i < (g n).length) h)
      rw [hn]
      refine ⟨1, ?_, ?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
      · simp [arun, astep_valP (show A P l₀ lm .start = _ from rfl), hv]
      · simp [arun, astep_valP (show A P l₀ lm .start = _ from rfl), hv]
      · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
        exact ⟨by simp [arun, PreS, A], fun r => by simp [arun]⟩
  exact ⟨by simpa using key false, by simpa using key true⟩

end Complexity
```

```
/-
