import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.ExpBFS.Machine

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Routines of the search machine

Run lemmas for the straight-line parts of the breadth-first search memory machine
`Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.A`: single steps (`step_of`, `mright_of`, …), the loop sites
(instances of the generic loops of `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMLoops`,
transferred to the memory machine by `Complexity.LogProg.MReach.of_areach`), a memory access
(`ac_run`: walk the head out to `Bs + idx`, read or set the bit, walk back), the setup
(`setup_run`) and the width computation (`wk_run`).

Infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1.1, proof of Theorem 4.2]; not itself a result of the book.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.G` — the guard: registers at most `B`, the memory head in
  `[0, P]`.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.preS_A` — the machine meets the syntactic preconditions.
* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.ac_run` — a memory access.
* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.setup_run`, `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.wk_run`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1, Theorem 4.2.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

namespace ExpBFS

open Turing

variable {K₀ : ℕ}

/-- The deterministic part of the search machine. -/
abbrev Ad (K₀ : ℕ) : ARM 17 4 (Lb K₀) := (A K₀).detPart false

/-- A configuration of the search machine with a named register file. -/
abbrev cf (l : Lb K₀) (st : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) : MConf 17 (Lb K₀) :=
  ((some l, st.toV, none), (M, p))

/-- The radius registers are not `U`. -/
lemma rad_ne_U (p : Ph3) : rU ≠ rad p := by cases p <;> decide

/-- The radius registers are neither `U` nor `V`. -/
lemma rad_ne_V (p : Ph3) : rV ≠ rad p := by cases p <;> decide

/-- **The search machine meets the syntactic preconditions** everywhere: its equality tests
compare distinct registers and its calls have distinct arguments. -/
lemma preS_A (x : List Bool) (a : AConf 17 (Lb K₀)) : PreS (Ad K₀) x a := by
  rcases a with ⟨_ | l, v, res⟩
  · trivial
  · cases l with
    | iC φ => simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, rad_ne_U]
    | rlS φ => cases φ <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, rad, toPh] <;> decide
    | d1 i => simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A]
    | fz i => simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A]
    | nz i => by_cases h : i.val = 0 <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, h]
    | cp k j => fin_cases j <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, cpI]
    | mv j => fin_cases j <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, mvI]
    | sh p j => fin_cases j <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, shI]
    | ac st ph =>
      rcases ph with j | _ | ⟨b, j⟩
      · fin_cases j <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, acI]
      · by_cases h : st.set <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, acI, h]
      · fin_cases j <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, acI]
    | _ => simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A] <;> decide

variable {orc : Fin 4 → List Bool → Bool} {x : List Bool} {B P : ℕ}

/-- **The guard** of the search machine's runs: the syntactic preconditions, every register
at most `B`, the memory head in `[0, P]`. -/
def G (x : List Bool) (B P : ℕ) (c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)) : Prop :=
  GuardLe (Ad K₀) x B c.1 ∧ 0 ≤ c.2.2 ∧ c.2.2 ≤ P

/-- A bounded register file with the memory head in range meets the guard. -/
lemma g_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (l : Lb K₀) : G x B P (cf l st M p) := ⟨⟨preS_A x _, hbd.toV⟩, hp⟩

/-- One register step from a bounded register file. -/
lemma step_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l : Lb K₀} {i : Ins 17 4 (Lb K₀)}
    {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)} (hA : A K₀ l = .det i) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (astep (fun _ => i) orc x (some l, st.toV, none), (M, p))
      c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c := by
  refine MReach.step (g_of hbd hp l) ?_
  have e : mstep (A K₀) orc x (cf l st M p) =
      (astep (fun _ => i) orc x (some l, st.toV, none), (M, p)) := by
    simp only [mstep, hA]
  rw [e]; exact h

/-- One halting register step from a bounded register file. -/
lemma stepH_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l : Lb K₀} {i : Ins 17 4 (Lb K₀)} {r : Bool}
    (hA : A K₀ l = .det i) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MHalt (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (astep (fun _ => i) orc x (some l, st.toV, none), (M, p))
      r) :
    MHalt (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) r := by
  refine MHalt.step (g_of hbd hp l) ?_
  have e : mstep (A K₀) orc x (cf l st M p) =
      (astep (fun _ => i) orc x (some l, st.toV, none), (M, p)) := by
    simp only [mstep, hA]
  rw [e]; exact h

/-- A memory head move to the right. -/
lemma mright_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l l' : Lb K₀} {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)}
    (hA : A K₀ l = .mright l') (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l' st M (p + 1)) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c := by
  refine MReach.step (g_of hbd hp l) ?_
  have e : mstep (A K₀) orc x (cf l st M p) = cf l' st M (p + 1) := by simp only [cf, mstep, hA]
  rw [e]; exact h

/-- A memory head move to the left. -/
lemma mleft_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l l' : Lb K₀} {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)}
    (hA : A K₀ l = .mleft l') (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l' st M (p - 1)) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c := by
  refine MReach.step (g_of hbd hp l) ?_
  have e : mstep (A K₀) orc x (cf l st M p) = cf l' st M (p - 1) := by simp only [cf, mstep, hA]
  rw [e]; exact h

/-- Setting the memory bit under the head. -/
lemma mset_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l l' : Lb K₀} {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)}
    (hA : A K₀ l = .mset l') (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l' st (Function.update M p true) p) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c := by
  refine MReach.step (g_of hbd hp l) ?_
  have e : mstep (A K₀) orc x (cf l st M p) = cf l' st (Function.update M p true) p := by
    simp only [cf, mstep, hA]
  rw [e]; exact h

/-- Branching on the memory bit under the head. -/
lemma mread_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l l₁ l₀ : Lb K₀} {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)}
    (hA : A K₀ l = .mread l₁ l₀) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (if M p then l₁ else l₀) st M p) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c := by
  refine MReach.step (g_of hbd hp l) ?_
  have e : mstep (A K₀) orc x (cf l st M p) = cf (if M p then l₁ else l₀) st M p := by
    simp only [cf, mstep, hA]
  rw [e]; exact h

/-- Continue a run from an equal register file. -/
lemma cont {st st' : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l : Lb K₀} {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)}
    (e : st = st') (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st' M p) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c := e ▸ h

/-- Transfer a run of the deterministic part through `GuardLe` to the search machine. -/
lemma of_areach {a a' : AConf 17 (Lb K₀)} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : AReach (Ad K₀) orc x (GuardLe (Ad K₀) x B) a a') (hlive : a'.1 ≠ none) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (a, (M, p)) (a', (M, p)) :=
  (MReach.of_areach (M, p) h hlive).mono fun c ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, by rw [h2]; exact hp⟩

/-- A clear step. -/
lemma clr_step {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l l' : Lb K₀} {r : Fin 17}
    {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)} (hA : A K₀ l = .det (.clr r l')) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) ((some l', Function.update st.toV r 0, none), (M, p)) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c :=
  step_of hA hbd hp h

/-- An increment step. -/
lemma inc_step {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l l' : Lb K₀} {r : Fin 17}
    {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)} (hA : A K₀ l = .det (.inc r l')) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P)
      ((some l', Function.update st.toV r (st.toV r + 1), none), (M, p)) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c :=
  step_of hA hbd hp h

/-! ## Loop sites -/

/-- Copy sites have distinct registers, all different from `Z`. -/
lemma cp_ne (k : CpS K₀) : cpSrc k ≠ cpDst k ∧ cpSrc k ≠ rZ ∧ cpDst k ≠ rZ := by
  rcases k with p | p | ⟨p, i⟩ | p | p | p | st | st | _
  · cases p <;> simp only [cpSrc, cpDst, rad] <;> decide
  all_goals first
    | (simp only [cpSrc, cpDst]; decide)
    | (cases st <;> simp only [cpSrc, cpDst, Site.idx] <;> decide)

/-- **A copy site** adds the source to the target. -/
theorem cp_run (k : CpS K₀) (st : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (hbd : st.Bd B) (hZ : st.Z = 0) (hb : st.toV (cpDst k) + st.toV (cpSrc k) ≤ B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.cp k 0) st M p)
      ((some (cpExit k), Function.update st.toV (cpDst k)
        (st.toV (cpDst k) + st.toV (cpSrc k)), none), (M, p)) :=
  of_areach hp (copy_run (A := Ad K₀) (oracle := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (l := .cp k 0)
    (l1 := .cp k 1) (l2 := .cp k 2) (l3 := .cp k 3) (l4 := .cp k 4) (l5 := .cp k 5)
    (l6 := .cp k 6) (lx := cpExit k) (cp_ne k).1 (cp_ne k).2.1 (cp_ne k).2.2 rfl rfl rfl rfl
    rfl rfl rfl _ hZ hbd.toV hb) (by simp)

/-- **The shift site** of phase `p` multiplies `K` by `2 ^ C` and clears `C`. -/
theorem sh_run (q : Ph3) (st : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (hbd : st.Bd B) (hZ : st.Z = 0) (hb : st.K * 2 ^ st.C ≤ B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.sh q 0) st M p)
      (cf (.cp (.KB1 q) 0) { st with C := 0, K := st.K * 2 ^ st.C } M p) := by
  have h := shl_run (A := Ad K₀) (oracle := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (c := rC) (r := rK) (z := rZ)
    (l := .sh q 0) (l1 := .sh q 1) (l2 := .sh q 2) (l3 := .sh q 3) (l4 := .sh q 4)
    (l5 := .sh q 5) (l6 := .sh q 6) (l7 := .sh q 7) (l8 := .sh q 8) (lx := .cp (.KB1 q) 0)
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl _ st.toV rfl hZ
    hbd.toV hb
  regs at h
  exact of_areach hp h (by simp)

/-- **The move site** `c1 := c1 + c`, `c := 0`. -/
theorem mv_run (st : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P) (hbd : st.Bd B)
    (hb : st.c1 + st.c ≤ B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.mv 0) st M p)
      (cf (.cp .s1 0) { st with c := 0, c1 := st.c1 + st.c } M p) := by
  have h := move_run (A := Ad K₀) (oracle := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (r := rc) (t := rc1)
    (l := .mv 0) (l1 := .mv 1) (l2 := .mv 2) (lx := .cp .s1 0) (by decide) rfl rfl rfl _
    st.toV rfl hbd.toV hb
  regs at h
  exact of_areach hp h (by simp)

/-- Rewriting the end configuration of a run along equal register files and head positions. -/
lemma reach_cf {a : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)} {l : Lb K₀} {st st' : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p p' : ℤ}
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) a (cf l st M p)) (e1 : st = st') (e2 : p = p') :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) a (cf l st' M p') := e1 ▸ e2 ▸ h

/-! ## Memory accesses -/

/-- The index register of an access site is `U` or `V`. -/
lemma idx_cases (st : Site) : st.idx = rU ∨ st.idx = rV := by
  cases st <;> simp [Site.idx]

/-- **The outward walk**: from `wo 0` with `T = k`, the head moves `k` cells right while `T`
counts down to `0` and `T2` counts up by `k`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `k`; one round is `jz`, `dec T`, `inc T2`, `mright`. -/
theorem wo_run (st : Site) : ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ), S.T = k → S.Bd B →
    S.T2 + k ≤ B → 0 ≤ p → p + k ≤ P →
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.ac st (.wo 0)) S M p)
      (cf (.ac st .op) { S with T := 0, T2 := S.T2 + k } M (p + k)) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro S M p hT hbd hb hp0 hpP
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨hp0, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_jz (A := fun _ => Ins.jz _ _ _) rfl, St.toV_T, hT, ↓reduceIte]
    exact reach_cf (MReach.refl _) (by ext <;> simp [hT]) (by simp)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro S M p hT hbd hb hp0 hpP
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨hp0, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_jz (A := fun _ => Ins.jz _ _ _) rfl, St.toV_T, hT, Nat.add_one_ne_zero,
      ↓reduceIte]
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨hp0, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_dec (A := fun _ => Ins.dec _ _) rfl]; regs [hT, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with T := k } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
    refine step_of rfl hbd1 ⟨hp0, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_inc (A := fun _ => Ins.inc _ _) rfl]; regs
    have hbd2 : St.Bd B { S with T := k, T2 := S.T2 + 1 } := by
      simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
    refine mright_of rfl hbd2 ⟨hp0, by omega⟩ ?_
    refine reach_cf (ih _ M (p + 1) rfl hbd2 (by simp only; omega) (by omega)
      (by push_cast at hpP ⊢; omega)) (by ext <;> simp; omega) (by push_cast; ring)

/-- **The return walk**: from `wb b 0` with `T2 = k`, the head moves `k` cells left while `T2`
counts down to `0`, and the access exits with the bit `b`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `k`; one round is `jz`, `dec T2`, `mleft`. -/
theorem wb_run (st : Site) (b : Bool) : ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ), S.T2 = k →
    S.Bd B → 0 ≤ p - k → p ≤ P →
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.ac st (.wb b 0)) S M p)
      (cf (acExit st b) { S with T2 := 0 } M (p - k)) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro S M p hT hbd hp0 hpP
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨by omega, hpP⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_jz (A := fun _ => Ins.jz _ _ _) rfl, St.toV_T2, hT, ↓reduceIte]
    exact reach_cf (MReach.refl _) (by ext <;> simp [hT]) (by simp)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro S M p hT hbd hp0 hpP
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨by omega, hpP⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_jz (A := fun _ => Ins.jz _ _ _) rfl, St.toV_T2, hT, Nat.add_one_ne_zero,
      ↓reduceIte]
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨by omega, hpP⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_dec (A := fun _ => Ins.dec _ _) rfl]; regs [hT, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with T2 := k } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
    refine mleft_of rfl hbd1 ⟨by omega, hpP⟩ ?_
    refine reach_cf (ih _ M (p - 1) rfl hbd1 (by push_cast at hp0 ⊢; omega) (by omega))
      (by ext <;> simp) (by push_cast; ring)

/-- **A memory access** at site `st`, from the start of its two copies with `T`, `T2`, `Z`
clear and the memory head at `0`: the access ends at the site's exit for the bit read at
`Bs + idx` (or `true` after setting it), with the same register file and the head back at `0`;
a setting site sets the bit at `Bs + idx`.

**Proof sketch.** Copy `Bs` and the index into `T` (`cp_run`), walk out (`wo_run`), read or
set (`mread_of`, `mset_of`), walk back (`wb_run`). -/
theorem ac_run (st : Site) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (hbd : S.Bd B) (hT : S.T = 0)
    (hT2 : S.T2 = 0) (hZ : S.Z = 0) (hB : S.Bs + S.toV st.idx ≤ B)
    (hP : S.Bs + S.toV st.idx ≤ P) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.cp (.aB st) 0) S M 0)
      (cf (acExit st (st.set || M ((S.Bs + S.toV st.idx : ℕ) : ℤ))) S
        (if st.set then Function.update M ((S.Bs + S.toV st.idx : ℕ) : ℤ) true else M) 0) := by
  set u := S.toV st.idx with hu
  have h1 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.aB st) S M 0
    ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩
    hbd hZ (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; omega)
  simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h1
  regs at h1
  simp only [hT, zero_add] at h1
  have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with T := S.Bs } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have hidx1 : ({ S with T := S.Bs } : St).toV st.idx = u := by
    rcases idx_cases st with h | h <;> simp [hu, h]
  have h2 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.aI st)
    { S with T := S.Bs } M 0
    ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ hbd1 (by simpa using hZ) (by
      simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; rw [hidx1]; simp only [St.toV_T]; omega)
  simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h2
  rw [hidx1] at h2
  regs at h2
  have hbd2 : St.Bd B { S with T := S.Bs + u } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have h3 := wo_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) st (S.Bs + u)
    { S with T := S.Bs + u } M 0 rfl hbd2 (by simp only; omega) le_rfl (by push_cast; omega)
  simp only [zero_add] at h3
  set S3 : St := { S with T := 0, T2 := S.Bs + u } with hS3
  have hS3' : ({ ({ S with T := S.Bs + u } : St) with T := 0, T2 := S.T2 + (S.Bs + u) } : St)
      = S3 := by ext <;> simp [hS3, hT2]
  rw [hS3'] at h3
  have hbd3 : S3.Bd B := by simp only [hS3, St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have hend : ({ S3 with T2 := 0 } : St) = S := by ext <;> simp [hS3, hT, hT2]
  refine ((h1.trans h2).trans h3).trans ?_
  by_cases hs : st.set
  · refine mset_of (l' := .ac st (.wb true 0)) (by simp [A, acI, hs]) hbd3
      ⟨by omega, by push_cast; omega⟩ ?_
    have h4 := wb_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) st true (S.Bs + u) S3
      (Function.update M ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ) true) ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ) rfl hbd3 (by simp)
      (by push_cast; omega)
    simp only [hs, Bool.true_or, ↓reduceIte]
    exact reach_cf h4 hend (by simp)
  · refine mread_of (l₁ := .ac st (.wb true 0)) (l₀ := .ac st (.wb false 0))
      (by simp [A, acI, hs]) hbd3 ⟨by omega, by push_cast; omega⟩ ?_
    have h4 := wb_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) st
      (M ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ)) (S.Bs + u) S3 M ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ) rfl hbd3 (by simp)
      (by push_cast; omega)
    simp only [hs, Bool.false_or, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    have e : (if M ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ) = true then Lb.ac st (.wb true 0)
        else Lb.ac st (.wb false 0)) = Lb.ac (K₀ := K₀) st (.wb (M ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ)) 0) := by
      cases M ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ) <;> rfl
    rw [e]
    exact reach_cf h4 hend (by simp)

/-! ## The setup -/

/-- The number of halvings that take `k` to `0`. -/
def hv (k : ℕ) : ℕ := if k = 0 then 0 else Nat.log 2 k + 1

/-- One halving less. -/
lemma hv_div (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) : hv k = hv (k / 2) + 1 := by
  unfold hv
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 2 with h | h
  · obtain rfl : k = 1 := by omega
    simp
  · have h2 : k / 2 ≠ 0 := by omega
    rw [if_neg hk, if_neg h2, Nat.log_of_one_lt_of_le (by decide) h]

/-- The value of `Lg` after the setup: `1 +` the number of halvings of `|x|`. -/
def lgv (n : ℕ) : ℕ := 1 + hv n

/-- `Lg` bounds the logarithm of the input length. -/
lemma logSpace_le_lgv (n : ℕ) : logSpace n ≤ lgv n := by
  unfold lgv hv logSpace
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; simp
  · omega

/-- `Lg` exceeds the logarithm of the input length by at most one. -/
lemma lgv_le (n : ℕ) : lgv n ≤ logSpace n + 1 := by
  unfold lgv hv logSpace
  split_ifs <;> omega

/-- `Lg` is at most `|x| + 1`. -/
lemma lgv_le_succ (n : ℕ) : lgv n ≤ n + 1 := by
  unfold lgv hv
  split_ifs with h
  · omega
  · have := Nat.log_lt_self 2 h
    omega

/-- **The logarithm loop**: from `lg0` with `N = k`, the machine halves `N` to `0`, adding the
number of halvings to `Lg`, and reaches the first width computation.

**Proof sketch.** Strong induction on `k` (`hv_div`). -/
theorem lg_run : ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool), S.N = k → S.Bd B → S.Lg + hv k ≤ B →
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf .lg0 S M 0)
      (cf (.cp (.radX .fst) 0) { S with N := 0, Lg := S.Lg + hv k } M 0) := by
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ k ih =>
  intro S M hN hbd hb
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst hk
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_jz (A := fun _ => Ins.jz _ _ _) rfl]; regs [hN, ↓reduceIte]
    exact reach_cf (MReach.refl _) (by ext <;> simp [hN, hv]) rfl
  · refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_jz (A := fun _ => Ins.jz _ _ _) rfl]; regs [hN, hk, ↓reduceIte]
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_half (A := fun _ => Ins.half _ _) rfl]; regs [hN]
    have hdiv := hv_div k hk
    have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with N := k / 2 } := by
      simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩; omega
    refine step_of rfl hbd1 ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_inc (A := fun _ => Ins.inc _ _) rfl]; regs
    have hbd2 : St.Bd B { S with N := k / 2, Lg := S.Lg + 1 } := by
      simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
    exact reach_cf (ih (k / 2) (by omega) _ M rfl hbd2 (by simp only; omega))
      (by ext <;> simp; omega) rfl

/-- **The setup**: from `scan` with all registers clear, the machine counts the input length
into `N`, sets `Lg := 1` and runs the logarithm loop, reaching the first width computation with
`Lg = lgv |x|` and every other register clear.

**Proof sketch.** `inputLength_loop` (asking decider `0`) on the deterministic part,
transferred by `of_areach`; one increment; `lg_run`. -/
theorem setup_run (hq : ∀ k ≤ x.length, orc 0 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits k)) = decide (k < x.length))
    (M : ℤ → Bool) (hB : x.length + 2 ≤ B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf .scan St.zero M 0)
      (cf (.cp (.radX .fst) 0) { St.zero with Lg := lgv x.length } M 0) := by
  have hbd0 : St.zero.Bd B := by simp only [St.Bd, St.zero]; omega
  have h := inputLength_loop (Ad K₀) orc x rN 0 .scan .incN .lgI rfl rfl hq B (by omega)
    St.zero.toV hbd0.toV (by simp [St.zero])
  regs at h
  refine (of_areach (P := P) (M := M) ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ h (by simp)).trans ?_
  have hbd1 : St.Bd B { St.zero with N := x.length } := by simp only [St.Bd, St.zero]; omega
  refine step_of rfl hbd1 ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ ?_
  simp only [astep_inc (A := fun _ => Ins.inc _ _) rfl]; regs
  have hbd2 : St.Bd B { St.zero with N := x.length, Lg := 1 } := by
    simp only [St.Bd, St.zero]; omega
  have hhv : hv x.length ≤ x.length := by
    have := lgv_le_succ x.length
    unfold lgv at this
    omega
  exact reach_cf (lg_run x.length _ M rfl (by simpa [St.zero] using hbd2)
    (by simp [St.zero]; omega)) (by ext <;> simp [St.zero, lgv]) rfl

/-! ## The width computation -/

/-- **The multiplication chain**: from the `i`-th copy of `X` into `w`, with `w = i · X`, the
machine reaches `wkC` with `w = K₀ · X`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `K₀ - i`, each step a copy site. -/
theorem mw_run (q : Ph3) : ∀ (j i : ℕ) (hi : i < K₀) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool), K₀ - i = j →
    S.w = i * S.X → S.Z = 0 → S.Bd B → K₀ * S.X ≤ B →
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.cp (.mw q ⟨i, hi⟩) 0) S M 0)
      (cf (.wkC q) { S with w := K₀ * S.X } M 0) := by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => intro i hi; omega
  | succ j ih =>
    intro i hi S M hj hw hZ hbd hb
    have hle : (i + 1) * S.X ≤ K₀ * S.X := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    have hwX : S.w + S.X ≤ B := by rw [hw, ← Nat.succ_mul]; exact hle.trans hb
    have h := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.mw q ⟨i, hi⟩) S M 0
      ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ hbd hZ (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; exact hwX)
    simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h
    regs at h
    have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with w := S.w + S.X } := by
      simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
    by_cases hlt : i + 1 < K₀
    · rw [dif_pos hlt] at h
      refine h.trans (reach_cf (ih (i + 1) hlt _ M (by omega) (by simp only; rw [hw]; ring) hZ
        hbd1 (by simpa using hb)) (by ext <;> simp) rfl)
    · rw [dif_neg hlt] at h
      have hK : K₀ = i + 1 := by omega
      exact reach_cf h (by ext <;> simp [hw, hK]; ring) rfl

/-- The register file after a width computation of phase `q` at radius `r`. -/
def wkSt (q : Ph3) (S : St) (r : ℕ) : St :=
  { S with
    w := K₀ * (r + S.Lg + 1)
    K := 2 ^ (K₀ * (r + S.Lg + 1))
    Bs := (if q = .snd then 1 else 2) * 2 ^ (K₀ * (r + S.Lg + 1)) }

/-- **The width computation**: from its first copy, with `X`, `w`, `K`, `Bs`, `C`, `Z`
clear, the machine computes `w = K₀ (r + Lg + 1)` for the phase's radius `r`, `K = 2 ^ w` and
the base `Bs` (`K` for the second search, else `2K`), and reaches the phase's exit.

**Proof sketch.** Copies (`cp_run`) and the multiplication chain (`mw_run`) compute `w`, the
shift site (`sh_run`) computes `K`, copies compute `Bs`. -/
theorem wk_run (q : Ph3) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (hX : S.X = 0) (hw : S.w = 0) (hK : S.K = 0)
    (hBs : S.Bs = 0) (hC : S.C = 0) (hZ : S.Z = 0) (hK0 : 0 < K₀) (hbd : S.Bd B)
    (hB : 3 * 2 ^ (K₀ * (S.toV (rad q) + S.Lg + 1)) ≤ B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.cp (.radX q) 0) S M 0)
      (cf (wkExit q) (wkSt (K₀ := K₀) q S (S.toV (rad q))) M 0) := by
  set r := S.toV (rad q) with hr
  set w := K₀ * (r + S.Lg + 1) with hwd
  have hw2 : w < 2 ^ w := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  have hX1 : r + S.Lg + 1 ≤ w := by
    calc r + S.Lg + 1 = 1 * (r + S.Lg + 1) := (one_mul _).symm
      _ ≤ w := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hK0
  have hp : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 0 ∧ (0 : ℤ) ≤ P := ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩
  -- `X := r`
  have h1 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.radX q) S M 0 hp hbd hZ
    (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; rw [← hr]; regs; omega)
  simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h1
  rw [← hr] at h1
  regs [hX, zero_add] at h1
  -- `X := r + Lg`
  have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with X := r } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have h2 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.lgX q)
    { S with X := r } M 0 hp
    hbd1 hZ (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; omega)
  simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h2
  regs at h2
  refine (h1.trans h2).trans ?_
  -- `X := r + Lg + 1`
  have hbd2 : St.Bd B { S with X := r + S.Lg } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  refine step_of rfl hbd2 hp ?_
  simp only [astep_inc (A := fun _ => Ins.inc _ _) rfl, dif_pos hK0]; regs
  -- `w := K₀ · X`
  have hbd3 : St.Bd B { S with X := r + S.Lg + 1 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have h3 := mw_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) q K₀ 0 hK0
    { S with X := r + S.Lg + 1 }
    M (by omega) (by simp [hw]) hZ hbd3 (by simp only; omega)
  refine h3.trans ?_
  -- `X := 0`, `K := 1`
  have hbd4 : St.Bd B { S with X := r + S.Lg + 1, w := w } := by
    simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  refine step_of rfl hbd4 hp ?_
  simp only [astep_clr (A := fun _ => Ins.clr _ _) rfl]; regs
  refine cont (st' := { S with w := w }) (by ext <;> simp [hX, hwd]) ?_
  have hbd5 : St.Bd B { S with w := w } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  refine step_of rfl hbd5 hp ?_
  simp only [astep_inc (A := fun _ => Ins.inc _ _) rfl]; regs
  refine cont (st' := { S with w := w, K := 1 }) (by ext <;> simp [hK]) ?_
  -- `C := w`
  have hbd6 : St.Bd B { S with w := w, K := 1 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have h4 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.wC q)
    { S with w := w, K := 1 } M 0 hp hbd6 hZ (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; omega)
  simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h4
  regs at h4
  refine (reach_cf h4 (st' := { S with w := w, K := 1, C := w }) (by ext <;> simp [hC])
    rfl).trans ?_
  -- `K := 2 ^ w`
  have hbd7 : St.Bd B { S with w := w, K := 1, C := w } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have h5 := sh_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) q
    { S with w := w, K := 1, C := w } M 0 hp hbd7 hZ (by simp only; omega)
  refine (reach_cf h5 (st' := { S with w := w, K := 2 ^ w }) (by ext <;> simp [hC])
    rfl).trans ?_
  -- `Bs := K` (and once more)
  have hbd8 : St.Bd B { S with w := w, K := 2 ^ w } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have h6 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.KB1 q)
    { S with w := w, K := 2 ^ w } M 0 hp hbd8 hZ (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; omega)
  simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h6
  regs at h6
  refine (reach_cf h6 (st' := { S with w := w, K := 2 ^ w, Bs := 2 ^ w })
    (by ext <;> simp [hBs]) rfl).trans ?_
  by_cases hq : q = .snd
  · rw [if_pos hq]
    exact reach_cf (MReach.refl _) (by ext <;> simp [wkSt, hq, hwd, hr]) rfl
  · rw [if_neg hq]
    have hbd9 : St.Bd B { S with w := w, K := 2 ^ w, Bs := 2 ^ w } := by
      simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
    have h7 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.KB2 q)
      { S with w := w, K := 2 ^ w, Bs := 2 ^ w } M 0 hp hbd9 hZ
      (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; omega)
    simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h7
    regs at h7
    exact reach_cf h7 (by ext <;> simp [wkSt, hq, hwd, hr]; ring) rfl

/-! ## The clear chains -/

/-- **The clear chain after the first search**: `U`, `V`, `w`, `K`, `Bs` are cleared. -/
theorem d1_run (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (hbd : S.Bd B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.d1 0) S M 0)
      (cf (.mv 0) { S with U := 0, V := 0, w := 0, K := 0, Bs := 0 } M 0) := by
  have hp : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 0 ∧ (0 : ℤ) ≤ P := ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩
  refine clr_step (r := rU) (l' := .d1 1) rfl hbd hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rV) (l' := .d1 2) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rw) (l' := .d1 3) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rK) (l' := .d1 4) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rBs) (l' := .mv 0) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  exact MReach.refl _

/-- **The clear chain before the final scan**: `U`, `V`, `w`, `K`, `Bs` are cleared. -/
theorem fz_run (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (hbd : S.Bd B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.fz 0) S M 0)
      (cf (.cp (.radX .fin) 0) { S with U := 0, V := 0, w := 0, K := 0, Bs := 0 } M 0) := by
  have hp : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 0 ∧ (0 : ℤ) ≤ P := ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩
  refine clr_step (r := rU) (l' := .fz 1) rfl hbd hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rV) (l' := .fz 2) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rw) (l' := .fz 3) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rK) (l' := .fz 4) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rBs) (l' := .cp (.radX .fin) 0) rfl
    (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  exact MReach.refl _

/-- **The chain to the next iteration**: `s` is incremented and `U`, `V`, `w`, `K`, `Bs`, `c`,
`c1`, `s1` are cleared.

**Proof sketch.** Nine straight-line steps: the increment of `s` (`inc_step`, within the bound
`s + 1 ≤ B`) and eight clears (`clr_step`), each keeping the register bounds; the run ends at
the first label of the radius copy. -/
theorem nz_run (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (hbd : S.Bd B) (hs : S.s + 1 ≤ B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.nz 0) S M 0)
      (cf (.cp (.radX .fst) 0)
        { S with s := S.s + 1, U := 0, V := 0, w := 0, K := 0, Bs := 0, c := 0, c1 := 0,
                 s1 := 0 } M 0) := by
  have hp : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 0 ∧ (0 : ℤ) ≤ P := ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩
  refine inc_step (r := rs) (l' := .nz 1) rfl hbd hp ?_; regs
  have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with s := S.s + 1 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  refine clr_step (r := rU) (l' := .nz 2) rfl hbd1 hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rV) (l' := .nz 3) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rw) (l' := .nz 4) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rK) (l' := .nz 5) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rBs) (l' := .nz 6) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_
  regs
  refine clr_step (r := rc) (l' := .nz 7) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rc1) (l' := .nz 8) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_
  regs
  refine clr_step (r := rs1) (l' := .cp (.radX .fst) 0) rfl
    (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  exact MReach.refl _

end ExpBFS

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.ExpBFS.Relax
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Intervals

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The breadth-first search of the search machine

Run lemmas for one search of `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.A` over the codes `u < K`, its marks
kept at the memory cells `Bs + u`, after the initial marking and the relaxation round of
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.ExpBFS.Relax`: the rounds until nothing changes
(`rounds_run`, by induction on the number of unmarked codes), the count (`count_run`), and the
whole search (`search_run`): it ends with the marks at `Bs + v` exactly at the codes `v < K`
reachable from an initial code `u < K` through step pairs below `K`, and with their number
in `c`.

Infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1.1, proof of Theorem 4.2]; not itself a result of the book.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.unmarked` — the number of unmarked codes of the region.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.rounds_run`, `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.count_run`.
* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.search_run` — a search marks exactly the reachable codes and
  counts them.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1, Theorem 4.2.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

namespace ExpBFS

open Turing

variable {K₀ : ℕ} {orc : Fin 4 → List Bool → Bool} {x : List Bool} {B P : ℕ}

/-! ## The rounds -/

/-- The number of unmarked codes of the region. -/
noncomputable def unmarked (b K : ℕ) (M : ℤ → Bool) : ℕ :=
  ((Finset.range K).filter fun v => M (cell b v) = false).card

/-- A memory that grew, only in the region, and changed, has fewer unmarked codes.

**Proof sketch.** Some cell changed; by `Out` it is a region cell `Bs + v`, by `Mono` it
changed from `0` to `1`. The unmarked codes afterwards are a proper subset of those before. -/
lemma unmarked_lt {b K : ℕ} {M M' : ℤ → Bool} (hm : Mono M M') (ho : Out b K M M')
    (hne : M' ≠ M) : unmarked b K M' < unmarked b K M := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z, M' z ≠ M z := by
    by_contra h; push_neg at h; exact hne (funext h)
  have hin : ∃ v, v < K ∧ z = cell b v := by
    by_contra h; push_neg at h; exact hz (ho z fun v hv e => h v hv e)
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hin
  have hMv : M (cell b v) = false := by
    cases h : M (cell b v)
    · rfl
    · exact absurd (hm _ h) (by rw [h] at hz; simpa using hz)
  apply Finset.card_lt_card
  refine ⟨fun w hw => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hw ⊢
    refine ⟨hw.1, ?_⟩
    cases h : M (cell b w)
    · rfl
    · rw [hm _ h] at hw; exact absurd hw.2 (by simp)
  · have := h (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr hv, hMv⟩)
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at this
    have h' : M' (cell b v) = true := by
      cases h'' : M' (cell b v)
      · rw [h'', hMv] at hz; exact absurd rfl hz
      · rfl
    rw [h'] at this; exact absurd this.2 (by simp)

/-- **The rounds**: from `rl0` with `U = K` and `V` clear, the machine repeats relaxation
rounds until one marks nothing, and reaches `cn0` with the change flag clear. The final marks
contain the old ones, are closed under step pairs below `K`, and stay inside any set closed
under step pairs that contains the old marks.

**Proof sketch.** Strong induction on the number of unmarked codes (`unmarked_lt`); each round
is `outer_run` from `U = 0`, the change flag cleared. -/
theorem rounds_run (φ : Bool) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool), unmarked S.Bs S.K M = j →
    S.U = S.K → S.V = 0 → S.T = 0 → S.T2 = 0 → S.Z = 0 → S.ch ≤ 1 → SBd B P S →
    ∃ M', MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.rl0 φ) S M 0) (cf (.cn0 φ) { S with ch := 0 } M' 0) ∧
      Mono M M' ∧ Out S.Bs S.K M M' ∧
      (∀ Q : ℕ → Prop, (∀ a b, Q a → a < S.K → b < S.K →
          stp orc x (rr S φ) a b = true → Q b) →
        (∀ v, v < S.K → M (cell S.Bs v) = true → Q v) →
        ∀ v, v < S.K → M' (cell S.Bs v) = true → Q v) ∧
      (∀ a b, a < S.K → b < S.K → M' (cell S.Bs a) = true → stp orc x (rr S φ) a b = true →
        M' (cell S.Bs b) = true) := by
  intro j
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ j ih =>
  intro S M hj hU hV hT hT2 hZ hch hS
  obtain ⟨hbd, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩ := hS
  have hbd0 : St.Bd B { S with U := 0 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have hbd00 : St.Bd B { S with U := 0, ch := 0 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  refine ex1_pre (b := ?b6) ?p6 ?q6
  case p6 =>
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_clr (A := fun _ => Ins.clr _ _) rfl]; regs
    refine step_of rfl hbd0 ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_clr (A := fun _ => Ins.clr _ _) rfl]; regs
    exact MReach.refl _
  obtain ⟨M1, c1, hr1, hm1, ho1, hc1, hq1, hcl1, he1, hn1⟩ :=
    outer_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) φ (S.K - 0)
      { S with U := 0, ch := 0 } M rfl (by simp only; omega) hV hT hT2 hZ (by simp only; omega)
      ⟨hbd00, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩
  have hrr : rr { S with U := 0, ch := 0 } φ = rr S φ := by cases φ <;> rfl
  rw [hrr] at hq1 hcl1
  simp only at he1 hn1 hr1 hq1 hcl1 ho1
  refine ex1_pre (cont (st' := { S with U := 0, ch := 0 }) (by ext <;> simp) hr1) ?_
  have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with U := S.K, ch := c1 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  refine ex1_pre (b := ?b7) ?p7 ?q7
  case p7 =>
    refine cont (st' := { S with U := S.K, ch := c1 }) (by ext <;> simp) ?_
    refine step_of rfl hbd1 ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_jz (A := fun _ => Ins.jz _ _ _) rfl]; regs
    exact MReach.refl _
  by_cases e : M1 = M
  · have hc0 : c1 = 0 := he1 e
    simp only [hc0, ↓reduceIte]
    subst e
    refine ⟨M1, ?_, Mono.refl _, Out.refl _ _ _, fun Q _ h => h, fun a b ha hb hMa hs => ?_⟩
    · refine reach_cf (MReach.refl _) ?_ rfl
      ext <;> simp [hU]
    · exact hcl1 rfl a b (Nat.zero_le _) ha hb hMa hs
  · have hc1' : c1 = 1 := hn1 e
    simp only [hc1', one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
    obtain ⟨M', hr, hm, ho, hq, hcl⟩ := ih (unmarked S.Bs S.K M1)
      (hj ▸ unmarked_lt hm1 ho1 e) { S with U := S.K, ch := 1 } M1 rfl (by simp only)
      hV hT hT2 hZ (by simp only; omega)
      ⟨by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩
    have hrr2 : rr { S with U := S.K, ch := 1 } φ = rr S φ := by cases φ <;> rfl
    rw [hrr2] at hq hcl
    refine ⟨M', ?_, hm1.trans hm, ho1.trans ho, fun Q hQ hM => hq Q hQ (hq1 Q hQ hM), hcl⟩
    refine cont (st' := { S with U := S.K, ch := 1 }) (by ext <;> simp) ?_
    exact reach_cf hr (by ext <;> simp [hU]) rfl

/-! ## The count -/

/-- Splitting off the first code of a range. -/
lemma card_filter_Ico_succ {p : ℕ → Prop} [DecidablePred p] {u K : ℕ} (h : u < K) :
    ((Finset.Ico u K).filter p).card =
      (if p u then 1 else 0) + ((Finset.Ico (u + 1) K).filter p).card := by
  rw [Finset.card_filter, Finset.card_filter, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot h]

/-- **The count**: from `cnU` with `U = u₀`, the machine adds to `c` the number of marked codes
`u₀ ≤ v < K` and reaches the search's exit with `U = K`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `K - U`: read the mark of `U` (`ac_run`), increment `c` if
marked, increment `U`. -/
theorem count_run (φ : Bool) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool), S.K - S.U = j →
    S.U ≤ S.K → S.T = 0 → S.T2 = 0 → S.Z = 0 → S.c + (S.K - S.U) ≤ S.K → SBd B P S →
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.cnU φ) S M 0)
      (cf (if φ then .d2 else .d1 0)
        { S with U := S.K,
                 c := S.c + ((Finset.Ico S.U S.K).filter fun v => M (cell S.Bs v) = true).card }
        M 0) := by
  intro j
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ j ih =>
  intro S M hj hUK hT hT2 hZ hc hS
  obtain ⟨hbd, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩ := hS
  by_cases hU : S.U = S.K
  · refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_jeq (A := fun _ => Ins.jeq _ _ _ _) rfl]; regs [hU, ↓reduceIte]
    refine reach_cf (MReach.refl _) ?_ rfl
    ext <;> simp [hU]
  · have hlt : S.U < S.K := by omega
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep_jeq (A := fun _ => Ins.jeq _ _ _ _) rfl]; regs; rw [if_neg hU]
    have hac := ac_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.cU φ) S M hbd hT
      hT2 hZ (by simp [Site.idx]; omega) (by simp [Site.idx]; omega)
    simp only [Site.set, Site.idx, St.toV_U, Bool.false_or, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
      acExit] at hac
    refine hac.trans ?_
    rw [card_filter_Ico_succ hlt]
    by_cases hb : M (cell S.Bs S.U) = true
    · simp only [hb, ↓reduceIte]
      have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with c := S.c + 1 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
      have hbd2 : St.Bd B { S with U := S.U + 1, c := S.c + 1 } := by
        simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
      refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
      simp only [astep_inc (A := fun _ => Ins.inc _ _) rfl]; regs
      refine step_of rfl hbd1 ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
      simp only [astep_inc (A := fun _ => Ins.inc _ _) rfl]; regs
      exact reach_cf (ih (S.K - (S.U + 1)) (by omega) { S with U := S.U + 1, c := S.c + 1 } M
        rfl (by simp only; omega) hT hT2 hZ (by simp only; omega) ⟨hbd2, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩)
        (by ext <;> simp; omega) rfl
    · rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hb
      simp only [hb, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, zero_add]
      have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with U := S.U + 1 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
      refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
      simp only [astep_inc (A := fun _ => Ins.inc _ _) rfl]; regs
      exact reach_cf (ih (S.K - (S.U + 1)) (by omega) { S with U := S.U + 1 } M rfl
        (by simp only; omega) hT hT2 hZ (by simp only; omega) ⟨hbd1, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩)
        (by ext <;> simp) rfl

/-! ## The search -/

open Classical in
/-- **A search**: from `iU` with `U`, `V`, the change flag, `c`, `T`, `T2`, `Z` clear and the
region `[Bs, Bs + K)` unmarked, the machine reaches the search's exit with `U = K`, the marks
at `Bs + v` exactly at the reachable codes `v < K` (`Cl`), their number in `c`, and the memory
outside the region unchanged.

**Proof sketch.** `ini_run` marks the initial codes, which are reachable; `rounds_run` closes
the marks under step pairs while keeping them reachable; reachable codes are marked by
induction along their paths; `count_run` counts the marks. -/
theorem search_run (φ : Bool) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (hU : S.U = 0) (hV : S.V = 0)
    (hT : S.T = 0) (hT2 : S.T2 = 0) (hZ : S.Z = 0) (hch : S.ch = 0) (hc : S.c = 0)
    (hS : SBd B P S) (hfresh : ∀ v, v < S.K → M (cell S.Bs v) = false) :
    ∃ M', MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.iU φ) S M 0)
        (cf (if φ then .d2 else .d1 0)
          { S with U := S.K, c := ((Finset.range S.K).filter (Cl orc x (rr S φ) S.K)).card }
          M' 0) ∧
      Mono M M' ∧ Out S.Bs S.K M M' ∧
      ∀ v, v < S.K → (M' (cell S.Bs v) = true ↔ Cl orc x (rr S φ) S.K v) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hbd, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩ := hS
  obtain ⟨M1, hr1, hm1, ho1, hmk1, hcl1⟩ := ini_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P)
    (K₀ := K₀) φ (S.K - S.U) S M rfl (by omega) hT hT2 hZ ⟨hbd, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩
  have hbdK : St.Bd B { S with U := S.K } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  obtain ⟨M2, hr2, hm2, ho2, hq2, hcl2⟩ := rounds_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P)
    (K₀ := K₀) φ _ { S with U := S.K } M1 rfl rfl hV hT hT2 hZ (by simp only; omega)
    ⟨hbdK, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩
  have hrr : rr { S with U := S.K } φ = rr S φ := by cases φ <;> rfl
  rw [hrr] at hq2 hcl2
  simp only at hq2 hcl2 ho2 hr2
  -- the marks are the reachable codes
  have hinv : ∀ v, v < S.K → M2 (cell S.Bs v) = true → Cl orc x (rr S φ) S.K v := by
    refine hq2 (Cl orc x (rr S φ) S.K) (fun a b ha _ hb hs => ha.step hs hb) ?_
    intro v hv h
    rcases hcl1 v hv h with h' | h'
    · rw [hfresh v hv] at h'; cases h'
    · exact ⟨v, hv, h', Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
  have hcov : ∀ v, Cl orc x (rr S φ) S.K v → M2 (cell S.Bs v) = true := by
    rintro v ⟨u, hu, hi, hpath⟩
    have hmarked : ∀ w, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => stp orc x (rr S φ) a b = true ∧
        b < S.K) u w → w < S.K ∧ M2 (cell S.Bs w) = true := by
      intro w hw
      induction hw with
      | refl => exact ⟨hu, hm2 _ (hmk1 u (by omega) hu hi)⟩
      | tail _ hst ih => exact ⟨hst.2, hcl2 _ _ ih.1 hst.2 ih.2 hst.1⟩
    exact (hmarked v hpath).2
  have hiff : ∀ v, v < S.K → (M2 (cell S.Bs v) = true ↔ Cl orc x (rr S φ) S.K v) :=
    fun v hv => ⟨hinv v hv, hcov v⟩
  refine ⟨M2, ?_, hm1.trans hm2, ho1.trans ho2, hiff⟩
  refine (hr1.trans hr2).trans ?_
  have hbdK0 : St.Bd B { S with U := S.K, ch := 0 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  refine step_of rfl hbdK0 ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
  simp only [astep_clr (A := fun _ => Ins.clr _ _) rfl]; regs
  have hcnt := count_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) φ (S.K - 0)
    { S with U := 0, ch := 0 } M2 (by simp) (by simp) hT hT2 hZ (by simp [hc])
    ⟨by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩
  have hceq : ((Finset.range S.K).filter fun v : ℕ => M2 ((S.Bs : ℤ) + (v : ℤ)) = true).card =
      ((Finset.range S.K).filter (Cl orc x (rr S φ) S.K)).card := by
    refine congrArg Finset.card (Finset.filter_congr fun v hv => ?_)
    have := hiff v (Finset.mem_range.mp hv)
    simpa [cell] using this
  refine reach_cf hcnt ?_ rfl
  ext <;> simp [hc, hch, hceq]

end ExpBFS

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-

Authors: Seyoon Ragavan

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.DblLang

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Random access to a general input in logarithmic space

A logspace machine reads its input at a position held in binary on a work tape [AB09, §4.1:
"a pointer into the input"]. The received `LogProg` layer has no such access for a general
(non-unary) input: the input instructions of `Complexity.LogProg.ARM` presuppose inputs
`⟨1ⁿ, w⟩` or `⟨1ⁿ, ⟨u, w⟩⟩`, and a call's virtual input is the whole input or its leading run
of `1`s followed by register words (P0 reception audit, `audits/ch34-p0-findings.md`). This
file supplies the missing piece twice, at the two levels later logspace programs use:

* **as a program fragment**: `Complexity.LogProg.readIn_run` reads bit `i` of the input,
  `i` held in binary on a register, into the control state (a counter register stepped up to
  `i` in lockstep with the input head, the received equality, increment, rewind and clear
  fragments), and restores everything else;
* **as a language pair**: `Complexity.implicitlyLogspaceComputable_id` — the bit and length
  languages of the identity, `Complexity.inputBitLang` and `Complexity.inputLenLang`, are in
  `L` — so an abstract register machine reads its own input at a register-held position by a
  `whole`-mode call with that register as its one argument (`Complexity.LogProg.vword_whole₁`,
  `Complexity.indicator_indexLang_pairEncode`).

Phase P4.4b of `AroraBarakChapters3-4Plan.md` (the B7 statement mini-phase, recorded in
`audits/ch4-p44-resolutions-addendum.md`). The fragment is campaign-owned and lives here,
not in `Machines/`, by decision D3; it is built only from received fragments.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.RdPh`, `Complexity.LogProg.readTr` — the phases and the transition
  table of the input-read fragment.
* `Complexity.inputBitLang`, `Complexity.inputLenLang` — `{⟨u, i⟩ | uᵢ = 1}` and
  `{⟨u, i⟩ | i < |u|}`.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.vword_whole₁` — a `whole` call with one argument presents `⟨u, V r⟩`.
* `Complexity.indicator_indexLang_pairEncode` — the answer of an `indexLang` decider on a
  genuine pair.
* `Complexity.pairEncode_ne_nil` — no pair is empty (so `[]` lies in no `indexLang`).
* `Complexity.pairEncode_getD` — a shared bit-address formula for doubled fields,
  separators, and suffixes of paired inputs.
* `Complexity.LogProg.alignedPair_loop` — a bounded ARM pair scan at any positive stride.
* `Complexity.LogProg.register_update_le` — the shared register-bound update rule.
* `Complexity.LogProg.registerCopy_loop` — copy by bounded counting, preserving the source.
* `Complexity.LogProg.registerScale_loop` — consume a source into a scaled destination.
* `Complexity.LogProg.canonicalTail_loop` — canonical-tail and width validation before decoding.
* `Complexity.LogProg.boundedDecode_loop` — reverse binary decoding after the width check, the
  unit-stride case of `Complexity.LogProg.boundedDecodeStride_loop`.
* `Complexity.LogProg.arm_chain` — a bounded chain of increments or decrements of one register.
* `Complexity.LogProg.access_width_half`, `Complexity.LogProg.drop_canon` — halving removes one
  binary digit; the tail loop's flag is `Canon`.
* `Complexity.indicator_inputBitLang`, `Complexity.indicator_inputLenLang` — the answers of the
  bit and length languages on a genuine pair.
* `Complexity.pairEncode_getD_snd` — a letter of the second field of a pair.
* `Complexity.LogProg.indexedSeek_loop` — bounded positioning within a strided segment.
* `Complexity.LogProg.inputLength_loop` — a bounded ARM loop counting a general input
  through its length-query oracle.
* `Complexity.LogProg.readIn_run` — the input-read fragment (proved; phase-P4.4b
  statement).
* `Complexity.implicitlyLogspaceComputable_id` — input random access in `L` (proved;
  phase-P4.4b statement), with `Complexity.inputBitLang_mem`, `Complexity.inputLenLang_mem`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1; §4.3, Definition 4.16.)
-/

namespace Complexity

open Turing

/-- No pair encoding is the empty word: `pairEncode x y` contains the separator. -/
theorem pairEncode_ne_nil (x y : List Bool) : pairEncode x y ≠ [] := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg List.length h
  simp [length_pairEncode] at this

/-- **The answer of an index-language decider on a genuine pair**: the indicator of
`indexLang p` at `⟨u, bits v⟩` is the decision of `p u v`. -/
theorem indicator_indexLang_pairEncode (p : List Bool → ℕ → Prop) (u : List Bool) (v : ℕ) :
    MultiTapeTM.indicator (indexLang p : Set (List Bool)) (pairEncode u (Nat.bits v)) =
      @decide (p u v) (Classical.dec _) := by
  rw [LogProg.indicator_eq_decide]
  exact decide_eq_decide.mpr (pairEncode_mem_indexLang p u v)

namespace LogProg

/-- **A `whole`-mode call with one argument** presents the pair of the whole input and the
argument register's word: its virtual input is `⟨u, V r⟩`. -/
theorem vword_whole₁ {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} (u : List Bool) (j : Fin d) (r : Fin m) (l₁ l₀ : Λ)
    (V : Fin m → List Bool) :
    vword (callSegs ⟨j, .whole, [r], l₁, l₀⟩ u V) = pairEncode u (V r) := by
  simp [callSegs, Mode.seg0, argSegs, vword, render, pairEncode_eq_dbl]

/-! ## The input-read fragment -/

/-- The phases of the input-read fragment: the equality test of the counter with the index
(`eC`, `eBy`, `eBn`), the read (`yes`) or advance (`no`) step, the counter increment (`iC`,
`iB`), and, carrying the symbol read, the input rewind (`rw₁`, `rw₂`) and the counter clear
(`cR`, `cE`). -/
inductive RdPh where
  | eC | eBy | eBn
  | yes | no
  | iC | iB
  | rw₁ (a : Option Bool) | rw₂ (a : Option Bool)
  | cR (a : Option Bool) | cE (a : Option Bool)
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

variable {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- **The transition table of the input-read fragment** on index register `r` and counter
register `s`, its phases embedded by `st` and its exits by `ex`. With the input head on
position `k + 1` (input symbol `k`) and the counter holding `bits k`: compare the counter with
the index (`eq_run`); if equal, take the symbol under the head; if not, stop at the right
blank, or else step the input head right and increment the counter (`inc_run`). Then rewind
the input head to position `1` (`rewind_x`) and clear the counter (`clr_run`), exiting into
`ex a` with the symbol `a` taken. -/
def readTr (r s : Fin m) (st : RdPh → Λ) (ex : Option Bool → Λ) :
    RdPh → Option Bool → (Fin m → Option Bool) → Action m Bool Λ
  | .eC, _, w => eqCAct s r (st .eC) (st .eBy) (st .eBn) (w s) (w r)
  | .eBy, _, w => eqBAct s r (st .eBy) (st .yes) (w s)
  | .eBn, _, w => eqBAct s r (st .eBn) (st .no) (w s)
  | .yes, a, _ => goAct (st (.rw₁ a))
  | .no, a, _ =>
    match a with
    | none => goAct (st (.rw₁ none))
    | some _ => xAct s 1 0 (st .iC)
  | .iC, _, w => incCAct s (st .iC) (st .iB) (w s)
  | .iB, _, w => incBAct s (st .iB) (st .eC) (w s)
  | .rw₁ a, _, _ => xAct s (-1) 0 (st (.rw₂ a))
  | .rw₂ a, b, _ => rw2Act s (st (.rw₂ a)) (st (.cR a)) b
  | .cR a, _, w => toEndAct s (st (.cR a)) (st (.cE a)) (w s)
  | .cE a, _, w => clrEAct s (st (.cE a)) (ex a) (w s)

/-- A proof-only instance of the frozen read table, with disjoint phase and exit labels.
Exits halt, which lets the received fragments' non-call trace clauses recover phase
membership before the final exit. The eventual transport does not require `st` injective. -/
private def readModel (r s : Fin m) : RProg m 0 (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) :=
  ⟨⟨.inl .eC, fun l a w => match l with
    | .inl ph => readTr r s Sum.inl Sum.inr ph a w
    | .inr _ => junkAct⟩, fun _ => none⟩

/-- A read-fragment boundary with its input position and canonical counter explicit. -/
private def readAt (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (s : Fin m)
    (l : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (k : ℕ) :
    Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x :=
  ⟨some l, ip, Function.update c.workTapes s (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits k)),
    Function.update c.workTapePos s 0, c.output⟩

/-- The frame and head-range assertion, before restricting the control label to a phase. -/
private def readFrame (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (d : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) : Prop :=
  ∃ l ip f p q, d = ⟨some l, ip, Function.update c.workTapes s f,
      Function.update (Function.update c.workTapePos s p) r q, c.output⟩ ∧
    -1 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ (Nat.bits (x.length + 1)).length ∧
    -1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (Nat.bits (x.length + 1)).length

/-- A counter-only fragment view satisfies the frame. -/
private theorem readFrame_reg (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) (l l' : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (k : ℕ) (f : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ)
    (hp : -1 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≤ (Nat.bits (x.length + 1)).length) :
    readFrame c r s (regCfg (readAt c s l ip k) l' s f p) := by
  refine ⟨l', ip, f, p, 0, ?_, hp, hp', by omega, by omega⟩
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · simp [regCfg, readAt]
  · simp [regCfg, readAt, Function.update_of_ne hrs, hrp]

/-- A boundary configuration is framed with both active heads at the origin. -/
private theorem readFrame_at (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) (l : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (k : ℕ) : readFrame c r s (readAt c s l ip k) := by
  have he : regCfg (readAt c s l ip k) l s (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits k)) 0 =
      readAt c s l ip k := by simp [regCfg, readAt]
  rw [← he]
  exact readFrame_reg c r s hrs hrp l l ip k _ 0 (by omega) (by omega)

/-- The comparison fragment is framed, with its common head position bounded by the
counter word rather than by the possibly much longer index word.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the received equality fragment with the counter as its first
register. Its trace moves the two heads together, so the counter length bounds both;
rewrite its configuration view into the frame and use monotonicity of binary length. -/
private theorem read_eq (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (i k : ℕ) (hr : c.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i))
    (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) (hk : k ≤ x.length)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) :
    ∃ T, rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ip k) T =
        readAt c s (.inl (if k = i then .yes else .no)) ip k ∧
      ∀ n < T, readFrame c r s
        (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ip k) n) := by
  obtain ⟨T, he, hm⟩ := eq_run (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) s r (Ne.symm hrs)
    (.inl .eC) (.inl .eBy) (.inl .eBn) (.inl .yes) (.inl .no)
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) rfl rfl rfl
    (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ip k) k i (by simp [readAt])
    (by simp [readAt, hrs, hr])
  have view (l : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) :
      eqCfg (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ip k) l s r 0 = readAt c s l ip k := by
    simp [eqCfg, readAt, Function.update_of_ne hrs, hrp]
  rw [view, view] at he
  refine ⟨T, ?_, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  · simpa only [apply_ite Sum.inl] using he
  · rw [view] at hm
    obtain ⟨l, p, he', _, hlo, hhi⟩ := hm n hn
    refine ⟨l, ip, FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits k), p, p, ?_, hlo, ?_, hlo, ?_⟩
    · rw [he']; simp [eqCfg, readAt]
    all_goals
      have hw := length_bits_mono (show k ≤ x.length + 1 by omega)
      omega

/-- One ordinary model step applies the frozen table. -/
private theorem read_one (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (ph : RdPh) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (k : ℕ) :
    rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl ph) ip k) 1 =
      (readTr r s Sum.inl Sum.inr ph (inSym x ip.val)
        (readAt c s (.inl ph) ip k).workTapeSymbols).apply (readAt c s (.inl ph) ip k) := by
  rw [rrun_one, rstep_noncall (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) _ (.inl ph) rfl rfl]
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, readModel, readAt, inputSymbol_eq, inSym]

/-- Rewind and clear restore the boundary input head and the empty counter.

**Proof sketch.** Invoke `rewind_x` at the current input position, then `clr_run` on the
counter. Both leave the index tape and all unrelated tapes unchanged. -/
private theorem read_cleanup (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ x.length)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (a : Option Bool) :
    ∃ T, rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl (.rw₁ a)) ip k) T =
        readAt c s (.inr a) 1 0 ∧
      ∀ n < T, readFrame c r s
        (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl (.rw₁ a)) ip k) n) := by
  obtain ⟨A, heA, hmA⟩ := rewind_x (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
    (readAt c s (.inl (.rw₁ a)) ip k) s 0 (.inl (.rw₁ a)) (.inl (.rw₂ a)) (.inl (.cR a))
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) rfl rfl ip
  have xv (l : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) (jp : Fin (x.length + 2)) :
      xCfg (readAt c s (.inl (.rw₁ a)) ip k) l jp s 0 = readAt c s l jp k := by
    simp [xCfg, readAt]
  rw [xv, xv] at heA
  have hone : (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) = 1 := by
    apply Fin.ext; simp
  rw [hone] at heA
  obtain ⟨B, heB, hmB⟩ := clr_run (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) s
    (.inl (.cR a)) (.inl (.cE a)) (.inr a)
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) rfl rfl (readAt c s (.inl (.cR a)) 1 k) k
  have rv (l : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) (j : ℕ) :
      regCfg (readAt c s (.inl (.cR a)) 1 k) l s (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits j)) 0 =
      readAt c s l 1 j := by simp [regCfg, readAt]
  rw [rv, rv] at heB
  refine ⟨A + B, by rw [rrun_add, heA, heB], fun n hn => ?_⟩
  by_cases hnA : n < A
  · rw [xv] at hmA
    obtain ⟨l, jp, he, _⟩ := hmA n hnA
    rw [he, xv]
    exact readFrame_at c r s hrs hrp l jp k
  · have hn' : n = A + (n - A) := by omega
    rw [hn', rrun_add, heA]
    rw [rv] at hmB
    obtain ⟨l, f, p, he, _, hlo, hhi⟩ := hmB (n - A) (by omega)
    rw [he]
    exact readFrame_reg c r s hrs hrp _ l 1 k f p hlo
      (hhi.trans (by exact_mod_cast length_bits_mono (show k ≤ x.length + 1 by omega)))

/-- Advance one counter/input position when both the requested index and the input end
are still ahead.

**Proof sketch.** The received equality fragment answers no. One table step advances the
input head, and the received increment fragment advances the counter. -/
private theorem read_advance (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (i k : ℕ) (hr : c.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i))
    (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) (hk : k < min i x.length) :
    ∃ T, rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
        (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ k) T =
        readAt c s (.inl .eC) ⟨k + 2, by omega⟩ (k + 1) ∧
      ∀ n < T, readFrame c r s (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
        (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ k) n) := by
  obtain ⟨A, heA, hmA⟩ := read_eq c r s hrs i k hr hrp (by omega) ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩
  rw [if_neg (show k ≠ i by omega)] at heA
  have he1 : rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
      (readAt c s (.inl .no) ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ k) 1 =
      readAt c s (.inl .iC) ⟨k + 2, by omega⟩ k := by
    rw [read_one, inSym_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (show k < x.length by omega)]
    simp only [readTr]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ (by simp [Action.apply, xAct, readAt])
    · apply Fin.ext
      simpa only [Action.apply, xAct, readAt] using
        (moveInputPos_pos_val (x := x) ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ (by dsimp; omega))
    · funext j z; simp [Action.apply, xAct, readAt]
    · funext j; simp [Action.apply, xAct, readAt]
  obtain ⟨B, heB, hmB⟩ := inc_run (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) s
    (.inl .iC) (.inl .iB) (.inl .eC) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) rfl rfl
    (readAt c s (.inl .iC) ⟨k + 2, by omega⟩ k) k
  have rv (l : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) (j : ℕ) :
      regCfg (readAt c s (.inl .iC) ⟨k + 2, by omega⟩ k) l s (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits j)) 0 =
      readAt c s l ⟨k + 2, by omega⟩ j := by simp [regCfg, readAt]
  rw [rv, rv] at heB
  refine ⟨A + (1 + B), by rw [rrun_add, heA, rrun_add, he1, heB], fun n hn => ?_⟩
  by_cases hnA : n < A
  · exact hmA n hnA
  · have hn' : n = A + (n - A) := by omega
    rw [hn', rrun_add, heA]
    by_cases heq : n - A = 0
    · rw [heq, rrun_zero]
      exact readFrame_at c r s hrs hrp _ _ _
    · have hn'' : n - A = 1 + (n - A - 1) := by omega
      rw [hn'', rrun_add, he1]
      rw [rv] at hmB
      obtain ⟨l, f, p, he, _, hlo, hhi⟩ := hmB (n - A - 1) (by omega)
      rw [he]
      exact readFrame_reg c r s hrs hrp _ l _ k f p hlo
        (hhi.trans (by exact_mod_cast length_bits_mono (show k + 1 ≤ x.length + 1 by omega)))

/-- At the smaller of the desired index and input length, read the answer and clean up.

**Proof sketch.** Equality selects the requested cell when the index is reached; otherwise
this is the right blank and the requested answer is also `none`. Rewind and clear complete
the routine. -/
private theorem read_finish (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (i : ℕ) (hr : c.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i))
    (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) :
    ∃ T, rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
        (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ⟨min i x.length + 1, by omega⟩ (min i x.length)) T =
        readAt c s (.inr x[i]?) 1 0 ∧
      ∀ n < T, readFrame c r s (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
        (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ⟨min i x.length + 1, by omega⟩ (min i x.length)) n) := by
  let k := min i x.length
  let ip : Fin (x.length + 2) := ⟨k + 1, by dsimp [k]; omega⟩
  obtain ⟨A, heA, hmA⟩ := read_eq c r s hrs i k hr hrp (by dsimp [k]; omega) ip
  have he1 : rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
      (readAt c s (.inl (if k = i then .yes else .no)) ip k) 1 =
      readAt c s (.inl (.rw₁ x[i]?)) ip k := by
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · rw [if_pos hki, read_one]
      have hin : inSym x ip.val = x[i]? := by dsimp [ip]; rw [inSym_succ, hki]
      rw [hin]
      simp [readTr, goAct, Action.apply, readAt]
    · have hklen : k = x.length := by dsimp [k] at *; omega
      have hi : x.length ≤ i := by dsimp [k] at *; omega
      rw [if_neg hki, read_one]
      have hin : inSym x ip.val = none := by dsimp [ip]; rw [inSym_succ, hklen]; simp
      rw [hin, List.getElem?_eq_none hi]
      simp [readTr, goAct, Action.apply, readAt]
  obtain ⟨B, heB, hmB⟩ := read_cleanup c r s hrs hrp k (by dsimp [k]; omega) ip x[i]?
  refine ⟨A + (1 + B), by rw [rrun_add, heA, rrun_add, he1, heB], fun n hn => ?_⟩
  by_cases hnA : n < A
  · exact hmA n hnA
  · have hn' : n = A + (n - A) := by omega
    rw [hn', rrun_add, heA]
    by_cases heq : n - A = 0
    · rw [heq, rrun_zero]
      exact readFrame_at c r s hrs hrp _ _ _
    · have hn'' : n - A = 1 + (n - A - 1) := by omega
      rw [hn'', rrun_add, he1]
      exact hmB (n - A - 1) (by omega)

/-- The proof-only model executes the whole routine with the original frame.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the counter up to `min i |x|`, concatenate each bounded advance,
then append `read_finish`. All sub-runs come from the received fragments. -/
private theorem read_model_run (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (i : ℕ) (hr : c.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i))
    (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) :
    ∃ T, rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl .eC) 1 0) T =
        readAt c s (.inr x[i]?) 1 0 ∧
      ∀ n < T, readFrame c r s
        (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl .eC) 1 0) n) := by
  have rounds : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ min i x.length), ∃ T,
      rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl .eC) 1 0) T =
        readAt c s (.inl .eC) ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ k ∧
      ∀ n < T, readFrame c r s
        (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl .eC) 1 0) n) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro hk; exact ⟨0, rfl, fun n hn => by omega⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      obtain ⟨A, heA, hmA⟩ := ih (by omega)
      obtain ⟨B, heB, hmB⟩ := read_advance c r s hrs i k hr hrp (by omega)
      refine ⟨A + B, by rw [rrun_add, heA, heB], fun n hn => ?_⟩
      by_cases hnA : n < A
      · exact hmA n hnA
      · have hn' : n = A + (n - A) := by omega
        rw [hn', rrun_add, heA]
        exact hmB (n - A) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨A, heA, hmA⟩ := rounds (min i x.length) le_rfl
  obtain ⟨B, heB, hmB⟩ := read_finish c r s hrs i hr hrp
  refine ⟨A + B, by rw [rrun_add, heA, heB], fun n hn => ?_⟩
  by_cases hnA : n < A
  · exact hmA n hnA
  · have hn' : n = A + (n - A) := by omega
    rw [hn', rrun_add, heA]
    exact hmB (n - A) (by omega)

/-- The proof-only model has no calls, so its register run is its ordinary machine run. -/
private theorem read_run_eq (r s : Fin m) (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (n : ℕ) :
    rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) c n = (readModel r s).tm.runFrom c n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [rrun_succ, ih, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
    cases hs : ((readModel r s).tm.runFrom c n).state <;>
      simp [rstep, MultiTapeTM.step, hs, readModel]

/-- Every state strictly before an exit in the proof-only model is a fragment phase.

**Proof sketch.** The final exit is live. Earlier configurations are live because halts are
absorbing. An earlier exit would halt on its next step, contradicting that liveness. -/
private theorem read_model_phase (r s : Fin m) (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x)
    (T : ℕ) (a : Option Bool)
    (hT : (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) c T).state = some (.inr a)) :
    ∀ n < T, ∃ ph, (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) c n).state = some (.inl ph) := by
  simp only [read_run_eq] at hT ⊢
  have hl := (readModel r s).tm.runFrom_state_ne_none_of_le c T
    (by rw [hT]; simp)
  intro n hn
  cases he : ((readModel r s).tm.runFrom c n).state with
  | none => exact (hl n (by omega) he).elim
  | some l =>
    cases l with
    | inl ph => exact ⟨ph, rfl⟩
    | inr b =>
      exfalso
      apply hl (n + 1) (by omega)
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
      simp [MultiTapeTM.step, he, readModel, junkAct, Action.apply]

/-- The frozen table commutes with replacing its phase and exit labels. -/
private theorem read_action_map (r s : Fin m) (st : RdPh → Λ) (ex : Option Bool → Λ)
    (ph : RdPh) (a : Option Bool) (w : Fin m → Option Bool) :
    (readTr r s Sum.inl Sum.inr ph a w).mapState (Sum.elim st ex) = readTr r s st ex ph a w := by
  cases ph <;>
    simp [readTr, eqCAct, eqBAct, incCAct, incBAct, rw2Act, toEndAct, clrEAct,
      regAct, mv2Act, xAct, goAct, Action.mapState, apply_ite] <;>
    repeat' first | split | rfl

section Read

variable (P : RProg m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (r s : Fin m) (hrs : r ≠ s)
  (st : RdPh → Λ) (ex : Option Bool → Λ)
  (htr : ∀ ph a w, P.tm.tr (st ph) a w = readTr r s st ex ph a w)
  (hc : ∀ ph, P.call (st ph) = none)

include hrs htr hc in
/-- **The input-read fragment** (phase P4.4b; proved): from phase `eC`, with
`bits i` on the index register `r`, an empty counter register `s`, both heads on cell `0` and
the input head on position `1`, the program reaches the exit `ex x[i]?` — symbol `i` of the
input, `none` when `i ≥ |x|` — in the same configuration otherwise (registers, heads, input
position and output restored). Throughout, only registers `s` and `r` change (the tape of `s`,
the heads of both), both heads stay in `[-1, |bits (|x| + 1)|]`, and every state is an
ordinary fragment state: the fragment's space is these two ranges, independently of `i`.
A hand-built fragment: no received layer reads a general input at a register-held position
(the `Parse` fragments assume unary-first inputs).

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the counter value `k ≤ min i |x|`, the input head on position
`k + 1`. `eq_run` (with `r₁ := s`, so both heads stay within `|bits k|`) compares `bits k`
with `bits i`. If `k = i`, phase `yes` takes `inSym x (i + 1) = x[i]?`. Otherwise phase `no`
reads `inSym x (k + 1)`: at the right blank (`k = |x| < i`) the symbol taken is
`none = x[i]?`; on a letter (`k < |x|`) the head steps right and `inc_run` turns `bits k` into
`bits (k + 1)`, `k + 1 ≤ |x|`. Then `rewind_x` returns the input head to position `1`, and
`clr_run` empties the counter (its head within `|bits k|`). -/
theorem readIn_run (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (i : ℕ)
    (hr : c.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i)) (hs : c.workTapes s = FinTM.bufferTape [])
    (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) (hsp : c.workTapePos s = 0) (hip : c.inputPos.val = 1) :
    ∃ T, rrun P oracle { c with state := some (st .eC) } T = { c with state := some (ex x[i]?) } ∧
      ∀ t < T, ∃ (ph : RdPh) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (f : ℤ → Option Bool) (q q' : ℤ),
        rrun P oracle { c with state := some (st .eC) } t =
          ⟨some (st ph), ip, Function.update c.workTapes s f,
            Function.update (Function.update c.workTapePos s q) r q', c.output⟩ ∧
        -1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (Nat.bits (x.length + 1)).length ∧
        -1 ≤ q' ∧ q' ≤ (Nat.bits (x.length + 1)).length := by
  let c₀ : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x :=
    ⟨some (.inl .eC), c.inputPos, c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, c.output⟩
  let d₀ := readAt c₀ s (.inl .eC) 1 0
  let rename : (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) → Λ := Sum.elim st ex
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hmid⟩ := read_model_run c₀ r s hrs i hr hrp
  have hphase := read_model_phase r s d₀ T x[i]? (by rw [hT]; rfl)
  have hm : ∀ n ≤ T, rrun P oracle (d₀.mapState rename) n =
      (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) d₀ n).mapState rename := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro _; rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      intro hn
      obtain ⟨ph, hph⟩ := hphase n (by omega)
      rw [rrun_succ, ih (by omega), rrun_succ]
      rw [rstep_noncall P oracle _ (st ph) (by simp [Cfg.mapState, hph, rename]) (hc ph),
        rstep_noncall (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) _ (.inl ph) hph rfl]
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, Cfg.mapState, hph, Option.map_some, rename, Sum.elim_inl]
      rw [htr]
      rw [← read_action_map]
      rfl
  have hstart : d₀.mapState rename = {c with state := some (st .eC)} := by
    refine Cfg.ext rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ rfl
    · apply Fin.ext; simpa [d₀, c₀, readAt, Cfg.mapState] using hip.symm
    · simp [d₀, c₀, readAt, Cfg.mapState, Nat.zero_bits, ← hs, Function.update_eq_self]
    · simp [d₀, c₀, readAt, Cfg.mapState, ← hsp, Function.update_eq_self]
  rw [← hstart]
  refine ⟨T, ?_, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  · rw [hm T le_rfl, hT]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ rfl
    · apply Fin.ext; simpa [readAt, Cfg.mapState] using hip.symm
    · simp [readAt, c₀, Cfg.mapState, Nat.zero_bits, ← hs, Function.update_eq_self]
    · simp [readAt, c₀, Cfg.mapState, ← hsp, Function.update_eq_self]
  · obtain ⟨ph, hph⟩ := hphase n hn
    obtain ⟨l, ip, f, p, q, he, hlo, hhi, hlo', hhi'⟩ := hmid n hn
    have hl : l = Sum.inl ph := by rw [he] at hph; exact Option.some.inj hph
    subst l
    refine ⟨ph, ip, f, p, q, ?_, hlo, hhi, hlo', hhi'⟩
    rw [hm n (by omega), he]
    rfl

end Read

end LogProg

/-! ## Input access as a language pair -/

/-- The bit language of the identity: `{⟨u, bits i⟩ | uᵢ = 1}` (`0`-based; `false` beyond the
end). -/
def inputBitLang : Language Bool := indexLang fun u i => u.getD i false = true

/-- The length language of the identity: `{⟨u, bits i⟩ | i < |u|}`. -/
def inputLenLang : Language Bool := indexLang fun u i => i < u.length

/-- **The bit language answers with the indexed letter**: on a genuine pair `⟨y, bits a⟩` the
indicator of `Complexity.inputBitLang` is letter `a` of `y` (`false` beyond the end).

**Proof sketch.** `Complexity.indicator_indexLang_pairEncode`, by cases on the letter. -/
theorem indicator_inputBitLang (y : List Bool) (a : ℕ) :
    MultiTapeTM.indicator (inputBitLang : Set (List Bool)) (pairEncode y (Nat.bits a)) =
      y.getD a false := by
  rw [inputBitLang, indicator_indexLang_pairEncode]
  cases y.getD a false <;> simp

/-- **The length language answers with the comparison**: on a genuine pair `⟨y, bits a⟩` the
indicator of `Complexity.inputLenLang` decides `a < |y|`.

**Proof sketch.** `Complexity.indicator_indexLang_pairEncode`. -/
theorem indicator_inputLenLang (y : List Bool) (a : ℕ) :
    MultiTapeTM.indicator (inputLenLang : Set (List Bool)) (pairEncode y (Nat.bits a)) =
      decide (a < y.length) := by
  rw [inputLenLang, indicator_indexLang_pairEncode]
  exact decide_eq_decide.mpr Iff.rfl

/-- Reading a paired word by position selects a doubled first-field bit, a separator bit,
or a suffix bit. The default is `false` beyond the complete word. This common address rule
serves the nested layouts of index dropping, query reshaping, and multiplication.

**Proof sketch.** Within the first field, write the address as twice its quotient by two
plus its parity and cite `getElem?_dbl`. Outside that field, the append lookup rule exposes
the separator or the suffix. -/
theorem pairEncode_getD (u v : List Bool) (j : ℕ) :
    (pairEncode u v).getD j false =
      if j < 2 * u.length then u.getD (j / 2) false
      else if j = 2 * u.length then false
      else if j = 2 * u.length + 1 then true
      else v.getD (j - 2 * u.length - 2) false := by
  by_cases hj : j < 2 * u.length
  · rw [if_pos hj, pairEncode_eq_dbl, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.append_assoc, List.getElem?_append_left (by simpa using hj)]
    have hc : j / 2 < u.length := by omega
    have hread : (dbl u)[j]? = some u[j / 2] := by
      rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one j with h | h
      · have he : 2 * (j / 2) + (false : Bool).toNat = j := by simp; omega
        simpa only [he] using getElem?_dbl u (j / 2) hc false
      · have he : 2 * (j / 2) + (true : Bool).toNat = j := by simp; omega
        simpa only [he] using getElem?_dbl u (j / 2) hc true
    rw [hread]
    simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hc]
  · rw [if_neg hj, pairEncode_eq_dbl, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.append_assoc, List.getElem?_append_right (by simp; omega)]
    simp only [length_dbl]
    by_cases he : j = 2 * u.length
    · subst j; simp
    · rw [if_neg he]
      by_cases he' : j = 2 * u.length + 1
      · subst j; simp
      · rw [if_neg he', show j - 2 * u.length = (j - 2 * u.length - 2) + 1 + 1 by omega]
        rfl

/-- **A letter of the second field of a pair**: letter `j` of `v` sits at position
`2 |u| + 2 + j` of `⟨u, v⟩` (reading with default `false`, also beyond the end).

**Proof sketch.** The address lies past the doubled first field and the separator, so the last
case of `pairEncode_getD` reads letter `j` of `v`. -/
theorem pairEncode_getD_snd (u v : List Bool) (j : ℕ) :
    (pairEncode u v).getD (2 * u.length + 2 + j) false = v.getD j false := by
  rw [pairEncode_getD, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
  congr 1
  omega

namespace LogProg

open Classical

/-- A length-query/increment loop counts the host input, with all registers bounded by
the chosen bound. The oracle law is needed only up to the first failing query, at the
input length. This shared ARM fragment is used by the query validators.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the input length minus the current counter. Below the end,
the length call succeeds and increment reduces the remaining count. At the end, the call
fails and exits. The counter never exceeds the input length; all other registers stay
unchanged. Both instructions meet the received ARM syntactic preconditions. -/
theorem inputLength_loop {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} (A : ARM m d Λ)
    (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool) (r : Fin m) (j : Fin d)
    (scan inc done : Λ)
    (hscan : A scan = .call j .whole [r] inc done)
    (hinc : A inc = .inc r scan)
    (hquery : ∀ n ≤ x.length, oracle j (pairEncode x (Nat.bits n)) = decide (n < x.length))
    (B : ℕ) (hB : x.length ≤ B) (v : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hv : ∀ s, v s ≤ B) (hr : v r ≤ x.length) :
    AReach A oracle x (fun a => PreS A x a ∧ ∀ s, a.2.1 s ≤ B)
      (some scan, v, none) (some done, Function.update v r x.length, none) := by
  generalize hN : x.length - v r = N
  induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing v with
  | h N ih =>
    have hs : astep A oracle x (some scan, v, none) =
        (some (if v r < x.length then inc else done), v, none) := by
      simp only [astep_call hscan, vword_whole₁, hquery (v r) hr, decide_eq_true_eq]
    have hg : PreS A x (some scan, v, none) ∧ ∀ s, v s ≤ B :=
      ⟨by simp [PreS, hscan], hv⟩
    by_cases hlt : v r < x.length
    · let v' := Function.update v r (v r + 1)
      have hv' : ∀ s, v' s ≤ B := by
        intro s
        by_cases he : s = r
        · subst s; dsimp [v']; rw [Function.update_self]; omega
        · simpa [v', Function.update_of_ne he] using hv s
      have hr' : v' r ≤ x.length := by simp [v']; omega
      have hremain : x.length - v' r < N := by simp [v']; omega
      have hc := ih (x.length - v' r) hremain v' hv' hr' rfl
      have hi : astep A oracle x (some inc, v, none) = (some scan, v', none) := by
        simp [astep_inc hinc, v']
      apply AReach.step hg
      rw [hs, if_pos hlt]
      apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, hinc], hv⟩
      rw [hi]
      simpa only [v', Function.update_idem] using hc
    · have he : v r = x.length := by omega
      have hp := AReach.single (A := A) (oracle := oracle) (x := x)
        (G := fun a => PreS A x a ∧ ∀ s, a.2.1 s ≤ B) (a := (some scan, v, none)) hg
      have hs' : astep A oracle x (some scan, v, none) = (some done, v, none) := by
        rw [hs, if_neg hlt]
      have hvdone : Function.update v r x.length = v := by
        rw [← he, Function.update_eq_self]
      rw [hvdone]
      simpa only [hs'] using hp

/-- **A bounded straight chain of unit steps of one register**: if the instructions at the
labels `labels 0, …, labels (k - 1)` all increment register `r` (`up = true`), or all decrement
it (`up = false`), each passing to the next label, then the run from `labels 0` reaches
`labels k` with `r` raised (respectively lowered) by `k`, every register staying at most `B`.
The side condition is `v r + k ≤ B` for increments and `k ≤ v r` for decrements, so that no
decrement truncates. The labels may belong to any larger ARM; no new reachability relation is
needed. The increment chains of the bounded fragments below and the codec's chains
(`Complexity.Codec.incChain`, `Complexity.Codec.decChain`) are its instances.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `k`. A step at `labels 0` moves `r` by one, within the bound;
the rest of the chain starts at `labels 1`. -/
theorem arm_chain {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} (A : ARM m d Λ)
    (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool) (r : Fin m) (up : Bool)
    (labels : ℕ → Λ) (k B : ℕ)
    (hcode : ∀ i < k, A (labels i) =
      bif up then .inc r (labels (i + 1)) else .dec r (labels (i + 1)))
    (v : Fin m → ℕ) (hv : ∀ s, v s ≤ B) (hk : bif up then v r + k ≤ B else k ≤ v r) :
    AReach A oracle x (fun a => PreS A x a ∧ ∀ s, a.2.1 s ≤ B)
      (some (labels 0), v, none)
      (some (labels k), Function.update v r (bif up then v r + k else v r - k), none) := by
  induction k generalizing labels v with
  | zero =>
