Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMWidth
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.InputAccess

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Exhaustive search with a polynomially wide register

A non-vacuity check for `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_pspace_val`, on an algorithm that
genuinely needs registers of more than logarithmically many binary digits: for a language
`P ∈ PSPACE`, the language `Complexity.LogProg.WidthExample.searchLang P` of inputs `x` having
a witness `u < 2^|x|` with `⟨x, bits u⟩ ∈ P` is in `PSPACE`. The abstract register machine
`Complexity.LogProg.WidthExample.searchA` measures `n = |x|` (asking the logspace decider of
`Complexity.inputLenLang`), computes `2^n` by `n` doublings, and then runs a counter `u`
through `0, 1, …, 2^n - 1`, asking the decider of `P` on `⟨x, bits u⟩`. The counter and the
bound `2^n` have `n + 1` binary digits — far beyond the `O(log n)` of
`Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides`.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.WidthExample.searchLang` — exhaustive search over `|x|`-bit witnesses.
* `Complexity.LogProg.WidthExample.searchA` — the search machine.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.WidthExample.searchLang_mem_PSPACE` — `searchLang P ∈ PSPACE` for
  `P ∈ PSPACE`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1; compare the exhaustive-search argument of
  Example 4.6, `NP ⊆ PSPACE`.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

namespace WidthExample

open Turing

/-- **Exhaustive search over `|x|`-bit witnesses**: the inputs `x` with some `u < 2^|x|` such
that `⟨x, bits u⟩ ∈ P`. -/
def searchLang (P : Language Bool) : Language Bool :=
  {x | ∃ u < 2 ^ x.length, pairEncode x (Nat.bits u) ∈ P}

/-- The labels of the search machine. -/
inductive Lb where
  | init | scan | incI | dbl | decI | d1 | d1a | d1b | d1c | d2 | d2a | d2b
  | enum | chk | nxt | acc | rej
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- **The search machine**, on registers `i = 0`, `p = 1`, `t = 2`, `u = 3`: set `p = 1`;
count `i = |x|` (asking `i < |x|` of decider `0`); while `i ≠ 0`, decrement `i` and double `p`
(move `p` into `t` twice over, then back); finally, for `u = 0, 1, …` until `u = p = 2^|x|`,
accept if decider `1` accepts `⟨x, bits u⟩`; reject at the end. -/
def searchA : ARM 4 2 Lb
  | .init => .inc 1 .scan
  | .scan => .call 0 .whole [0] .incI .dbl
  | .incI => .inc 0 .scan
  | .dbl => .jz 0 .enum .decI
  | .decI => .dec 0 .d1
  | .d1 => .jz 1 .d2 .d1a
  | .d1a => .dec 1 .d1b
  | .d1b => .inc 2 .d1c
  | .d1c => .inc 2 .d1
  | .d2 => .jz 2 .dbl .d2a
  | .d2a => .dec 2 .d2b
  | .d2b => .inc 1 .d2
  | .enum => .jeq 3 1 .rej .chk
  | .chk => .call 1 .whole [3] .acc .nxt
  | .nxt => .inc 3 .enum
  | .acc => .ret true
  | .rej => .ret false

/-- The deciders: `0` is `Complexity.inputLenLang` (`i < |x|`), `1` is `P`. -/
def decs (P : Language Bool) : Fin 2 → Language Bool := ![inputLenLang, P]

/-- The oracle: membership in the deciders' languages. -/
noncomputable def orc (P : Language Bool) : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool :=
  fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (decs P j : Set (List Bool)) V

/-- The register file `(i, p, t, u)`. -/
def rf (i p t u : ℕ) : Fin 4 → ℕ := ![i, p, t, u]

/-- Updating register `0` (`i`) of the register file. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_upd0 (i p t u a : ℕ) : Function.update (rf i p t u) 0 a = rf a p t u := by
  funext k
  match k with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ | ⟨1, _⟩ | ⟨2, _⟩ | ⟨3, _⟩ => rfl
  | ⟨_ + 4, h⟩ => omega
/-- Updating register `1` (`p`) of the register file. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_upd1 (i p t u a : ℕ) : Function.update (rf i p t u) 1 a = rf i a t u := by
  funext k
  match k with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ | ⟨1, _⟩ | ⟨2, _⟩ | ⟨3, _⟩ => rfl
  | ⟨_ + 4, h⟩ => omega
/-- Updating register `2` (`t`) of the register file. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_upd2 (i p t u a : ℕ) : Function.update (rf i p t u) 2 a = rf i p a u := by
  funext k
  match k with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ | ⟨1, _⟩ | ⟨2, _⟩ | ⟨3, _⟩ => rfl
  | ⟨_ + 4, h⟩ => omega
/-- Updating register `3` (`u`) of the register file. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_upd3 (i p t u a : ℕ) : Function.update (rf i p t u) 3 a = rf i p t a := by
  funext k
  match k with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ | ⟨1, _⟩ | ⟨2, _⟩ | ⟨3, _⟩ => rfl
  | ⟨_ + 4, h⟩ => omega
/-- Register `0` of the register file is `i`. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_0 (i p t u : ℕ) : rf i p t u 0 = i := rfl
/-- Register `1` of the register file is `p`. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_1 (i p t u : ℕ) : rf i p t u 1 = p := rfl
/-- Register `2` of the register file is `t`. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_2 (i p t u : ℕ) : rf i p t u 2 = t := rfl
/-- Register `3` of the register file is `u`. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_3 (i p t u : ℕ) : rf i p t u 3 = u := rfl

/-- The guard of the runs: the syntactic preconditions, and every register at most `B`. -/
def G (x : List Bool) (B : ℕ) : AConf 4 Lb → Prop :=
  fun a => PreS searchA x a ∧ ∀ s, a.2.1 s ≤ B

/-- Every configuration of the search machine with registers at most `B` meets the guard. -/
lemma guard_rf (x : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (l : Lb) {i p t u : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ B) (hp : p ≤ B) (ht : t ≤ B)
    (hu : u ≤ B) : G x B (some l, rf i p t u, none) := by
  refine ⟨by cases l <;> simp [PreS, searchA], fun s => ?_⟩
  match s with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => exact hi
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => exact hp
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => exact ht
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => exact hu
  | ⟨_ + 4, h⟩ => omega

variable (P : Language Bool) (x : List Bool) (B : ℕ)

/-- **The first half of a doubling**: from `d1` with `p = a`, `t = b`, the machine moves `p`
into `t` twice over, reaching `d2` with `p = 0`, `t = b + 2a`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `a`: each round decrements `p` and increments `t` twice. -/
lemma d1_loop (i u : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ B) (hu : u ≤ B) : ∀ a b, b + 2 * a ≤ B →
    AReach searchA (orc P) x (G x B) (some .d1, rf i a b u, none)
      (some .d2, rf i 0 (b + 2 * a) u, none) := by
  intro a
  induction a with
  | zero =>
    intro b hb
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simpa [astep_jz (show searchA .d1 = _ from rfl)] using AReach.refl _
  | succ a ih =>
    intro b hb
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep_jz (show searchA .d1 = _ from rfl), rf_1, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep_dec (show searchA .d1a = _ from rfl), rf_1, rf_upd1, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep_inc (show searchA .d1b = _ from rfl), rf_2, rf_upd2]
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep_inc (show searchA .d1c = _ from rfl), rf_2, rf_upd2]
    have e : b + 2 * (a + 1) = b + 1 + 1 + 2 * a := by ring
    rw [e]
    exact ih (b + 1 + 1) (by omega)

/-- **The second half of a doubling**: from `d2` with `p`, `t = b`, the machine moves `t`
back into `p`, reaching `dbl` with `p + b` and `t = 0`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `b`: each round decrements `t` and increments `p`. -/
lemma d2_loop (i u : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ B) (hu : u ≤ B) : ∀ b p, p + b ≤ B →
    AReach searchA (orc P) x (G x B) (some .d2, rf i p b u, none)
      (some .dbl, rf i (p + b) 0 u, none) := by
  intro b
  induction b with
  | zero =>
    intro p hb
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simpa [astep_jz (show searchA .d2 = _ from rfl)] using AReach.refl _
  | succ b ih =>
    intro p hb
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep_jz (show searchA .d2 = _ from rfl), rf_2, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep_dec (show searchA .d2a = _ from rfl), rf_2, rf_upd2, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep_inc (show searchA .d2b = _ from rfl), rf_1, rf_upd1]
    have e : p + (b + 1) = p + 1 + b := by ring
    rw [e]
    exact ih (p + 1) (by omega)

/-- **The doubling loop**: from `dbl` with `i = k`, `p = 2^a` and `a + k = n`, `2^n ≤ B`, the
machine reaches `enum` with `i = 0`, `p = 2^n`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `k`: each round decrements `i` and doubles `p` (`d1_loop`,
`d2_loop`), all registers staying at most `2^n`. -/
lemma dbl_loop (n : ℕ) (hB : 2 ^ n ≤ B) : ∀ k a, a + k = n →
    AReach searchA (orc P) x (G x B) (some .dbl, rf k (2 ^ a) 0 0, none)
      (some .enum, rf 0 (2 ^ n) 0 0, none) := by
  have hn : n ≤ B := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le.trans hB
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro a ha
    obtain rfl : a = n := by omega
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simpa [astep_jz (show searchA .dbl = _ from rfl)] using AReach.refl _
  | succ k ih =>
    intro a ha
    have h2 : 2 ^ (a + 1) ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    have e2 : 2 ^ (a + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ a := by ring
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep_jz (show searchA .dbl = _ from rfl), rf_0, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep_dec (show searchA .decI = _ from rfl), rf_0, rf_upd0, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    refine (d1_loop P x B k 0 (by omega) (by omega) (2 ^ a) 0 (by omega)).trans ?_
    refine (d2_loop P x B k 0 (by omega) (by omega) (0 + 2 * 2 ^ a) 0 (by omega)).trans ?_
    have e : 0 + (0 + 2 * 2 ^ a) = 2 ^ (a + 1) := by omega
    rw [e]
    exact ih (a + 1) (by omega)

/-- **The search loop**: from `enum` with `p = 2^n` and counter `u ≤ 2^n`, `2^n ≤ B`, the
machine answers whether some `w` with `u ≤ w < 2^n` has `⟨x, bits w⟩ ∈ P`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `2^n - u`. At `u = 2^n` the machine rejects, and no such `w`
exists. Below, it accepts if `⟨x, bits u⟩ ∈ P`, and otherwise moves to `u + 1`. -/
lemma enum_loop (n : ℕ) (hB : 2 ^ n ≤ B) : ∀ k u, u + k = 2 ^ n → ∀ b : Bool,
    (b = true ↔ ∃ w, u ≤ w ∧ w < 2 ^ n ∧ pairEncode x (Nat.bits w) ∈ P) →
    AHalt searchA (orc P) x (G x B) (some .enum, rf 0 (2 ^ n) 0 u, none) b := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro u hu b hb
    obtain rfl : u = 2 ^ n := by omega
    refine AHalt.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) hB) ?_
    simp only [astep_jeq (show searchA .enum = _ from rfl), rf_1, rf_3, ↓reduceIte]
    obtain rfl : b = false := by
      cases b
      · rfl
      · obtain ⟨w, h1, h2, -⟩ := hb.mp rfl; omega
    exact AHalt.ret rfl (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) hB)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro u hu b hb
    have hu' : u < 2 ^ n := by omega
    refine AHalt.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep_jeq (show searchA .enum = _ from rfl), rf_1, rf_3, hu'.ne, ↓reduceIte]
    refine AHalt.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have ho : orc P 1 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits u)) = true ↔ pairEncode x (Nat.bits u) ∈ P := by
      simp [orc, decs, indicator_eq_decide]
    simp only [astep_call (show searchA .chk = _ from rfl), vword_whole₁, rf_3]
    by_cases hq : pairEncode x (Nat.bits u) ∈ P
    · rw [if_pos (ho.mpr hq)]
      obtain rfl : b = true := hb.mpr ⟨u, le_rfl, hu', hq⟩
      exact AHalt.ret rfl (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) (by omega))
    · have hf : orc P 1 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits u)) = false := by
        simpa using mt ho.mp hq
      rw [hf]
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      refine AHalt.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
      simp only [astep_inc (show searchA .nxt = _ from rfl), rf_3, rf_upd3]
      refine ih (u + 1) (by omega) b (hb.trans ⟨fun ⟨w, h1, h2, h3⟩ => ⟨w, ?_, h2, h3⟩,
        fun ⟨w, h1, h2, h3⟩ => ⟨w, by omega, h2, h3⟩⟩)
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u w with h | h
      · omega
      · obtain rfl : w = u := by omega
        exact absurd h3 hq

/-- **Exhaustive search over `|x|`-bit witnesses preserves `PSPACE`**: if `P ∈ PSPACE` then
the language of inputs `x` with some `u < 2^|x|` such that `⟨x, bits u⟩ ∈ P` is in
`PSPACE`. [AB09, §4.1; the exhaustive-search argument of Example 4.6] — here an example of
`Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_pspace_val`, whose registers hold values up to `2^|x|`.

**Proof sketch.** `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_pspace_val` with the deciders of
`Complexity.inputLenLang` (in `L ⊆ PSPACE`) and `P`, and value bound `2^{|x| + 1}`. The
machine sets `p = 1`, counts `i = |x|` (`Complexity.LogProg.inputLength_loop`), doubles `p`
`|x|` times (`dbl_loop`), and searches `u = 0, …, 2^|x| - 1` (`enum_loop`); every register
stays at most `2^|x|`. -/
theorem searchLang_mem_PSPACE (hP : P ∈ PSPACE) : searchLang P ∈ PSPACE := by
  refine arm_decides_pspace_val searchA .init (decs P) (fun j => ?_) 1 1 fun x => ?_
  · match j with
    | 0 => exact LOGSPACE_subset_PSPACE inputLenLang_mem
    | 1 => exact hP
  set n := x.length with hn
  set B := 2 ^ (1 * (x.length + 1) ^ 1) with hB'
  have hB : 2 ^ n ≤ B := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by rw [pow_one, one_mul]; omega)
  have hnB : n ≤ B := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le.trans hB
  have h1B : 1 ≤ B := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  -- `init`: set `p = 1`
  have e0 : (fun _ : Fin 4 => 0) = rf 0 0 0 0 := by
    funext k
    match k with
    | ⟨0, _⟩ | ⟨1, _⟩ | ⟨2, _⟩ | ⟨3, _⟩ => rfl
    | ⟨_ + 4, h⟩ => omega
  rw [e0]
  refine AHalt.step (G := G x B) (guard_rf x B (i := 0) (p := 0) (t := 0) (u := 0) .init
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
  simp only [astep_inc (show searchA .init = _ from rfl), rf_1, rf_upd1, zero_add]
  -- count `i = |x|`
  have hq : ∀ k ≤ x.length, orc P 0 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits k)) = decide (k < x.length) := by
    intro k _
    simp only [orc, decs, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
    exact indicator_inputLenLang x k
  have hcount := inputLength_loop searchA (orc P) x 0 0 .scan .incI .dbl rfl rfl hq B
    (by omega) (rf 0 1 0 0) (fun s => (guard_rf x B .init (by omega) h1B (by omega) (by omega)).2 s)
    (by simp)
  simp only [rf_upd0] at hcount
  refine hcount.halt ?_
  -- double `p` `|x|` times, then search
  have hd := dbl_loop P x B n hB n 0 (by omega)
  rw [pow_zero] at hd
  refine hd.halt (enum_loop P x B n hB (2 ^ n) 0 (by omega) _ ?_)
  simp [indicator_eq_decide, searchLang, hn]

end WidthExample

end Complexity.LogProg
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/Machines/MARM.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMLoops
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMReach

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Abstract register machines with a monotone memory tape

A *memory register machine* (`Complexity.LogProg.MARM`) is an abstract register machine
(`Complexity.LogProg.ARM`) with one more device: a tape of bits (the *memory*), initially all
`0`, with a head, and four more instructions: branch on the bit under the head (`mread`), set
it to `1` (`mset`), and move the head (`mleft`, `mright`). Bits are never reset, so the
memory only grows. This is what an exponential-time algorithm needs beyond the counters of
a space-bounded one: a table indexed by register values (a visited set, [AB09, §4.1.1,
proof of Theorem 4.2]), addressed by walking the head. The compiled machine is in
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.MARMCompile`, its time bound in
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.MARMTime`.

Runs of a memory register machine between memory instructions are runs of its
*deterministic part* (`Complexity.LogProg.MARM.detPart`, answering a fixed bit at the memory
labels), so the counting loops of `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMLoops` and
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.InputAccess` transfer
(`Complexity.LogProg.MReach.of_areach`).

The machine model is infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1.1], not itself a result of the book.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.MIns`, `Complexity.LogProg.MARM` — instructions and machines.
* `Complexity.LogProg.MARM.detPart` — the register instructions, `ret β` at memory labels.
* `Complexity.LogProg.mstep`, `Complexity.LogProg.mrun` — the semantics.
* `Complexity.LogProg.MReach`, `Complexity.LogProg.MHalt` — runs through a guard.

## Main results

* the run algebra `mrun_add`, `MReach.trans`, `MReach.halt`, `MReach.step`, `MHalt.step`,
  `MHalt.ret`;
* `Complexity.LogProg.MReach.of_areach` — a run of the deterministic part to a live
  configuration is a run of the memory machine, the memory untouched.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1, Theorem 4.2.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

variable {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- The instructions of a memory register machine: a register instruction, or a memory
instruction. -/
inductive MIns (m d : ℕ) (Λ : Type) where
  /-- a register instruction of `Complexity.LogProg.Ins` -/
  | det (i : Ins m d Λ)
  /-- go to `l₁` if the memory bit under the head is `1`, else to `l₀` -/
  | mread (l₁ l₀ : Λ)
  /-- set the memory bit under the head to `1` -/
  | mset (l : Λ)
  /-- move the memory head one cell left -/
  | mleft (l : Λ)
  /-- move the memory head one cell right -/
  | mright (l : Λ)

/-- A memory register machine: an instruction at every label. -/
abbrev MARM (m d : ℕ) (Λ : Type) := Λ → MIns m d Λ

/-- Whether an instruction is a memory instruction. -/
def MIns.isMem {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} : MIns m d Λ → Bool
  | .det _ => false
  | _ => true

/-- The deterministic part of a memory register machine, answering `β` at the memory labels.
The compiled memory machine agrees with the compiled `A.detPart β` away from those labels. -/
def MARM.detPart (A : MARM m d Λ) (β : Bool) : ARM m d Λ := fun l =>
  match A l with
  | .det i => i
  | _ => .ret β

/-- At a register label the deterministic part is the instruction. -/
lemma MARM.detPart_det {A : MARM m d Λ} {l : Λ} {i : Ins m d Λ} (hA : A l = .det i)
    (β : Bool) : A.detPart β l = i := by
  simp [MARM.detPart, hA]

/-- At a memory label the deterministic part answers `β`. -/
lemma MARM.detPart_mem {A : MARM m d Λ} {l : Λ} (hA : (A l).isMem = true) (β : Bool) :
    A.detPart β l = .ret β := by
  unfold MARM.detPart
  cases h : A l with
  | det i => rw [h] at hA; simp [MIns.isMem] at hA
  | _ => rfl

/-- The memory: the bits (`true` = `1`) and the head position. -/
abbrev Mem := (ℤ → Bool) × ℤ

/-- A configuration of a memory register machine: an abstract configuration and the memory. -/
abbrev MConf (m : ℕ) (Λ : Type) := AConf m Λ × Mem

open Classical in
/-- **One step of a memory register machine** on input `x`, deciders answering `oracle`: a
register instruction acts as in `astep` on the abstract configuration, a memory instruction on
the memory; halted configurations are fixed. -/
noncomputable def mstep (A : MARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (x : List Bool) : MConf m Λ → MConf m Λ
  | ((none, v, res), μ) => ((none, v, res), μ)
  | ((some l, v, res), (M, p)) =>
    match A l with
    | .det i => (astep (fun _ => i) oracle x (some l, v, res), (M, p))
    | .mread l₁ l₀ => ((some (if M p then l₁ else l₀), v, res), (M, p))
    | .mset l' => ((some l', v, res), (Function.update M p true, p))
    | .mleft l' => ((some l', v, res), (M, p - 1))
    | .mright l' => ((some l', v, res), (M, p + 1))

/-- The run of a memory register machine. -/
noncomputable def mrun (A : MARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (c : MConf m Λ) (n : ℕ) : MConf m Λ :=
  (mstep A oracle x)^[n] c

/-- A run of a memory register machine from `a` to `a'` through configurations satisfying
`G`. -/
def MReach (A : MARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (G : MConf m Λ → Prop) (a a' : MConf m Λ) : Prop :=
  ∃ T, mrun A oracle x a T = a' ∧ ∀ t < T, G (mrun A oracle x a t)

/-- A run of a memory register machine from `a` answering `b`, through configurations
satisfying `G`. -/
def MHalt (A : MARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (G : MConf m Λ → Prop) (a : MConf m Λ) (b : Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ T, (mrun A oracle x a T).1.1 = none ∧ (mrun A oracle x a T).1.2.2 = some b ∧
    ∀ t < T, G (mrun A oracle x a t)

section Semantics

variable {A : MARM m d Λ} {oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool}

/-- At a register label a step is the step of the deterministic part, the memory untouched. -/
lemma mstep_det {l : Λ} {i : Ins m d Λ} (hA : A l = .det i) (β : Bool) (v : Fin m → ℕ)
    (res : Option Bool) (μ : Mem) :
    mstep A oracle x ((some l, v, res), μ) =
      (astep (A.detPart β) oracle x (some l, v, res), μ) := by
  obtain ⟨M, p⟩ := μ
  simp only [mstep, hA, astep, MARM.detPart_det hA β]

/-- Running `n + 1` steps is one step followed by `n` steps. -/
lemma mrun_succ (c : MConf m Λ) (n : ℕ) :
    mrun A oracle x c (n + 1) = mrun A oracle x (mstep A oracle x c) n := by
  simp [mrun, Function.iterate_succ_apply]

/-- Running `s + t` steps is running `s` steps, then `t` steps. -/
lemma mrun_add (c : MConf m Λ) (s t : ℕ) :
    mrun A oracle x c (s + t) = mrun A oracle x (mrun A oracle x c s) t := by
  simp only [mrun]; rw [Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply]

/-- A halted configuration stays put. -/
lemma mrun_halted (v : Fin m → ℕ) (res : Option Bool) (μ : Mem) (n : ℕ) :
    mrun A oracle x ((none, v, res), μ) n = ((none, v, res), μ) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [mrun_succ]; exact ih

end Semantics

section Combinators

variable {A : MARM m d Λ} {oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool} {G : MConf m Λ → Prop}

/-- Every configuration reaches itself. -/
lemma MReach.refl (a : MConf m Λ) : MReach A oracle x G a a := ⟨0, rfl, fun t h => by omega⟩

/-- Runs compose. -/
lemma MReach.trans {a b c : MConf m Λ} (h₁ : MReach A oracle x G a b)
    (h₂ : MReach A oracle x G b c) : MReach A oracle x G a c := by
  obtain ⟨T₁, e1, m1⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨T₂, e2, m2⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨T₁ + T₂, by rw [mrun_add, e1, e2], fun t ht => ?_⟩
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T₁ with h | h
  · exact m1 t h
  · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = T₁ + t' := ⟨t - T₁, by omega⟩
    rw [mrun_add, e1]; exact m2 t' (by omega)

/-- A run followed by a halting run is a halting run with the same answer. -/
lemma MReach.halt {a b : MConf m Λ} {r : Bool} (h₁ : MReach A oracle x G a b)
    (h₂ : MHalt A oracle x G b r) : MHalt A oracle x G a r := by
  obtain ⟨T₁, e1, m1⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨T₂, f1, f2, m2⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨T₁ + T₂, by rw [mrun_add, e1]; exact f1, by rw [mrun_add, e1]; exact f2,
    fun t ht => ?_⟩
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T₁ with h | h
  · exact m1 t h
  · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = T₁ + t' := ⟨t - T₁, by omega⟩
    rw [mrun_add, e1]; exact m2 t' (by omega)

/-- A configuration satisfying the guard reaches its successor in one step. -/
lemma MReach.single {a : MConf m Λ} (hG : G a) :
    MReach A oracle x G a (mstep A oracle x a) := ⟨1, rfl, fun t ht => by
  obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
  exact hG⟩

/-- A step followed by a run. -/
lemma MReach.step {a c : MConf m Λ} (hG : G a) (h : MReach A oracle x G (mstep A oracle x a) c) :
    MReach A oracle x G a c := (MReach.single hG).trans h

/-- A step followed by a halting run. -/
lemma MHalt.step {a : MConf m Λ} {r : Bool} (hG : G a)
    (h : MHalt A oracle x G (mstep A oracle x a) r) : MHalt A oracle x G a r :=
  (MReach.single hG).halt h

/-- Answering in one step. -/
lemma MHalt.ret {l : Λ} {v : Fin m → ℕ} {r : Bool} {μ : Mem} (hA : A l = .det (.ret r))
    (hG : G ((some l, v, none), μ)) : MHalt A oracle x G ((some l, v, none), μ) r :=
  ⟨1, by obtain ⟨M, p⟩ := μ; simp [mrun, mstep, hA, astep_ret (A := fun _ => .ret r) rfl],
    by obtain ⟨M, p⟩ := μ; simp [mrun, mstep, hA, astep_ret (A := fun _ => .ret r) rfl],
    fun t ht => by
      obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
      exact hG⟩

/-- Rewriting the end configuration of a run along an equation. -/
lemma MReach.of_eq {a b b' : MConf m Λ} (h : MReach A oracle x G a b) (e : b = b') :
    MReach A oracle x G a b' := e ▸ h

/-- A run through a guard is a run through any weaker guard. -/
lemma MReach.mono {G' : MConf m Λ → Prop} {a b : MConf m Λ} (h : MReach A oracle x G a b)
    (hG : ∀ c, G c → G' c) : MReach A oracle x G' a b := by
  obtain ⟨T, e, hm⟩ := h; exact ⟨T, e, fun t ht => hG _ (hm t ht)⟩

/-- A halting run through a guard is a halting run through any weaker guard. -/
lemma MHalt.mono {G' : MConf m Λ → Prop} {a : MConf m Λ} {r : Bool}
    (h : MHalt A oracle x G a r) (hG : ∀ c, G c → G' c) : MHalt A oracle x G' a r := by
  obtain ⟨T, e1, e2, hm⟩ := h; exact ⟨T, e1, e2, fun t ht => hG _ (hm t ht)⟩

end Combinators

section Transfer

variable {A : MARM m d Λ} {oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool}

/-- A run of the deterministic part from `a` that is live at time `T` is, up to time `T`, a
run of the memory machine with the memory untouched.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the time. A live run never visits a memory label before its
end: there the deterministic part answers and halts for good (`arun_halted`). At register
labels the two steps agree (`mstep_det`); halted configurations are fixed by both. -/
lemma mrun_eq_arun (β : Bool) (a : AConf m Λ) (μ : Mem) (T : ℕ)
    (hlive : (arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a T).1 ≠ none) :
    ∀ t ≤ T, mrun A oracle x (a, μ) t = (arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a t, μ) := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => intro _; rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    intro ht
    have e := ih (by omega)
    rw [mrun_add, e]
    show mstep A oracle x _ = _
    rw [show arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a (t + 1) =
      astep (A.detPart β) oracle x (arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a t) by
        simp [arun, Function.iterate_succ_apply']]
    generalize hc : arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a t = c
    obtain ⟨_ | l, v, res⟩ := c
    · rfl
    · cases hA : A l with
      | det i => exact mstep_det hA β v res μ
      | _ =>
        exfalso
        have hret : A.detPart β l = .ret β := MARM.detPart_mem (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem]) β
        have h1 : arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a (t + 1) = (none, v, some β) := by
          simp [arun, Function.iterate_succ_apply'] at hc ⊢
          rw [hc]; simp [astep_ret hret]
        apply hlive
        rw [show T = (t + 1) + (T - (t + 1)) by omega, arun_add, h1, arun_halted]

/-- **Runs of the deterministic part transfer.** A run of `A.detPart β` through `G` from `a`
to a live configuration `a'` is a run of the memory machine from `(a, μ)` to `(a', μ)` through
configurations whose abstract part satisfies `G` and whose memory is `μ`.

**Proof sketch.** `mrun_eq_arun` up to the end of the run. -/
lemma MReach.of_areach {β : Bool} {G : AConf m Λ → Prop} {a a' : AConf m Λ} (μ : Mem)
    (h : AReach (A.detPart β) oracle x G a a') (hlive : a'.1 ≠ none) :
    MReach A oracle x (fun c => G c.1 ∧ c.2 = μ) (a, μ) (a', μ) := by
  obtain ⟨T, e, hm⟩ := h
  have key := mrun_eq_arun (A := A) (oracle := oracle) (x := x) β a μ T (by rw [e]; exact hlive)
  refine ⟨T, by rw [key T le_rfl, e], fun t ht => ?_⟩
  rw [key t ht.le]
  exact ⟨hm t ht, rfl⟩

end Transfer

end Complexity.LogProg
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/Machines/NARMExample.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.NARMProof

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# A sanity example of a nondeterministic abstract register machine

The language of well-formed inputs `⟨1ⁿ, w⟩` (`Complexity.LogProg.ValidPlain`), decided by
guessing: the machine `Complexity.LogProg.guessValidA` first chooses a branch; on branch `1`
it checks the input format and answers `true` when it is valid, on branch `0` it answers
`false`. Some branch accepts exactly on valid inputs, so the language is in `NL`
(`Complexity.LogProg.validPlainLang_mem_NL`, by `Complexity.LogProg.narm_decides`). The
language is of course in `L` already; the example only exercises the interface of
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.NARM` and
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.NARMProof` (the combinators `NHalts.choose`,
`NHalts.det`, `nans_choose`, `nans_det`, `nans_halted`).

This is a test of infrastructure for [AB09, §4.3], not a result of the book.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.validPlainLang`, `Complexity.LogProg.guessValidA`.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.validPlainLang_mem_NL`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.3.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

/-- The well-formed inputs `⟨1ⁿ, w⟩` with `w` a canonical binary word. -/
def validPlainLang : Language Bool := {x | ValidPlain x}

/-- The guessing machine, one register, no deciders: label `0` chooses between `1` and `2`;
label `1` checks the input format and goes to `3`; label `2` answers `false`; label `3`
answers `true`. -/
def guessValidA : NARM 1 0 (Fin 4) :=
  ![.choose 1 2, .det (.valP 0 3), .det (.ret false), .det (.ret true)]

/-- Every choice word of length `3` halts the guessing machine, through configurations with all
registers `0`. -/
lemma guessValidA_halts (x : List Bool) (G : AConf 1 (Fin 4) → Prop)
    (hG : ∀ l res, G (some l, fun _ => 0, res)) (oracle : Fin 0 → List Bool → Bool) :
    NHalts guessValidA oracle x G (some 0, fun _ => 0, none) 3 := by
  have h3 : NHalts guessValidA oracle x G (some 3, fun _ => 0, none) 1 :=
    NHalts.det (i := .ret true) rfl false (hG _ _) (by
      simpa [astep_ret (show guessValidA.detPart false 3 = _ from rfl)] using
        NHalts.halted _ _ 0)
  have h1 : NHalts guessValidA oracle x G (some 1, fun _ => 0, none) 2 := by
    refine NHalts.det (i := .valP 0 3) rfl false (hG _ _) ?_
    by_cases hv : ValidPlain x
    · simpa [astep_valP (show guessValidA.detPart false 1 = _ from rfl), hv] using h3
    · simpa [astep_valP (show guessValidA.detPart false 1 = _ from rfl), hv] using
        NHalts.halted _ _ 1
  have h2 : NHalts guessValidA oracle x G (some 2, fun _ => 0, none) 2 :=
    NHalts.det (i := .ret false) rfl false (hG _ _) (by
      simpa [astep_ret (show guessValidA.detPart false 2 = _ from rfl)] using
        NHalts.halted _ _ 1)
  exact NHalts.choose (A := guessValidA) (l := 0) (l₁ := 1) (l₀ := 2) rfl (hG _ _) h1 h2

/-- Some choice word of length `3` makes the guessing machine answer `true` iff the input is
well formed. -/
lemma guessValidA_ans (x : List Bool) (oracle : Fin 0 → List Bool → Bool) :
    NAns guessValidA oracle x (some 0, fun _ => 0, none) 3 true ↔ ValidPlain x := by
  rw [nans_choose (A := guessValidA) (l := 0) (l₁ := 1) (l₀ := 2) rfl,
    nans_det (i := .valP 0 3) rfl false,
    nans_det (i := .ret false) rfl false]
  by_cases hv : ValidPlain x
  · have e : astep (guessValidA.detPart false) oracle x (some 1, fun _ => 0, none) =
        (some 3, fun _ => 0, none) := by
      simp [astep_valP (show guessValidA.detPart false 1 = _ from rfl), hv]
    rw [e, nans_det (i := .ret true) rfl false]
    simp [astep_ret (show guessValidA.detPart false 3 = _ from rfl),
      astep_ret (show guessValidA.detPart false 2 = _ from rfl), nans_halted, hv]
  · have e : astep (guessValidA.detPart false) oracle x (some 1, fun _ => 0, none) =
        (none, fun _ => 0, some false) := by
      simp [astep_valP (show guessValidA.detPart false 1 = _ from rfl), hv]
    rw [e]
    simp [astep_ret (show guessValidA.detPart false 2 = _ from rfl), nans_halted, hv]

/-- **The well-formed inputs are in `NL`, by guessing.** A sanity check of `narm_decides`. -/
theorem validPlainLang_mem_NL : validPlainLang ∈ NL := by
  refine narm_decides guessValidA 0 (fun j => j.elim0) (fun j => j.elim0) 1 fun x => ?_
  have hpre : ∀ (l : Fin 4) (res : Option Bool), NPreS guessValidA x (some l, fun _ => 0, res) := by
    intro l res
    fin_cases l <;> simp [NPreS, PreS, NARM.detPart, guessValidA]
  have hw : (Nat.bits (0 + 1)).length ≤ 1 * logSpace x.length := by
    have : (Nat.bits (0 + 1)).length ≤ 1 := length_bits_le (by norm_num)
    have : 1 ≤ logSpace x.length := by simp [logSpace]
    omega
  exact ⟨3, guessValidA_halts x _ (fun l res => ⟨hpre l res, fun _ => hw⟩) _,
    (guessValidA_ans x _).symm⟩

end Complexity.LogProg
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/Machines/NARMKit.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.NARM
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.InputAccess
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.VWord

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Proving nondeterministic register machines correct by continuation

The combinators of `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.NARM` (`NHalts`, `NAns`) fix
the length `N` of the choice words in advance, which is awkward for loops whose length
depends on earlier guesses. This file proves machines correct without explicit lengths:

* `Complexity.LogProg.NTerm` — every branch terminates, through configurations meeting a
  guard (an inductive, well-founded predicate);
* `Complexity.LogProg.NAcc` — some choice word, of any length, halts with answer `true`;
* `Complexity.LogProg.NSem a P` — both: every branch from `a` terminates, and some branch
  accepts iff `P`.

Since every configuration has only two successors, termination of every branch gives a
uniform length bound (`Complexity.LogProg.NTerm.nhalts`, by induction on the inductive
termination predicate), and then `NAcc` agrees with `NAns` at that length
(`Complexity.LogProg.NSem.decides`) — the form `narm_decides` consumes. Machine-specific
loop lemmas are proved in continuation-passing style: the semantics at a loop head is
derived from the semantics at its exits. Three generic loops are included: guessing a value
below a register bound (`nsem_guess`), copying a register (`nsem_copy`), and adding twice a
register to another (`nsem_addTwice`).

This is infrastructure for [AB09, §4.3] (nondeterministic logspace algorithms), not itself a
result of the book; it is written for `Complexity.PATH_mem_NL`.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.NTerm`, `Complexity.LogProg.NAcc`, `Complexity.LogProg.NSem`.
* `Complexity.LogProg.RegLe` — the register-bound guard.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.NTerm.nhalts`, `Complexity.LogProg.NSem.decides`.
* the step lemmas `NSem.det`, `NSem.choose`, `NSem.inc`, `NSem.clr`, `NSem.half`,
  `NSem.jeq_pos`, `NSem.jeq_neg`, `NSem.jz_pos`, `NSem.jz_neg`, `NSem.jodd_pos`,
  `NSem.jodd_neg`, `NSem.call_pos`, `NSem.call_neg`, `NSem.ret`, and `nsem_dec`,
  `nsem_call₂_pos`, `nsem_call₂_neg`, `nsem_call₃_pos`, `nsem_call₃_neg` (decrements and
  `whole`-mode calls on two and three registers).
* the loops `Complexity.LogProg.nsem_guess`, `Complexity.LogProg.nsem_copy`,
  `Complexity.LogProg.nsem_addTwice`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.3.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

variable {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- **Every branch terminates** from a configuration, through live configurations satisfying
the guard `G`: a halted configuration terminates, and a live one satisfying `G` terminates if
both of its successors do. -/
inductive NTerm (A : NARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (G : AConf m Λ → Prop) : AConf m Λ → Prop
  /-- a halted configuration -/
  | halted (v : Fin m → ℕ) (res : Option Bool) : NTerm A oracle x G (none, v, res)
  /-- a live configuration satisfying the guard, both of whose successors terminate -/
  | step (l : Λ) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (res : Option Bool) (hG : G (some l, v, res))
      (h : ∀ b, NTerm A oracle x G (nastep A oracle x b (some l, v, res))) :
      NTerm A oracle x G (some l, v, res)

/-- **Some branch accepts**: some choice word, of any length, halts the machine from `a` with
the answer `true`. -/
def NAcc (A : NARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (a : AConf m Λ) : Prop :=
  ∃ σ : List Bool, (narun A oracle x σ a).1 = none ∧ (narun A oracle x σ a).2.2 = some true

/-- **The semantics of a configuration**: every branch from `a` terminates through the guard
`G`, and some branch accepts iff `P`. -/
def NSem (A : NARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (G : AConf m Λ → Prop) (a : AConf m Λ) (P : Prop) : Prop :=
  NTerm A oracle x G a ∧ (NAcc A oracle x a ↔ P)

/-- The register-bound guard: every register value is at most `B`. -/
def RegLe (m : ℕ) (Λ : Type) (B : ℕ) (a : AConf m Λ) : Prop := ∀ r, a.2.1 r ≤ B

section Semantics

variable {A : NARM m d Λ} {oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool} {G : AConf m Λ → Prop}

/-- **Termination of every branch gives a uniform length bound**: if every branch terminates
from `a`, then for some `N` every choice word of length `N` halts the machine.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `NTerm`; at a live configuration take one more than the
larger of the bounds of the two successors (`NHalts.mono_len`), the guard at time `0` being
the hypothesis. -/
theorem NTerm.nhalts {a : AConf m Λ} (h : NTerm A oracle x G a) :
    ∃ N, NHalts A oracle x G a N := by
  induction h with
  | halted v res => exact ⟨0, NHalts.halted v res 0⟩
  | step l v res hG _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := ih true
    obtain ⟨N₀, h₀⟩ := ih false
    refine ⟨max N₁ N₀ + 1, fun σ hσ => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨b, σ', rfl⟩ : ∃ b σ', σ = b :: σ' := by
      cases σ with
      | nil => simp at hσ
      | cons b σ' => exact ⟨b, σ', rfl⟩
    simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hσ
    have hb : NHalts A oracle x G (nastep A oracle x b (some l, v, res)) (max N₁ N₀) := by
      cases b
      · exact h₀.mono_len (le_max_right _ _)
      · exact h₁.mono_len (le_max_left _ _)
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hb σ' hσ
    refine ⟨by rw [narun_cons]; exact h1, fun t ht hl => ?_⟩
    cases t with
    | zero => simpa using hG
    | succ t =>
      simp only [List.take_succ_cons, narun_cons] at hl ⊢
      exact h2 t (by omega) hl

/-- A halted configuration accepts iff its answer is `true`. -/
lemma nacc_halted (v : Fin m → ℕ) (res : Option Bool) :
    NAcc A oracle x (none, v, res) ↔ res = some true := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, -, h⟩; simpa using h
  · intro h; exact ⟨[], rfl, h⟩

/-- A live configuration accepts iff one of its successors does. -/
lemma nacc_live (l : Λ) (v : Fin m → ℕ) :
    NAcc A oracle x (some l, v, none) ↔
      ∃ b, NAcc A oracle x (nastep A oracle x b (some l, v, none)) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, h1, h2⟩
    cases σ with
    | nil => simp at h1
    | cons b σ => exact ⟨b, σ, h1, h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, σ, h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨b :: σ, h1, h2⟩

/-- At a deterministic label a step does not depend on the choice bit. -/
lemma nastep_det' {l : Λ} {i : Ins m d Λ} (hA : A l = .det i) (b : Bool) (v : Fin m → ℕ)
    (res : Option Bool) :
    nastep A oracle x b (some l, v, res) = astep (fun _ => i) oracle x (some l, v, res) := by
  simp only [nastep, hA]

/-- **Semantics transfer along an equivalence of the predicate.** -/
lemma NSem.congr {a : AConf m Λ} {P Q : Prop} (h : NSem A oracle x G a P) (hPQ : P ↔ Q) :
    NSem A oracle x G a Q :=
  ⟨h.1, h.2.trans hPQ⟩

/-- A halted configuration answering `b` accepts iff `b = true`. -/
lemma NSem.halted (v : Fin m → ℕ) (b : Bool) :
    NSem A oracle x G (none, v, some b) (b = true) :=
  ⟨NTerm.halted v _, by rw [nacc_halted]; cases b <;> simp⟩

/-- **A deterministic step.** -/
lemma NSem.det {l : Λ} {i : Ins m d Λ} (hA : A l = .det i) {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop}
    (hG : G (some l, v, none))
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (astep (fun _ => i) oracle x (some l, v, none)) P) :
    NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P := by
  refine ⟨NTerm.step l v none hG fun b => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [nastep_det' hA]; exact h.1
  · rw [nacc_live]
    simp only [nastep_det' hA]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨_, h'⟩ => h.2.mp h', fun hp => ⟨false, h.2.mpr hp⟩⟩

/-- **A `choose`**: some branch accepts iff some branch from either target does. -/
lemma NSem.choose {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} (hA : A l = .choose l₁ l₀) {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P₁ P₀ : Prop}
    (hG : G (some l, v, none)) (h₁ : NSem A oracle x G (some l₁, v, none) P₁)
    (h₀ : NSem A oracle x G (some l₀, v, none) P₀) :
    NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) (P₁ ∨ P₀) := by
  have e : ∀ b, nastep A oracle x b (some l, v, none) =
      (some (if b then l₁ else l₀), v, none) := fun b => nastep_choose hA b v none
  refine ⟨NTerm.step l v none hG fun b => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [e]; cases b
    · exact h₀.1
    · exact h₁.1
  · rw [nacc_live]
    simp only [e]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
      cases b
      · exact Or.inr (h₀.2.mp hb)
      · exact Or.inl (h₁.2.mp hb)
    · rintro (hp | hp)
      · exact ⟨true, h₁.2.mpr hp⟩
      · exact ⟨false, h₀.2.mpr hp⟩

/-- An increment. -/
lemma NSem.inc {l l' : Λ} {r : Fin m} (hA : A l = .det (.inc r l')) {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop}
    (hG : G (some l, v, none))
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l', Function.update v r (v r + 1), none) P) :
    NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by simpa only [astep_inc (A := fun _ => .inc r l') rfl] using h)

/-- A clear. -/
lemma NSem.clr {l l' : Λ} {r : Fin m} (hA : A l = .det (.clr r l')) {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop}
    (hG : G (some l, v, none)) (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l', Function.update v r 0, none) P) :
    NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by simpa only [astep_clr (A := fun _ => .clr r l') rfl] using h)

/-- A halving. -/
lemma NSem.half {l l' : Λ} {r : Fin m} (hA : A l = .det (.half r l')) {v : Fin m → ℕ}
    {P : Prop} (hG : G (some l, v, none))
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l', Function.update v r (v r / 2), none) P) :
    NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by simpa only [astep_half (A := fun _ => .half r l') rfl] using h)

/-- An equality test that succeeds. -/
lemma NSem.jeq_pos {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} {r s : Fin m} (hA : A l = .det (.jeq r s l₁ l₀))
    {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop} (hG : G (some l, v, none)) (he : v r = v s)
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l₁, v, none) P) : NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by simpa only [astep_jeq (A := fun _ => .jeq r s l₁ l₀) rfl, if_pos he] using h)

/-- An equality test that fails. -/
lemma NSem.jeq_neg {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} {r s : Fin m} (hA : A l = .det (.jeq r s l₁ l₀))
    {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop} (hG : G (some l, v, none)) (he : v r ≠ v s)
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l₀, v, none) P) : NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by simpa only [astep_jeq (A := fun _ => .jeq r s l₁ l₀) rfl, if_neg he] using h)

/-- A zero test that succeeds. -/
lemma NSem.jz_pos {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} {r : Fin m} (hA : A l = .det (.jz r l₁ l₀))
    {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop} (hG : G (some l, v, none)) (he : v r = 0)
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l₁, v, none) P) : NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by simpa only [astep_jz (A := fun _ => .jz r l₁ l₀) rfl, if_pos he] using h)

/-- A zero test that fails. -/
lemma NSem.jz_neg {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} {r : Fin m} (hA : A l = .det (.jz r l₁ l₀))
    {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop} (hG : G (some l, v, none)) (he : v r ≠ 0)
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l₀, v, none) P) : NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by simpa only [astep_jz (A := fun _ => .jz r l₁ l₀) rfl, if_neg he] using h)

/-- A parity test that succeeds. -/
lemma NSem.jodd_pos {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} {r : Fin m} (hA : A l = .det (.jodd r l₁ l₀))
    {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop} (hG : G (some l, v, none)) (he : v r % 2 = 1)
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l₁, v, none) P) : NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by simpa only [astep_jodd (A := fun _ => .jodd r l₁ l₀) rfl, if_pos he] using h)

/-- A parity test that fails. -/
lemma NSem.jodd_neg {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} {r : Fin m} (hA : A l = .det (.jodd r l₁ l₀))
    {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop} (hG : G (some l, v, none)) (he : ¬ v r % 2 = 1)
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l₀, v, none) P) : NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by simpa only [astep_jodd (A := fun _ => .jodd r l₁ l₀) rfl, if_neg he] using h)

/-- A `whole`-mode call on one register that answers `true`. -/
lemma NSem.call_pos {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} {j : Fin d} {r : Fin m}
    (hA : A l = .det (.call j .whole [r] l₁ l₀)) {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop}
    (hG : G (some l, v, none)) (he : oracle j (pairEncode x (Nat.bits (v r))) = true)
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l₁, v, none) P) : NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by
    simpa only [astep_call (A := fun _ => .call j .whole [r] l₁ l₀) rfl, vword_whole₁, he,
      if_true] using h)

/-- A `whole`-mode call on one register that answers `false`. -/
lemma NSem.call_neg {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} {j : Fin d} {r : Fin m}
    (hA : A l = .det (.call j .whole [r] l₁ l₀)) {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop}
    (hG : G (some l, v, none)) (he : oracle j (pairEncode x (Nat.bits (v r))) = false)
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l₀, v, none) P) : NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by
    simpa only [astep_call (A := fun _ => .call j .whole [r] l₁ l₀) rfl, vword_whole₁, he,
      Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] using h)

/-- A decrement. -/
lemma nsem_dec {l l' : Λ} {r : Fin m} (hA : A l = .det (.dec r l')) {v : Fin m → ℕ}
    {P : Prop} (hG : G (some l, v, none))
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l', Function.update v r (v r - 1), none) P) :
    NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by simpa only [astep_dec (A := fun _ => .dec r l') rfl] using h)

/-- A `whole`-mode call on two registers that answers `true`. -/
lemma nsem_call₂_pos {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} {j : Fin d} {r s : Fin m}
    (hA : A l = .det (.call j .whole [r, s] l₁ l₀)) {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop}
    (hG : G (some l, v, none))
    (he : oracle j (pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits (v r)) (Nat.bits (v s)))) = true)
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l₁, v, none) P) : NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by
    simpa only [astep_call (A := fun _ => .call j .whole [r, s] l₁ l₀) rfl, vword_whole₂, he,
      if_true] using h)

/-- A `whole`-mode call on two registers that answers `false`. -/
lemma nsem_call₂_neg {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} {j : Fin d} {r s : Fin m}
    (hA : A l = .det (.call j .whole [r, s] l₁ l₀)) {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop}
    (hG : G (some l, v, none))
    (he : oracle j (pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits (v r)) (Nat.bits (v s)))) = false)
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l₀, v, none) P) : NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by
    simpa only [astep_call (A := fun _ => .call j .whole [r, s] l₁ l₀) rfl, vword_whole₂, he,
      Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] using h)

/-- A `whole`-mode call on three registers that answers `true`. -/
lemma nsem_call₃_pos {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} {j : Fin d} {r s t : Fin m}
    (hA : A l = .det (.call j .whole [r, s, t] l₁ l₀)) {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop}
    (hG : G (some l, v, none))
    (he : oracle j (pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits (v r))
      (pairEncode (Nat.bits (v s)) (Nat.bits (v t))))) = true)
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l₁, v, none) P) : NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by
    simpa only [astep_call (A := fun _ => .call j .whole [r, s, t] l₁ l₀) rfl, vword_whole₃, he,
      if_true] using h)

/-- A `whole`-mode call on three registers that answers `false`. -/
lemma nsem_call₃_neg {l l₁ l₀ : Λ} {j : Fin d} {r s t : Fin m}
    (hA : A l = .det (.call j .whole [r, s, t] l₁ l₀)) {v : Fin m → ℕ} {P : Prop}
    (hG : G (some l, v, none))
    (he : oracle j (pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits (v r))
      (pairEncode (Nat.bits (v s)) (Nat.bits (v t))))) = false)
    (h : NSem A oracle x G (some l₀, v, none) P) : NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) P :=
  NSem.det hA hG (by
    simpa only [astep_call (A := fun _ => .call j .whole [r, s, t] l₁ l₀) rfl, vword_whole₃, he,
      Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] using h)

/-- An answer: some branch accepts iff the answer is `true`. -/
lemma NSem.ret {l : Λ} {b : Bool} (hA : A l = .det (.ret b)) {v : Fin m → ℕ}
    (hG : G (some l, v, none)) : NSem A oracle x G (some l, v, none) (b = true) := by
  have hh : NSem A oracle x G (none, v, some b) (b = true) := NSem.halted v b
  exact NSem.det hA hG (by simpa only [astep_ret (A := fun _ => .ret b) rfl] using hh)

/-- **Semantics gives the decision interface**: if every branch from `a` terminates through
`G` and some branch accepts iff `P`, then for some `N` every choice word of length `N` halts
through `G`, and `P` holds iff some choice word of length `N` answers `true`.

**Proof sketch.** `NTerm.nhalts` gives `N`. An accepting word shorter than `N` is padded (the
run is halted); a longer one is cut to its prefix of length `N`, after which the run is
halted already; conversely a word of length `N` answering `true` is halted, hence accepting. -/
theorem NSem.decides {a : AConf m Λ} {P : Prop} (h : NSem A oracle x G a P) :
    ∃ N, NHalts A oracle x G a N ∧ (P ↔ NAns A oracle x a N true) := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h.1.nhalts
  refine ⟨N, hN, h.2.symm.trans ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  swap
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, h2⟩
    exact ⟨σ, (hN σ hσ).1, h2⟩
  rintro ⟨σ, h1, h2⟩
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge σ.length N with hl | hl
  · refine ⟨σ ++ List.replicate (N - σ.length) false, by simp; omega, ?_⟩
    rwa [narun_append_of_halted h1]
  · have hlen : (σ.take N).length = N := by simp; omega
    refine ⟨σ.take N, hlen, ?_⟩
    rwa [← List.take_append_drop N σ, narun_append_of_halted (hN _ hlen).1] at h2

end Semantics

/-! ## Generic loops -/

section Loops

variable (A : NARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool) (B : ℕ)

/-- **Guessing a value below a bound**: the loop `test: if g = nr reject; ch: choose (exit,
more); more: g := g + 1; goto test` has, from `g ≤ nr`, an accepting branch iff some value
`j ∈ [g, nr)` has an accepting branch from the exit with `g := j`; every branch terminates.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `nr - g`: at `g = nr` the test rejects; otherwise the choice
either exits with the current value or increments and recurs. -/
theorem nsem_guess (g nr : Fin m) (hgn : g ≠ nr) (test ch more ex rej : Λ)
    (htest : A test = .det (.jeq g nr rej ch)) (hch : A ch = .choose ex more)
    (hmore : A more = .det (.inc g test)) (hrej : A rej = .det (.ret false))
    (Q : ℕ → Prop) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B) (hle : v g ≤ v nr)
    (hK : ∀ j, v g ≤ j → j < v nr →
      NSem A oracle x (RegLe m Λ B) (some ex, Function.update v g j, none) (Q j)) :
    NSem A oracle x (RegLe m Λ B) (some test, v, none) (∃ j, v g ≤ j ∧ j < v nr ∧ Q j) := by
  generalize hk : v nr - v g = k
  induction k generalizing v with
  | zero =>
    have he : v g = v nr := by omega
    refine (NSem.jeq_pos htest hv he (NSem.ret hrej hv)).congr ?_
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff, not_exists, not_and]
    intro j h1 h2; omega
  | succ k ih =>
    have hne : v g ≠ v nr := by omega
    let v' := Function.update v g (v g + 1)
    have hv' : ∀ r, v' r ≤ B := register_update_le v g B _ hv (by have := hv nr; omega)
    have hg' : v' g = v g + 1 := by simp [v']
    have hn' : v' nr = v nr := by simp [v', Function.update_of_ne hgn.symm]
    have hrec := ih v' hv' (by omega)
      (fun j h1 h2 => by
        have := hK j (by omega) (by omega)
        simpa only [v', Function.update_idem] using this)
      (by omega)
    rw [hg', hn'] at hrec
    have hstay := hK (v g) le_rfl (by omega)
    rw [Function.update_eq_self] at hstay
    refine (NSem.jeq_neg htest hv hne
      (NSem.choose hch hv hstay (NSem.inc hmore hv hrec))).congr ?_
    constructor
    · rintro (h | ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩)
      · exact ⟨v g, le_rfl, by omega, h⟩
      · exact ⟨j, by omega, h2, h3⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩
      rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (h ▸ h3)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨j, h, h2, h3⟩

/-- **Copying a register** by counting the destination up to the source (the destination
starting at most the source): the semantics at the loop head is that at the exit with the
destination equal to the source.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the difference: equality exits, otherwise increment. -/
theorem nsem_copy (dst src : Fin m) (hne : dst ≠ src) (test bump ex : Λ)
    (htest : A test = .det (.jeq dst src ex bump)) (hbump : A bump = .det (.inc dst test))
    (P : Prop) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B) (hle : v dst ≤ v src)
    (hK : NSem A oracle x (RegLe m Λ B) (some ex, Function.update v dst (v src), none) P) :
    NSem A oracle x (RegLe m Λ B) (some test, v, none) P := by
  generalize hk : v src - v dst = k
  induction k generalizing v with
  | zero =>
    have he : v dst = v src := by omega
    rw [← he, Function.update_eq_self] at hK
    exact NSem.jeq_pos htest hv he hK
  | succ k ih =>
    have hlt : v dst ≠ v src := by omega
    let v' := Function.update v dst (v dst + 1)
    have hv' : ∀ r, v' r ≤ B := register_update_le v dst B _ hv (by have := hv src; omega)
    have hs : v' src = v src := by simp [v', Function.update_of_ne hne.symm]
    have hd : v' dst = v dst + 1 := by simp [v']
    refine NSem.jeq_neg htest hv hlt (NSem.inc hbump hv ?_)
    refine ih v' hv' (by omega) ?_ (by omega)
    simpa only [hs, v', Function.update_idem] using hK

/-- **Adding twice a register**: the loop `test: if k = y exit; p += 2; k += 1; goto test`
(with `k`, `y`, `p` distinct), from `k ≤ y`, adds `2 (y - k)` to `p` and leaves `k = y`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `y - k`; each round is two increments of `p` and one of
`k`, all bounded by the final value of `p`. -/
theorem nsem_addTwice (k y p : Fin m) (hky : k ≠ y) (hkp : k ≠ p) (hpy : p ≠ y)
    (test i₁ i₂ i₃ ex : Λ)
    (htest : A test = .det (.jeq k y ex i₁)) (h₁ : A i₁ = .det (.inc p i₂))
    (h₂ : A i₂ = .det (.inc p i₃)) (h₃ : A i₃ = .det (.inc k test))
    (P : Prop) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B) (hle : v k ≤ v y)
    (hb : v p + 2 * (v y - v k) ≤ B)
    (hK : NSem A oracle x (RegLe m Λ B)
      (some ex, Function.update (Function.update v p (v p + 2 * (v y - v k))) k (v y), none) P) :
    NSem A oracle x (RegLe m Λ B) (some test, v, none) P := by
  suffices H : ∀ c (v : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ r, v r ≤ B) → v k ≤ v y → v y - v k = c →
      v p + 2 * c ≤ B →
      NSem A oracle x (RegLe m Λ B)
        (some ex, Function.update (Function.update v p (v p + 2 * c)) k (v y), none) P →
      NSem A oracle x (RegLe m Λ B) (some test, v, none) P from
    H _ v hv hle rfl hb hK
  intro c
  induction c with
  | zero =>
    intro v hv hle hc _ hK
    have he : v k = v y := by omega
    simp only [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.add_zero, Function.update_eq_self, ← he] at hK
    exact NSem.jeq_pos htest hv he hK
  | succ c ih =>
    intro v hv hle hc hb hK
    have hne : v k ≠ v y := by omega
    let v₁ := Function.update v p (v p + 1)
    let v₂ := Function.update v₁ p (v₁ p + 1)
    let v₃ := Function.update v₂ k (v₂ k + 1)
    have hv₁ : ∀ r, v₁ r ≤ B := register_update_le v p B _ hv (by omega)
    have e₁ : v₁ p = v p + 1 := by simp [v₁]
    have hv₂ : ∀ r, v₂ r ≤ B := register_update_le v₁ p B _ hv₁ (by omega)
    have e₂k : v₂ k = v k := by simp [v₂, v₁, Function.update_of_ne hkp]
    have hv₃ : ∀ r, v₃ r ≤ B := register_update_le v₂ k B _ hv₂ (by
      rw [e₂k]; have := hv y; omega)
    have e₃k : v₃ k = v k + 1 := by simp [v₃, e₂k]
    have e₃y : v₃ y = v y := by
      simp [v₃, v₂, v₁, Function.update_of_ne hky.symm, Function.update_of_ne hpy.symm]
    have e₃p : v₃ p = v p + 2 := by
      simp [v₃, v₂, v₁, Function.update_of_ne hkp.symm]
    have hfin : Function.update (Function.update v₃ p (v₃ p + 2 * c)) k (v₃ y) =
        Function.update (Function.update v p (v p + 2 * (c + 1))) k (v y) := by
      rw [e₃p, e₃y]
      funext r
      by_cases hr : r = k
      · subst hr; simp
      · by_cases hp : r = p
        · subst hp; simp [Function.update_of_ne hkp.symm]; omega
        · simp [v₃, v₂, v₁, Function.update_of_ne hr, Function.update_of_ne hp]
    have hrest := ih v₃ hv₃ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by rw [hfin]; exact hK)
    exact NSem.jeq_neg htest hv hne (NSem.inc h₁ hv (NSem.inc h₂ hv₁ (NSem.inc h₃ hv₂ hrest)))

end Loops

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: TCSlib Contributors
